// FILE PATH: ./app/apply/page.tsx
"use client";

import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
import { supabase } from "../lib/supabase";
import { PDFDocument, rgb, StandardFonts } from "pdf-lib";

// Prevents pdf-lib StandardFonts (WinAnsi) from throwing encoding errors on special characters
const sanitizePdfText = (val: string): string =>
  String(val || "").replace(/[^\x20-\x7E]/g, " ");

const formatToDDMMYYYY = (dateStr: string): string => {
  if (!dateStr) return "N/A";
  const parts = dateStr.split("-");
  if (parts.length === 3) return `${parts[2]}/${parts[1]}/${parts[0]}`;
  return dateStr;
};

interface ApplicationFormState {
  name: string;
  dob: string;
  gender: string;
  gov_id_number: string;
  pan_number: string;
  mobile: string;
  alt_mobile: string;
  email: string;
  qualification: string;
  guardian_relation: string;
  guardian_name: string;
  address_1: string;
  address_2: string;
  pin_code: string;
  taluk: string;
  dist: string;
  state: string;
  requested_role: string;
  center_name: string;
  terms_accepted: boolean;
  poi_type: string;
  poa_type: string;
  other_type: string;
  aadhaar_operator_id: string;
  aadhaar_station_id: string;
  nseit_cert_no: string;
}

export default function ApplicationForm() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const initialFormState: ApplicationFormState = {
    name: "",
    dob: "",
    gender: "",
    gov_id_number: "",
    pan_number: "",
    mobile: "",
    alt_mobile: "",
    email: "",
    qualification: "",
    guardian_relation: "Father Name",
    guardian_name: "",
    address_1: "",
    address_2: "",
    pin_code: "",
    taluk: "",
    dist: "",
    state: "",
    requested_role: "OCSC",
    center_name: "",
    terms_accepted: false,
    poi_type: "AADHAAR CARD",
    poa_type: "AADHAAR CARD",
    other_type: "PAN CARD",
    aadhaar_operator_id: "",
    aadhaar_station_id: "",
    nseit_cert_no: "",
  };

  const initialFileState = {
    poi: null,
    poa: null,
    photo: null,
    other: null,
  };

  const [formData, setFormData] =
    useState<ApplicationFormState>(initialFormState);
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<{
    poi: File | null;
    poa: File | null;
    photo: File | null;
    other: File | null;
  }>(initialFileState);
  const [photoPreview, setPhotoPreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [message, setMessage] = useState<string>("");
  const [maxDate, setMaxDate] = useState<string>("");

  useEffect(() => {
    const today = new Date();
    const past18Years = new Date(
      today.getFullYear() - 18,
      today.getMonth(),
      today.getDate()
    );
    const yyyy = past18Years.getFullYear();
    const mm = String(past18Years.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
    const dd = String(past18Years.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
    setMaxDate(`${yyyy}-${mm}-${dd}`);

    return () => {
      if (photoPreview) URL.revokeObjectURL(photoPreview);
    };
  }, [photoPreview]);

  const showError = (errorMsg: string) => {
    setLoading(false);
    setMessage(`❌ ${errorMsg}`);
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  const handlePinCodeChange = async (
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) => {
    const pin = e.target.value.replace(/[^0-9]/g, "");
    if (pin.length < 6) {
      setFormData((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        pin_code: pin,
        taluk: "",
        dist: "",
        state: "",
      }));
      return;
    }

    setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, pin_code: pin }));

    if (pin.length === 6) {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`https://api.postalpincode.in/pincode/${pin}`);
        const data = await res.json();
        if (
          Array.isArray(data) &&
          data[0]?.Status === "Success" &&
          Array.isArray(data[0]?.PostOffice) &&
          data[0].PostOffice.length > 0
        ) {
          const postOffice = data[0].PostOffice[0];
          const resolvedTaluk =
            postOffice.Block && postOffice.Block !== "NA"
              ? postOffice.Block
              : postOffice.Taluk ||
                postOffice.Division ||
                postOffice.Region ||
                "";
          setFormData((prev) => ({
            ...prev,
            taluk: resolvedTaluk,
            dist: postOffice.District || "",
            state: postOffice.State || "",
          }));
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error("Error fetching PIN details", err);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleFileChange = (
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>,
    type: "poi" | "poa" | "photo" | "other"
  ) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
      const file = e.target.files[0];

      if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
        setFiles((prev) => ({ ...prev, [type]: null }));
        if (type === "photo" && photoPreview) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(photoPreview);
          setPhotoPreview(null);
        }
        showError(
          `File size for ${type.toUpperCase()} must be under 2MB. Please select a smaller file.`
        );
        e.target.value = "";
        return;
      }

      setFiles((prev) => ({ ...prev, [type]: file }));

      if (type === "photo") {
        if (photoPreview) URL.revokeObjectURL(photoPreview);
        const objectUrl = URL.createObjectURL(file);
        setPhotoPreview(objectUrl);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const formElement = e.currentTarget as HTMLFormElement;

    setMessage("");

    if (!formData.name.trim()) return showError("Please enter your Full Name.");
    if (!formData.guardian_name.trim())
      return showError("Please enter the Guardian's Name.");
    if (!formData.gender) return showError("Please select your Gender.");

    if (!formData.dob)
      return showError("Please select your Date of Birth from the calendar.");
    const dobDate = new Date(formData.dob);
    if (isNaN(dobDate.getTime()))
      return showError("Invalid Date format. Please use the calendar picker.");
    const maxAllowedDate = new Date(maxDate);
    if (dobDate > maxAllowedDate)
      return showError(
        "You must be at least 18 years old to submit this application."
      );

    if (formData.gov_id_number.length !== 12)
      return showError(
        "Validation Error: ID Number must be exactly 12 digits."
      );

    if (
      formData.pan_number &&
      !/^[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z]{1}$/.test(formData.pan_number)
    ) {
      return showError(
        "Validation Error: Invalid PAN Card format. (e.g., ABCDE1234F)."
      );
    }

    if (formData.mobile.length !== 10)
      return showError(
        "Validation Error: Primary Mobile Number must be exactly 10 digits."
      );
    if (formData.alt_mobile && formData.alt_mobile.length !== 10)
      return showError(
        "Validation Error: Alternative Mobile Number must be exactly 10 digits."
      );

    if (formData.alt_mobile && formData.mobile === formData.alt_mobile) {
      return showError(
        "Validation Error: Alternative mobile number cannot be the exact same as your primary mobile number."
      );
    }

    const emailRegex = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;
    if (!emailRegex.test(formData.email))
      return showError(
        "Validation Error: Please enter a valid lowercase Email Address."
      );

    if (!formData.address_1.trim())
      return showError("Please enter Address Line 1.");
    if (formData.pin_code.length !== 6)
      return showError("Please enter a valid 6-digit PIN Code.");
    if (!formData.dist.trim() || !formData.state.trim())
      return showError(
        "Please enter a valid 6-digit Indian PIN Code so District and State can be verified."
      );
    if (!formData.center_name.trim())
      return showError("Please enter the Requested Center Name / Location.");

    if (formData.requested_role === "AADHAAR CENTER") {
      if (!formData.aadhaar_operator_id.trim())
        return showError("Please enter your UIDAI Operator ID.");
      if (formData.aadhaar_station_id.trim().length !== 5)
        return showError("UIDAI Station ID must be 5 digits.");
      if (!formData.nseit_cert_no.trim())
        return showError("Please enter your NSEIT Certificate Number.");
    }

    if (!formData.terms_accepted)
      return showError("You must accept the terms and conditions.");
    if (!files.poi || !files.poa)
      return showError("Please upload both POI and POA documents.");
    if (!files.photo)
      return showError("Please upload your Passport Size Photo.");

    setLoading(true);
    setMessage("Verifying application identity via secure backend...");
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });

    // =========================================================================
    // 1. SECURE PRE-FLIGHT CHECK (Bypasses RLS limits)
    // =========================================================================
    let rejectedIdToUse = null;
    try {
      const verifyRes = await fetch("/api/verify-applicant", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          email: formData.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
          mobile: formData.mobile.trim(),
          alt_mobile: formData.alt_mobile.trim(),
          gov_id_number: formData.gov_id_number.trim(),
          pan_number: formData.pan_number.trim(),
        }),
      });

      const verifyData = await verifyRes.json();
      if (!verifyRes.ok) {
        return showError(verifyData.error || "Identity verification failed.");
      }
      rejectedIdToUse = verifyData.rejectedId;
    } catch (err) {
      return showError(
        "Network error during security verification. Please try again."
      );
    }

    const uploadedFilesToCleanup: string[] = [];

    try {
      let userIp = "Unknown";
      try {
        const controller = new AbortController();
        const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 3000);
        const ipRes = await fetch("https://api.ipify.org?format=json", {
          signal: controller.signal,
        });
        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        if (ipRes.ok) {
          const ipData = await ipRes.json();
          userIp = ipData.ip || "Unknown";
        }
      } catch (ipErr) {
        console.error("Could not fetch IP", ipErr);
      }

      setMessage("Generating A4 Application Form & Merging KYC Documents...");

      const pdfDoc = await PDFDocument.create();
      const font = await pdfDoc.embedFont(StandardFonts.Helvetica);
      const boldFont = await pdfDoc.embedFont(StandardFonts.HelveticaBold);
      const trackingFont = boldFont;

      const timestamp = sanitizePdfText(new Date().toLocaleString("en-IN"));

      // =========================================================================
      // GENERATE OFFICIAL A4 APPLICATION FORM
      // =========================================================================
      const a4Width = 595.28;
      const a4Height = 841.89;
      const formPage = pdfDoc.addPage([a4Width, a4Height]);

      formPage.drawText("FAST ARK - PARTNER APPLICATION FORM", {
        x: 50,
        y: 790,
        size: 16,
        font: boldFont,
      });
      formPage.drawLine({
        start: { x: 50, y: 780 },
        end: { x: 545, y: 780 },
        thickness: 1,
      });

      if (files.photo) {
        try {
          const photoBuffer = await files.photo.arrayBuffer();
          const mimeType = files.photo.type.toLowerCase();

          let photoImage;
          if (mimeType.includes("png")) {
            photoImage = await pdfDoc.embedPng(photoBuffer);
          } else {
            photoImage = await pdfDoc.embedJpg(photoBuffer);
          }

          formPage.drawImage(photoImage, {
            x: 445,
            y: 640,
            width: 100,
            height: 125,
          });
          formPage.drawRectangle({
            x: 445,
            y: 640,
            width: 100,
            height: 125,
            borderColor: rgb(0, 0, 0),
            borderWidth: 1,
          });
        } catch (err) {
          console.error("Error embedding photo to A4:", err);
        }
      }

      let currentY = 750;
      const drawRow = (label: string, value: string) => {
        formPage.drawText(sanitizePdfText(label), {
          x: 50,
          y: currentY,
          size: 10,
          font: boldFont,
        });
        formPage.drawText(sanitizePdfText(value || "N/A"), {
          x: 200,
          y: currentY,
          size: 10,
          font: font,
        });
        currentY -= 22;
      };

      drawRow("Application Date:", timestamp);
      drawRow("Applicant Name:", formData.name);
      drawRow(`${formData.guardian_relation}:`, formData.guardian_name);
      drawRow("Gender:", formData.gender.toUpperCase());
      drawRow("Date of Birth:", formatToDDMMYYYY(formData.dob));
      drawRow("Gov ID Number:", "[Redacted]");
      drawRow("PAN Number:", formData.pan_number);
      drawRow("Primary Mobile:", formData.mobile);
      drawRow("Alt Mobile:", formData.alt_mobile);
      drawRow("Email Address:", formData.email);
      drawRow("Qualification:", formData.qualification.toUpperCase());

      currentY -= 15;
      formPage.drawText("ADDRESS DETAILS", {
        x: 50,
        y: currentY,
        size: 12,
        font: boldFont,
      });
      currentY -= 25;
      drawRow("Address Line 1:", formData.address_1);
      drawRow("Address Line 2:", formData.address_2);
      drawRow("PIN Code:", formData.pin_code);
      drawRow("Taluk & District:", `${formData.taluk}, ${formData.dist}`);
      drawRow("State:", formData.state);

      currentY -= 15;
      formPage.drawText("ROLE & CENTER REQUEST", {
        x: 50,
        y: currentY,
        size: 12,
        font: boldFont,
      });
      currentY -= 25;
      drawRow("Requested Role:", formData.requested_role);
      drawRow("Requested Center:", formData.center_name.toUpperCase());

      if (formData.requested_role === "AADHAAR CENTER") {
        drawRow(
          "UIDAI Operator ID:",
          formData.aadhaar_operator_id.toUpperCase()
        );
        drawRow("UIDAI Station ID:", formData.aadhaar_station_id);
        drawRow("NSEIT Cert No:", formData.nseit_cert_no.toUpperCase());
      }

      const formStampText = sanitizePdfText(
        `APP: ${formData.name.toUpperCase()} | DOC: SYSTEM GENERATED FORM | FILE: A4_APPLICATION.PDF | IP: ${userIp} | TIME: ${timestamp}`
      );
      formPage.drawRectangle({
        x: 0,
        y: 0,
        width: a4Width,
        height: 20,
        color: rgb(0, 0, 0),
      });
      formPage.drawText(formStampText, {
        x: 10,
        y: 6,
        size: 7,
        font: boldFont,
        color: rgb(1, 1, 1),
      });

      // =========================================================================
      // APPEND KYC DOCUMENTS BEHIND THE A4 FORM
      // =========================================================================
      const fileArray = [
        { file: files.poi, label: `POI: ${formData.poi_type}` },
        { file: files.poa, label: `POA: ${formData.poa_type}` },
      ];

      if (files.other) {
        fileArray.push({
          file: files.other,
          label: `OTHER: ${formData.other_type}`,
        });
      }

      for (const { file, label } of fileArray) {
        if (!file) continue;

        try {
          const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
          const stampText = sanitizePdfText(
            `APP: ${formData.name.toUpperCase()} | DOC: ${label} | FILE: ${file.name.toUpperCase()} | IP: ${userIp} | TIME: ${timestamp}`
          );

          const fileNameLower = file.name.toLowerCase();
          const mimeType = file.type ? file.type.toLowerCase() : "";

          const isPdf =
            mimeType.includes("pdf") || fileNameLower.endsWith(".pdf");
          const isJpg =
            mimeType.includes("jpeg") ||
            mimeType.includes("jpg") ||
            fileNameLower.endsWith(".jpg") ||
            fileNameLower.endsWith(".jpeg");
          const isPng =
            mimeType.includes("png") || fileNameLower.endsWith(".png");

          if (isPdf) {
            const loadedPdf = await PDFDocument.load(arrayBuffer, {
              ignoreEncryption: true,
            });
            const copiedPages = await pdfDoc.copyPages(
              loadedPdf,
              loadedPdf.getPageIndices()
            );

            copiedPages.forEach((page) => {
              pdfDoc.addPage(page);
              const { width } = page.getSize();
              page.drawRectangle({
                x: 0,
                y: 0,
                width: width,
                height: 20,
                color: rgb(0, 0, 0),
              });
              page.drawText(stampText, {
                x: 10,
                y: 6,
                size: 7,
                font: trackingFont,
                color: rgb(1, 1, 1),
              });
            });
          } else if (isJpg || isPng) {
            const image = isJpg
              ? await pdfDoc.embedJpg(arrayBuffer)
              : await pdfDoc.embedPng(arrayBuffer);

            let { width, height } = image;
            const maxWidth = 595.28;
            if (width > maxWidth) {
              const ratio = maxWidth / width;
              width = maxWidth;
              height = height * ratio;
            }

            const page = pdfDoc.addPage([width, height + 25]);
            page.drawImage(image, {
              x: 0,
              y: 25,
              width: width,
              height: height,
            });
            page.drawRectangle({
              x: 0,
              y: 0,
              width: width,
              height: 25,
              color: rgb(0, 0, 0),
            });
            page.drawText(stampText, {
              x: 10,
              y: 8,
              size: 7,
              font: trackingFont,
              color: rgb(1, 1, 1),
            });
          } else {
            console.warn(`Skipped unsupported file type: ${file.name}`);
          }
        } catch (mergeError) {
          console.error(`Merge Failed on ${label}:`, mergeError);
          return showError(
            `Failed to process document: ${file.name}. Ensure it is a valid PDF, JPG, or PNG.`
          );
        }
      }

      const mergedPdfBytes = await pdfDoc.save();
      const safeName = formData.name.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, "_");
      const batchTimestamp = Date.now();
      const pdfFileName = `${safeName}_${batchTimestamp}_KYC.pdf`;

      setMessage("Uploading secure KYC PDF to the Vault...");
      const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
        .from("application_documents")
        .upload(pdfFileName, mergedPdfBytes, {
          contentType: "application/pdf",
        });

      if (uploadError) throw uploadError;
      uploadedFilesToCleanup.push(pdfFileName);

      setMessage("Uploading pristine passport photo...");
      let savedPhotoPath = null;

      if (files.photo) {
        const fileExt = files.photo.name.split(".").pop();
        const photoFileName = `${safeName}_${batchTimestamp}_PHOTO.${fileExt}`;

        const { error: photoUploadError, data: photoData } =
          await supabase.storage
            .from("application_documents")
            .upload(photoFileName, files.photo, {
              contentType: files.photo.type,
            });

        if (photoUploadError) throw photoUploadError;
        savedPhotoPath = photoData.path;
        uploadedFilesToCleanup.push(photoData.path);
      }

      setMessage("Committing application record securely...");
      const combinedGuardian = `${formData.guardian_relation}: ${formData.guardian_name}`;

      const dbPayload = {
        name: formData.name,
        dob: formData.dob,
        gender: formData.gender,
        gov_id_number: formData.gov_id_number,
        pan_number: formData.pan_number || null,
        mobile: formData.mobile,
        alt_mobile: formData.alt_mobile,
        email: formData.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
        qualification: formData.qualification,
        father_name: combinedGuardian,
        address_1: formData.address_1,
        address_2: formData.address_2,
        pin_code: formData.pin_code,
        taluk: formData.taluk,
        dist: formData.dist,
        state: formData.state,
        requested_role: formData.requested_role,
        center_name: formData.center_name,
        role_metadata:
          formData.requested_role === "AADHAAR CENTER"
            ? {
                aadhaar_operator_id:
                  formData.aadhaar_operator_id.trim().toUpperCase(),
                aadhaar_station_id: formData.aadhaar_station_id.trim(),
                nseit_cert_no: formData.nseit_cert_no.trim().toUpperCase(),
                kyc_pdf_path: pdfFileName,
              }
            : {
                kyc_pdf_path: pdfFileName,
              },
        terms_accepted: Boolean(formData.terms_accepted),
        ip_address: userIp,
        photo_path: savedPhotoPath,
        status: "Pending",
        reject_reason: null,
      };

      // =========================================================================
      // 2. SECURE POST-FLIGHT COMMIT (Bypasses RLS limits)
      // =========================================================================
      const submitRes = await fetch("/api/submit-application", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({ dbPayload, rejectedId: rejectedIdToUse }),
      });

      const submitData = await submitRes.json();
      if (!submitRes.ok) {
        if (uploadedFilesToCleanup.length > 0) {
          await supabase.storage
            .from("application_documents")
            .remove(uploadedFilesToCleanup);
        }
        return showError(
          submitData.error || "Database commit failed. Please try again."
        );
      }

      setFormData(initialFormState);
      setFiles(initialFileState);
      if (photoPreview) URL.revokeObjectURL(photoPreview);
      setPhotoPreview(null);
      formElement.reset();
      setLoading(false);

      setMessage(
        "✅ Thank you. Your application has been successfully submitted to the Fast Ark Back Office."
      );

      router.refresh();
      setTimeout(() => setMessage(""), 8000);
    } catch (error: any) {
      if (uploadedFilesToCleanup.length > 0) {
        await supabase.storage
          .from("application_documents")
          .remove(uploadedFilesToCleanup);
      }
      console.error("Submission Error:", error);
      showError(
        error.message || "An unexpected error occurred during submission."
      );
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-100 py-12 px-4 sm:px-6">
      {/* 1. TOP ESCAPE HATCH */}
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto mb-4">
        <Link
          href="/"
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-500 font-black tracking-widest uppercase text-xs hover:text-blue-600 transition bg-white px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm border border-slate-200"
        >
          <span>&larr;</span> Return to Main Website
        </Link>
      </div>

      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto bg-white rounded-xl shadow-lg border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-6 text-white">
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-black">Partner Application Form</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-300 mt-2">
            Submit your details and KYC documents below.
          </p>
        </div>

        <form
          onSubmit={handleSubmit}
          noValidate
          className="p-8 space-y-10 text-slate-800"
        >
          {message && (
            <div
              className={`p-4 rounded-md font-bold text-center border shadow-sm transition-all duration-300 ${
                message.startsWith("❌")
                  ? "bg-red-50 text-red-800 border-red-200"
                  : message.startsWith("✅")
                  ? "bg-green-50 text-green-800 border-green-200"
                  : "bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-blue-200"
              } text-lg`}
            >
              {message}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* PERSONAL DETAILS & PHOTO UPLOAD */}
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-xl font-bold border-b pb-2 mb-6">
              Personal Details
            </h2>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
              <div className="lg:col-span-2 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <input
                  required
                  placeholder="Full Name (Max 45 Letters) *"
                  maxLength={45}
                  className="border p-3 rounded outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                  value={formData.name}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setFormData({
                      ...formData,
                      name: e.target.value
                        .replace(/[^A-Za-z\s]/g, "")
                        .toUpperCase(),
                    })
                  }
                />

                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <select
                    className="border p-3 rounded bg-gray-50 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 w-1/3"
                    value={formData.guardian_relation}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setFormData({
                        ...formData,
                        guardian_relation: e.target.value,
                      })
                    }
                  >
                    <option value="Father Name">Father Name</option>
                    <option value="Mother Name">Mother Name</option>
                    <option value="Guardian">Guardian</option>

                  />
                </div>
                <div>

                    NSEIT Certificate No *

                      setFormData({
                        ...formData,
                        nseit_cert_no: e.target.value.toUpperCase(),

            {formData.requested_role === "IRCTC AGENT" && (
              <p className="text-red-600 text-sm font-bold mt-2 border-l-4 border-red-600 pl-3">
                WARNING: Ensure your ID, Email, and Mobile are NOT blacklisted
                by IRCTC.

                    required
                    onChange={(e) => handleFileChange(e, "poi")}
                    className="flex-1 bg-white border p-2 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block font-bold mb-1">
                  2. Proof of Address (POA) - Mandatory
                </label>

                  <select

                    accept=".pdf, .jpg, .jpeg, .png"
                    required
                    onChange={(e) => handleFileChange(e, "poa")}
                    className="flex-1 bg-white border p-2 rounded cursor-pointer"
                  />

                <label className="block font-bold mb-1 text-gray-600">

                  setFormData((prev) => ({

// FILE PATH: ./app/partner/deposit/page.tsx
"use client";

import React, { useEffect, useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
import { supabase } from "../../lib/supabase";
import { QRCodeSVG } from "qrcode.react";
import { scanPaymentReceiptOCR } from "../../lib/ocrEngine";
import {
  reportAndMaskError,
  logSystemTelemetry,
  generateSystemReferenceCode,
} from "../../lib/errorCodes";
import {
  DatePresetMode,
  getDateRangeFromPreset,
  formatToDDMMYYYY,
  getISTDateString,
} from "../../lib/aadhaarEngine";

export default function PartnerDepositPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [partner, setPartner] = useState<any>(null);
  const [centerUpi, setCenterUpi] = useState<string>("fastark@upi");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [statusBanner, setStatusBanner] = useState<{
    type: "success" | "error" | "info";
    text: string;
  } | null>(null);

  // Desktop Split-Pane & Mobile 3-Tab Switcher ("form" | "viewer" | "ledger")
  const [rightPanel, setRightPanel] = useState<"ledger" | "viewer">("ledger");
  const [mobileTab, setMobileTab] = useState<"form" | "viewer" | "ledger">(
    "form"
  );

  // Data States
  const [deposits, setDeposits] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [salesList, setSalesList] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [matchedRows, setMatchedRows] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  // 7-Option Date Preset Filter (Week / Month / Custom)
  const [datePreset, setDatePreset] = useState<DatePresetMode>("current_month");
  const [filterFromDate, setFilterFromDate] = useState<string>(
    () => getDateRangeFromPreset("current_month").start
  );
  const [filterToDate, setFilterToDate] = useState<string>(
    () => getDateRangeFromPreset("current_month").end
  );

  // Submission Form State (Includes Unique UTR, Transaction ID & Auto Reference Code)
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    deposit_amount: "",
    deposit_method: "UPI",
    utr_number: "",
    transaction_id: "",
    reference_code: generateSystemReferenceCode("FA-DEP", getISTDateString(0)),
    deposit_date: getISTDateString(0),
  });

  // Slip, Exemption, Preset & OCR States
  const [slipTypePreset, setSlipTypePreset] = useState("auto");
  const [slipImage, setSlipImage] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [imagePreview, setImagePreview] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isScanning, setIsScanning] = useState(false);
  const [scanProgress, setScanProgress] = useState(0);

  // Scanned Extracted Snapshot for Audit
  const [detectedPlatform, setDetectedPlatform] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [ocrRawAmount, setOcrRawAmount] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [ocrRawRef, setOcrRawRef] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [ocrRawTxnId, setOcrRawTxnId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [ocrRawDate, setOcrRawDate] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isUserVerified, setIsUserVerified] = useState(false);

  const [isExempted, setIsExempted] = useState(false);
  const [exemptionCategory, setExemptionCategory] = useState("");
  const [otherExemptionText, setOtherExemptionText] = useState("");

  // Edit / Correction States
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editForm, setEditForm] = useState<any>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    initializePortal();
    return () => {
      if (imagePreview) URL.revokeObjectURL(imagePreview);
    };
  }, [router]);

  const showBanner = (type: "success" | "error" | "info", text: string) => {
    setStatusBanner({ type, text });
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  const handleNumericKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (["ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "e", "E", "+", "-"].includes(e.key)) {
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  };

  const handlePresetChange = (mode: DatePresetMode) => {
    setDatePreset(mode);
    if (mode !== "custom") {
      const range = getDateRangeFromPreset(mode);
      setFilterFromDate(range.start);
      setFilterToDate(range.end);
    }
  };

  const initializePortal = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      if (!session) return router.push("/partner/login");

      const { data: partnerData, error: partnerError } = await supabase
        .from("active_partners")
        .select(
          "id, center_id, partner_name, email, role, locations(center_name, center_code)"
        )
        .ilike("email", session.user.email || "")
        .maybeSingle();

      if (partnerError || !partnerData)
        throw new Error("Partner profile not found.");
      setPartner(partnerData);

      const [depRes, salesRes] = await Promise.all([
        supabase
          .from("partner_deposits")
          .select("*")
          .eq("partner_id", partnerData.id)
          .order("deposit_date", { ascending: false }),
        supabase
          .from("daily_sales_reports")
          .select("*")
          .eq("partner_id", partnerData.id)
          .order("report_date", { ascending: false }),
      ]);

      const telecomDeps = (depRes.data || []).filter(
        (d: any) =>
          d.deposit_stream !== "AADHAAR" &&
          !String(d.reference_no || "")
            .toUpperCase()
            .startsWith("AADHAAR_")
      );

      setDeposits(telecomDeps);
      setSalesList(salesRes.data || []);

      if (partnerData.center_id) {
        const { data: upiData } = await supabase
          .from("upi_ids")
          .select("upi_id")
          .eq("assigned_location_id", partnerData.center_id)
          .eq("is_active", true)
          .maybeSingle();

        if (upiData && upiData.upi_id) {
          setCenterUpi(upiData.upi_id);
        }
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      await reportAndMaskError(err, "PARTNER_DEPOSIT_INIT");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // --- ENHANCED CANVAS OCR ENGINE ---
  const handleImageUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setSlipImage(file);
    if (imagePreview) URL.revokeObjectURL(imagePreview);
    setImagePreview(URL.createObjectURL(file));

    setRightPanel("viewer");
    setIsScanning(true);
    setScanProgress(0);
    setIsExempted(false);
    setIsUserVerified(false);
    setDetectedPlatform(null);
    setOcrRawAmount(null);
    setOcrRawRef(null);
    setOcrRawTxnId(null);
    setOcrRawDate(null);

    try {
      if (
        file.type === "application/pdf" ||
        file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf")
      ) {
        setDetectedPlatform("PDF Receipt Attached");
        setIsScanning(false);
        return;
      }

      const ocrResult = await scanPaymentReceiptOCR(
        file,
        slipTypePreset,
        (pct) => setScanProgress(pct)
      );

      setDetectedPlatform(ocrResult.platform);
      setOcrRawAmount(ocrResult.amount);
      setOcrRawRef(ocrResult.utr);
      setOcrRawTxnId(ocrResult.transactionId);
      setOcrRawDate(ocrResult.date);

      const nextDate = ocrResult.date || form.deposit_date;
      setForm((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        deposit_amount:
          ocrResult.amount !== null
            ? ocrResult.amount.toString()
            : prev.deposit_amount,
        utr_number: ocrResult.utr ? ocrResult.utr : prev.utr_number,
        transaction_id: ocrResult.transactionId
          ? ocrResult.transactionId
          : ocrResult.utr || prev.transaction_id,
        deposit_method: ocrResult.method || prev.deposit_method,
        deposit_date: nextDate,
        reference_code: generateSystemReferenceCode("FA-DEP", nextDate),
      }));
    } catch (err) {
      const safeMsg = await reportAndMaskError(err, "PARTNER_DEPOSIT_OCR", {
        id: partner?.id,
        email: partner?.email,
      });
      showBanner("info", safeMsg);
    } finally {
      setIsScanning(false);
    }
  };

  // --- SECURE DOCUMENT VIEWER ---
  const handleViewSecureSlip = async (path: string) => {
    if (path.startsWith("http")) {
      window.open(path, "_blank");
      return;
    }

    const { data, error } = await supabase.storage
      .from("deposit-slips")
      .createSignedUrl(path, 60);

    if (error || !data) {
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "[ERR-VLT-301] Unable to open document from the vault."
      );
    }

    window.open(data.signedUrl, "_blank");
  };

  // --- SUBMIT NEW DEPOSIT (WITH UNIQUE UTR, TRANSACTION ID & REFERENCE CODE) ---
  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!isExempted && slipImage && !isUserVerified) {
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "⚠️ Please review all auto-scanned fields and check the confirmation box before submitting."
      );
    }

    if (!form.deposit_date || form.deposit_date > getISTDateString(0)) {
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Validation Error: Deposit Date cannot be in the future."
      );
    }

    const amt = parseFloat(form.deposit_amount);
    if (isNaN(amt) || amt <= 0)
      return showBanner("error", "Deposit Amount must be greater than zero.");

    const cleanUtr = form.utr_number.trim().replace(/\s+/g, "").toUpperCase();
    const cleanTxnId = (form.transaction_id || cleanUtr)
      .trim()
      .replace(/\s+/g, "")
      .toUpperCase();
    const finalRefCode =
      form.reference_code ||
      generateSystemReferenceCode("FA-DEP", form.deposit_date);

    if (cleanUtr.length < 4)
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Please provide a valid Unique UTR Number (minimum 4 characters)."
      );
    if (cleanTxnId.length < 4)
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Please provide a valid Transaction / Scroll ID (minimum 4 characters)."
      );
    if (!isExempted && !slipImage)
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Please upload the deposit slip, or declare an exemption."
      );
    if (isExempted && !exemptionCategory)
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "You must select a reason for not uploading a slip."
      );
    if (
      isExempted &&
      exemptionCategory === "Other" &&
      otherExemptionText.trim().length < 4
    ) {
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "You must provide detailed remarks for 'Other' missing slips."
      );
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    setStatusBanner(null);
    try {
      const { data: dupCheck } = await supabase
        .from("partner_deposits")
        .select("id, reference_code")
        .or(
          `utr_number.eq.${cleanUtr},reference_no.eq.${cleanUtr},reference_no.eq.AADHAAR_${cleanUtr}`
        )
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (dupCheck) {
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return showBanner(
          "error",
          `[ERR-DUP-205] Fraud Prevention Block: UTR '${cleanUtr}' has already been submitted under Reference Code ${
            dupCheck.reference_code || "EXISTING"
          }.`
        );
      }

      let finalSlipUrl = null;
      if (!isExempted && slipImage) {
        const fileExt = slipImage.name.split(".").pop();
        const fileName = `slip-${partner.id}-${Date.now()}.${fileExt}`;

        const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
          .from("deposit-slips")
          .upload(fileName, slipImage);
        if (uploadError) throw uploadError;

        finalSlipUrl = fileName;
      }

      const finalExemptionReason = isExempted
        ? exemptionCategory === "Other"
          ? `OTHER: ${otherExemptionText}`
          : exemptionCategory
        : null;

      const basePayload: any = {
        partner_id: partner.id,
        center_id: partner.center_id,
        deposit_amount: amt,
        deposit_method: form.deposit_method,
        reference_no: cleanUtr,
        deposit_date: form.deposit_date,
        deposit_slip_url: finalSlipUrl,
        is_exempted: isExempted,
        exemption_reason: finalExemptionReason,
        status: "Pending",
      };

      const { error: richErr } = await supabase.from("partner_deposits").insert([
        {
          ...basePayload,
          deposit_stream: "TELECOM",
          utr_number: cleanUtr,
          transaction_id: cleanTxnId,
          reference_code: finalRefCode,
        },
      ]);

      if (richErr && richErr.code === "42703") {
        const { error: fbErr } = await supabase
          .from("partner_deposits")
          .insert([basePayload]);
        if (fbErr) throw fbErr;
      } else if (richErr) {
        throw richErr;
      }

      await logSystemTelemetry({
        actorId: partner.id,
        actorEmail: partner.email,
        module: "PARTNER_TELECOM_DEPOSIT",
        actionCode: "DEPOSIT_SUBMITTED",
        referenceId: finalRefCode,
        metadata: {
          amount: amt,
          method: form.deposit_method,
          utr_number: cleanUtr,
          transaction_id: cleanTxnId,
          reference_code: finalRefCode,
        },
      });

      const todayStr = getISTDateString(0);
      setForm({
        deposit_amount: "",
        deposit_method: "UPI",
        utr_number: "",
        transaction_id: "",
        reference_code: generateSystemReferenceCode("FA-DEP", todayStr),
        deposit_date: todayStr,
      });
      setSlipImage(null);
      if (imagePreview) URL.revokeObjectURL(imagePreview);
      setImagePreview(null);
      setOcrRawAmount(null);
      setOcrRawRef(null);
      setOcrRawTxnId(null);
      setOcrRawDate(null);
      setDetectedPlatform(null);
      setIsUserVerified(false);
      setIsExempted(false);
      setExemptionCategory("");
      setOtherExemptionText("");

      setRightPanel("ledger");
      setMobileTab("ledger");
      showBanner(
        "success",
        `✅ Deposit of ₹${amt.toLocaleString(
          "en-IN"
        )} recorded! Reference Code: ${finalRefCode} | UTR: ${cleanUtr}`
      );
      initializePortal();
    } catch (err: any) {
      const safeMsg = await reportAndMaskError(err, "PARTNER_DEPOSIT_SUBMIT", {
        id: partner?.id,
        email: partner?.email,
      });
      showBanner("error", safeMsg);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  // --- EDIT / CORRECTION ENGINE (WITH DUPLICATE UTR GUARD & MOBILE SUPPORT) ---
  const startEditing = (dep: any) => {
    setEditingId(dep.id);
    setEditForm({
      deposit_amount: dep.deposit_amount,
      utr_number: dep.utr_number || dep.reference_no || "",
      transaction_id: dep.transaction_id || dep.reference_no || "",
      deposit_method: dep.deposit_method,
    });
  };

  const handleEditSubmit = async (id: string) => {
    const cleanUtr = String(editForm.utr_number || "")
      .trim()
      .replace(/\s+/g, "")
      .toUpperCase();
    const cleanTxn = String(editForm.transaction_id || cleanUtr)
      .trim()
      .replace(/\s+/g, "")
      .toUpperCase();
    const amt = parseFloat(editForm.deposit_amount);

    if (isNaN(amt) || amt <= 0)
      return showBanner("error", "Amount must be greater than zero.");
    if (cleanUtr.length < 4)
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Valid Unique UTR (minimum 4 characters) is required."
      );
    if (cleanTxn.length < 4)
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Valid Transaction ID (minimum 4 characters) is required."
      );
    if (!confirm("Update this pending deposit record?")) return;

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      // Pre-flight duplicate UTR check excluding the current record being edited
      const { data: dupCheck } = await supabase
        .from("partner_deposits")
        .select("id, reference_code")
        .neq("id", id)
        .or(
          `utr_number.eq.${cleanUtr},reference_no.eq.${cleanUtr},reference_no.eq.AADHAAR_${cleanUtr}`
        )
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (dupCheck) {
        setIsSubmitting(false);
        return showBanner(
          "error",
          `[ERR-DUP-205] Fraud Prevention Block: UTR '${cleanUtr}' is already registered under Reference Code ${
            dupCheck.reference_code || "EXISTING"
          }.`
        );
      }

      const { error: richErr } = await supabase
        .from("partner_deposits")
        .update({
          deposit_amount: amt,
          reference_no: cleanUtr,
          utr_number: cleanUtr,
          transaction_id: cleanTxn,
          deposit_method: editForm.deposit_method,
        })
        .eq("id", id)
        .in("status", ["Pending", "Pending Verification"]);

      if (richErr && richErr.code === "42703") {
        const { error: fbErr } = await supabase
          .from("partner_deposits")
          .update({
            deposit_amount: amt,
            reference_no: cleanUtr,
            deposit_method: editForm.deposit_method,
          })
          .eq("id", id)
          .in("status", ["Pending", "Pending Verification"]);
        if (fbErr) throw fbErr;
      } else if (richErr) {
        throw richErr;
      }

      await logSystemTelemetry({
        actorId: partner?.id,
        actorEmail: partner?.email,
        module: "PARTNER_TELECOM_DEPOSIT",
        actionCode: "PENDING_DEPOSIT_EDITED",
        referenceId: id,
        metadata: { amount: amt, utr: cleanUtr, transaction_id: cleanTxn },
      });

      showBanner("success", "✅ Pending deposit record updated.");
      setEditingId(null);
      initializePortal();
    } catch (err: any) {
      const safeMsg = await reportAndMaskError(err, "PARTNER_DEPOSIT_EDIT", {
        id: partner?.id,
        email: partner?.email,
      });
      showBanner("error", safeMsg);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const toggleMatch = (id: string) => {
    setMatchedRows((prev) => {
      const newSet = new Set(prev);
      if (newSet.has(id)) newSet.delete(id);
      else newSet.add(id);
      return newSet;
    });
  };

  // Filtered Sales & Deposits by Selected Week / Month / Custom Date Range
  const filteredDeposits = useMemo(() => {
    return deposits.filter((d) => {
      const dt = (d.deposit_date || d.created_at || "").split("T")[0];
      return dt >= filterFromDate && dt <= filterToDate;
    });
  }, [deposits, filterFromDate, filterToDate]);

  const filteredSales = useMemo(() => {
    return salesList.filter((s) => {
      const dt = (s.report_date || "").split("T")[0];
      return dt >= filterFromDate && dt <= filterToDate;
    });
  }, [salesList, filterFromDate, filterToDate]);

  // Total Collection Deducted from Deposit = Balance Payable
  const reconciliationMetrics = useMemo(() => {
    const calcSaleRow = (s: any) =>
      Number(s.cbp_landline_amt || 0) +
      Number(s.cbp_gsm_amt || 0) +
      Number(s.ctop_recharge_amt || 0) +
      Number(s.sim_replacement_amt || 0) +
      Number(s.sim_fancy_amt || 0) +
      Number(s.sim_postpaid_amt || 0) +
      Number(s.other_amt || 0) +
      Number(s.frc_amt || 0) +
      Number(s.mnp_amt || 0) +
      Number(s.pb_cbp_amt || 0) +
      Number(s.pb_ctop_amt || 0) +
      Number(s.pb_frc_amt || 0) +
      Number(s.pb_mnp_amt || 0) +
      Number(s.pb_other_amt || 0);

    const lifetimeCollection = salesList.reduce(
      (sum, s) => sum + calcSaleRow(s),
      0
    );
    const lifetimeDeposited = deposits
      .filter((d) => d.status !== "Discrepancy")
      .reduce((sum, d) => sum + Number(d.deposit_amount || 0), 0);
    const lifetimePayable = Math.max(0, lifetimeCollection - lifetimeDeposited);

    const periodCollection = filteredSales.reduce(
      (sum, s) => sum + calcSaleRow(s),
      0
    );
    const periodDeposited = filteredDeposits
      .filter((d) => d.status !== "Discrepancy")
      .reduce((sum, d) => sum + Number(d.deposit_amount || 0), 0);

    return {
      lifetimeCollection,
      lifetimeDeposited,
      lifetimePayable,
      periodCollection,
      periodDeposited,
    };
  }, [salesList, deposits, filteredSales, filteredDeposits]);

  if (loading)
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="w-12 h-12 border-4 border-slate-200 border-t-blue-600 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
      </div>
    );

  // QR & Mobile Deep-Link Engine (NPCI Compliant)
  const userEnteredValue = parseFloat(form.deposit_amount) || 0;
  const safeAmount = userEnteredValue.toFixed(2);
  const safeName = encodeURIComponent("Fast Ark");
  const rawNote = `Rolling_${partner?.center_id}`;
  const safeNote = encodeURIComponent(rawNote.substring(0, 48));
  const upiString = `upi://pay?pa=${centerUpi}&pn=${safeName}&am=${safeAmount}&cu=INR&tn=${safeNote}`;

  const isPdfPreview =
    slipImage?.type === "application/pdf" ||
    (slipImage?.name || "").toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf");

  const numInputClass =
    "w-full border-2 border-slate-200 p-3 rounded-lg outline-none focus:border-blue-500 font-black text-slate-800 transition [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-100 p-3 sm:p-6 md:p-8 pb-24 lg:pb-10 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-[1400px] mx-auto space-y-5">
        {/* HEADER */}
        <div className="bg-white p-4 sm:p-6 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4">
          <div>
            <Link
              href="/partner/dashboard"
              className="text-blue-600 font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest mb-1 hover:underline inline-block"
            >
              &larr; Back to Dashboard
            </Link>
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <span>💳</span> Deposit of Sales &amp; Cash Collection
            </h1>
            <p className="text-slate-500 text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold mt-1">
              Submit bank slips with Unique UTR, Transaction ID &amp; Auto
              Reference Code.
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-left md:text-right shadow-sm w-full md:w-auto">
            <p className="text-[10px] text-blue-600 font-black uppercase tracking-widest">
              Active Center [{partner?.locations?.center_code || "CENTER"}]
            </p>
            <p className="font-black text-slate-900">
              {partner?.locations?.center_name}
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {statusBanner && (
          <div
            className={`p-4 rounded-xl border-2 font-bold text-xs flex justify-between items-center shadow-sm ${
              statusBanner.type === "error"
                ? "bg-red-50 border-red-300 text-red-900"
                : statusBanner.type === "success"
                ? "bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-900"
                : "bg-blue-50 border-blue-300 text-blue-900"
            }`}
          >
            <span>{statusBanner.text}</span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setStatusBanner(null)}
              className="font-black text-base px-2"
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* COLLECTION DEDUCTED FROM DEPOSIT = BALANCE PAYABLE BANNER */}
        <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-2xl p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-xl border border-slate-800 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-3 sm:gap-4">
          <div className="bg-slate-800/90 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-blue-400 tracking-widest">
              1. Total Cash Collection
            </p>
            <p className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-white mt-1">
              ₹
              {reconciliationMetrics.lifetimeCollection.toLocaleString(
                "en-IN",
                { minimumFractionDigits: 2 }
              )}
            </p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold mt-1">
              Period: ₹
              {reconciliationMetrics.periodCollection.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-800/90 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700">
            <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-emerald-400 tracking-widest">
              2. Less: Total Deposited
            </p>
            <p className="text-xl sm:text-2xl font-black text-emerald-400 mt-1">
              - ₹
              {reconciliationMetrics.lifetimeDeposited.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
                minimumFractionDigits: 2,
              })}
            </p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold mt-1">
              Period: ₹
              {reconciliationMetrics.periodDeposited.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div
            className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border-2 ${
              reconciliationMetrics.lifetimePayable > 0
                ? "bg-red-950/80 border-red-500"
                : "bg-emerald-950/80 border-emerald-500"
            }`}
          >
            <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-amber-300 tracking-widest">
              3. Remaining Balance Payable
            </p>
            <p className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-white mt-1">
              ₹
              {reconciliationMetrics.lifetimePayable.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
                minimumFractionDigits: 2,
              })}
            </p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-300 font-bold mt-1">
              Total Collection - Total Deposit
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-slate-800/90 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-700 flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div>
              <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-indigo-300 tracking-widest">
                4. Next Auto Reference Code
              </p>
              <p className="font-mono font-black text-sm text-indigo-300 mt-1">
                {form.reference_code}
              </p>
            </div>
            {reconciliationMetrics.lifetimePayable > 0 && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setForm((prev) => ({
                    ...prev,
                    deposit_amount:
                      reconciliationMetrics.lifetimePayable.toFixed(2),
                  }));
                  setMobileTab("form");
                }}
                className="mt-2 w-full bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-black py-1.5 px-3 rounded-lg text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider transition"
              >
                ⚡ Fill Payable (₹{reconciliationMetrics.lifetimePayable})
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* MOBILE 3-TAB SWITCHER (VISIBLE ON PHONES / TABLETS < LG) */}
        <div className="lg:hidden bg-white p-1.5 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm grid grid-cols-3 gap-1.5">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setMobileTab("form")}
            className={`py-2.5 rounded-lg font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition ${
              mobileTab === "form"
                ? "bg-slate-900 text-white shadow"
                : "text-slate-600 bg-slate-50"
            }`}
          >
            💳 1. Deposit
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setMobileTab("viewer");
              setRightPanel("viewer");
            }}
            className={`py-2.5 rounded-lg font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition ${
              mobileTab === "viewer"
                ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow"
                : "text-slate-600 bg-slate-50"
            }`}
          >
            📄 2. Slip ({slipImage ? "1" : "0"})
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setMobileTab("ledger");
              setRightPanel("ledger");
            }}
            className={`py-2.5 rounded-lg font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider transition ${
              mobileTab === "ledger"
                ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow"
                : "text-slate-600 bg-slate-50"
            }`}
          >
            📖 3. Ledger ({filteredDeposits.length})
          </button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 items-start">
          {/* LEFT: SUBMISSION FORM */}
          <div
            className={`bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 p-5 sm:p-6 lg:sticky lg:top-8 lg:max-h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] lg:overflow-y-auto ${
              mobileTab === "form" ? "block" : "hidden lg:block"
            }`}
          >
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-100 pb-3 mb-5">
              <h2 className="font-black text-base sm:text-lg text-slate-800">
                Record New Remittance
              </h2>
              <span className="font-mono text-[10px] font-black bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 border border-indigo-200 px-2 py-1 rounded">
                {form.reference_code}
              </span>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
              <div>
                <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1.5">
                  Receipt Format Preset
                </label>
                <select
                  value={slipTypePreset}
                  onChange={(e) => setSlipTypePreset(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full border-2 border-slate-200 p-2.5 rounded-lg outline-none focus:border-blue-500 font-bold text-xs bg-slate-50 text-slate-700"
                >
                  <option value="auto">⚡ Auto-Detect Receipt Format</option>
                  <option value="gpay">Google Pay (UPI)</option>
                  <option value="phonepe">PhonePe (UPI)</option>
                  <option value="paytm">Paytm (UPI)</option>
                  <option value="cash_slip">Bank Branch Cash Slip</option>
                  <option value="neft_imps">NEFT / RTGS / IMPS Receipt</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3 pt-1 border-t border-slate-100">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    className="w-5 h-5 accent-amber-600"
                    checked={isExempted}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setIsExempted(e.target.checked);
                      setSlipImage(null);
                      if (imagePreview) URL.revokeObjectURL(imagePreview);
                      setImagePreview(null);
                      setOcrRawAmount(null);
                      setOcrRawRef(null);
                      setOcrRawTxnId(null);
                      setOcrRawDate(null);
                      setDetectedPlatform(null);
                      setIsUserVerified(false);
                      setExemptionCategory("");
                      setOtherExemptionText("");
                      setRightPanel("ledger");
                    }}
                  />
                  <span className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-700">
                    No deposit slip available (Request Exemption)
                  </span>
                </label>

                {!isExempted ? (
                  <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-blue-300 rounded-xl p-5 text-center bg-blue-50/40 relative transition-all hover:bg-blue-50">
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      accept="image/*,application/pdf,.pdf"
                      onChange={handleImageUpload}
                      className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 cursor-pointer z-10"
                    />
                    {!imagePreview ? (
                      <div>
                        <div className="text-3xl mb-1">📸</div>
                        <p className="font-black text-slate-800 text-sm">
                          Upload Slip or Screenshot
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 mt-1">
                          GPay, PhonePe, Paytm, or Bank Cash Receipt (Image /
                          PDF)
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
                        <div className="text-3xl mb-1">✅</div>
                        <p className="font-black text-emerald-700 text-xs truncate max-w-full">
                          {slipImage?.name || "Document Attached"}
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-blue-600 bg-blue-100 px-3 py-1 rounded-full mt-2">
                          Tap to change file
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="animate-in fade-in bg-amber-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 space-y-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="text-[9px] text-amber-800 font-black uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1">
                        Reason for Missing Slip *
                      </label>
                      <select
                        required
                        value={exemptionCategory}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          setExemptionCategory(e.target.value);
                          setOtherExemptionText("");
                        }}
                        className="w-full bg-white border-2 border-amber-200 text-slate-800 font-bold text-xs rounded-lg p-2.5 outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
                      >
                        <option value="" disabled>
                          -- Select Reason --
                        </option>
                        <option value="Missing">Missing / Lost Slip</option>
                        <option value="Not downloaded">
                          Not Downloaded / App Error
                        </option>
                        <option value="Other">Other (Specify Below)</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    {exemptionCategory === "Other" && (
                      <div>
                        <label className="text-[9px] text-amber-800 font-black uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1">
                          Detailed Reason *
                        </label>
                        <input
                          required
                          type="text"
                          placeholder="TYPE REASON HERE..."
                          value={otherExemptionText}
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            setOtherExemptionText(e.target.value.toUpperCase())
                          }
                          className="w-full bg-white border-2 border-amber-200 text-slate-800 font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-xs rounded-lg p-2.5 outline-none focus:border-amber-500"
                        />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {isScanning && !isExempted && (
                <div className="p-4 bg-blue-50 rounded-xl border border-blue-200 text-center space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-blue-700 font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider">
                    <div className="w-3.5 h-3.5 border-2 border-blue-600 border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
                    Pre-processing &amp; Scanning Slip ({scanProgress}%)
                  </div>
                  <div className="w-full bg-blue-200 h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                    <div
                      className="bg-blue-600 h-full transition-all duration-200"
                      style={{ width: `${scanProgress}%` }}
                    ></div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {!isScanning && !isExempted && slipImage && detectedPlatform && (
                <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3 border-2 border-slate-800">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-blue-400 uppercase tracking-widest">
                      Enhanced OCR Capture
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-black bg-blue-900/60 text-blue-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-700">
                      {detectedPlatform}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
                    <div className="bg-slate-800/80 p-2 rounded">
                      <p className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 uppercase">
                        Scanned Amount
                      </p>
                      <p className="font-bold text-emerald-400">
                        {ocrRawAmount
                          ? `₹${ocrRawAmount.toLocaleString("en-IN")}`
                          : "Verify Below"}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="bg-slate-800/80 p-2 rounded">
                      <p className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 uppercase">
                        Scanned Date
                      </p>
                      <p className="font-bold text-slate-200">
                        {ocrRawDate
                          ? formatToDDMMYYYY(ocrRawDate)
                          : "Verify Below"}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="bg-slate-800/80 p-2 rounded text-xs">
                    <p className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 uppercase">
                      Scanned UTR / Txn ID
                    </p>
                    <p className="font-bold text-slate-200 tracking-wider truncate">
                      {ocrRawRef || ocrRawTxnId || "Verify Manually Below"}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <label className="flex items-start gap-2.5 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-blue-950/70 border border-blue-700/80 cursor-pointer hover:bg-blue-950 transition">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      required
                      checked={isUserVerified}
                      onChange={(e) => setIsUserVerified(e.target.checked)}
                      className="w-5 h-5 accent-blue-500 mt-0.5 cursor-pointer shrink-0"
                    />
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-200 leading-tight">
                      I have cross-checked the Amount, Date, Unique UTR, and
                      Transaction ID against the uploaded receipt.
                    </span>
                  </label>
                </div>
              )}

              <div>
                <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1.5">
                  1. Deposit Amount (₹) *
                </label>
                <input
                  required
                  type="number"
                  inputMode="decimal"
                  step="0.01"
                  min="0"
                  value={form.deposit_amount}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setForm({ ...form, deposit_amount: e.target.value })
                  }
                  onWheel={(e) => (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur()}
                  onKeyDown={handleNumericKeyDown}
                  className={numInputClass}
                  placeholder="0.00"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1.5">
                    2. Deposit Date *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    required
                    type="date"
                    max={getISTDateString(0)}
                    value={form.deposit_date}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setForm({
                        ...form,
                        deposit_date: e.target.value,
                        reference_code: generateSystemReferenceCode(
                          "FA-DEP",
                          e.target.value
                        ),
                      })
                    }
                    className="w-full border-2 border-slate-200 p-3 rounded-lg outline-none focus:border-blue-500 font-bold text-xs bg-white"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1.5">
                    3. Deposit Method *
                  </label>
                  <select
                    required
                    value={form.deposit_method}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setForm({ ...form, deposit_method: e.target.value })
                    }
                    className="w-full border-2 border-slate-200 p-3 rounded-lg outline-none focus:border-blue-500 font-bold text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    <option value="UPI">UPI</option>
                    <option value="NEFT/RTGS">NEFT/RTGS</option>
                    <option value="IMPS">IMPS</option>
                    <option value="Cash Deposit">Bank Cash Deposit</option>
                    <option value="Cheque">Cheque</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-blue-700 uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1.5">
                  4. Unique UTR Number (12-Digit UPI / Bank Ref) *
                </label>
                <input
                  required
                  type="text"
                  value={form.utr_number}
                  onChange={(e) =>
                    setForm({
                      ...form,
                      utr_number: e.target.value.toUpperCase(),
                    })
                  }
                  className="w-full border-2 border-blue-200 bg-blue-50/30 p-3 rounded-lg outline-none focus:border-blue-600 font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider"
                  placeholder="e.g. 412345678901"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1.5">
                    5. Transaction / Journal ID *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    required
                    type="text"
                    value={form.transaction_id}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      setForm({
                        ...form,
                        transaction_id: e.target.value.toUpperCase(),
                      })
                    }
                    className="w-full border-2 border-slate-200 p-2.5 rounded-lg outline-none focus:border-blue-500 font-bold text-xs uppercase"
                    placeholder="Txn / Scroll / Challan ID"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-indigo-700 uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1.5">
                    6. Reference Code (Auto)
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    readOnly
                    value={form.reference_code}
                    className="w-full border-2 border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 p-2.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-black text-xs text-indigo-900 cursor-not-allowed"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {form.deposit_method === "UPI" && userEnteredValue > 0 && (
                <div className="bg-slate-900 rounded-xl p-5 text-center border-2 border-slate-800 shadow-inner flex flex-col items-center animate-in fade-in mt-2">
                  <p className="text-blue-400 font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-xs mb-3">
                    Scan or Tap to Pay via UPI
                  </p>
                  <div className="bg-white p-3 rounded-xl shadow-lg mb-3">
                    <QRCodeSVG value={upiString} size={145} level="M" />
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-white font-bold text-sm">
                    Fast Ark Pvt Ltd
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-slate-400 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest mt-0.5">
                    Routing to: {centerUpi}
                  </p>
                  <p className="text-emerald-400 font-black text-lg mt-1">
                    ₹
                    {userEnteredValue.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
                      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
                    })}
                  </p>
                  <a
                    href={upiString}
                    className="mt-3 w-full py-3 px-4 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-black text-[11px] uppercase tracking-widest rounded-lg shadow-md transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                  >
                    <span>📲</span> Tap to Pay via UPI App (GPay / PhonePe)
                  </a>
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={
                  isSubmitting ||
                  isScanning ||
                  (!isExempted && slipImage !== null && !isUserVerified)
                }
                className="w-full bg-slate-900 hover:bg-blue-600 text-white font-black py-4 rounded-xl shadow-md transition disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-not-allowed tracking-widest uppercase text-xs"
              >
                {isSubmitting
                  ? "Submitting to Ledger..."
                  : !isExempted && slipImage && !isUserVerified
                  ? "Check Verification Box Above"
                  : `Submit Remittance (${form.reference_code})`}
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* RIGHT: DYNAMIC SPLIT PANE (Viewer OR Filtered Ledger) */}
          <div
            className={`lg:col-span-2 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex flex-col lg:sticky lg:top-8 lg:max-h-[calc(100vh-4rem)] ${
              mobileTab === "viewer" || mobileTab === "ledger"
                ? "block"
                : "hidden lg:flex"
            }`}
          >
            <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900 border-b border-slate-800 text-white rounded-t-2xl space-y-3 shrink-0">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-3">
                <div>
                  <h3 className="font-black tracking-widest uppercase text-xs sm:text-sm">
                    Remittance Verification &amp; Ledger History
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-bold mt-0.5">
                    Filter by Week / Month / Custom Date Range (
                    {filteredDeposits.length} Records)
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="hidden lg:flex bg-slate-800 p-1 rounded-lg">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setRightPanel("viewer");
                      setMobileTab("viewer");
                    }}
                    className={`px-4 py-2 rounded text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest transition ${
                      rightPanel === "viewer"
                        ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow"
                        : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
                    }`}
                  >
                    📄 Document Viewer
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setRightPanel("ledger");
                      setMobileTab("ledger");
                    }}
                    className={`px-4 py-2 rounded text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest transition ${
                      rightPanel === "ledger"
                        ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow"
                        : "text-slate-400 hover:text-white"
                    }`}
                  >
                    📖 Ledger History ({filteredDeposits.length})
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-2 border-t border-slate-800 text-xs">
                <div>
                  <label className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase text-indigo-400 block mb-1">
                    Period Filter (Week / Month / Custom)
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={datePreset}
                    onChange={(e) =>
                      handlePresetChange(e.target.value as DatePresetMode)
                    }
                    className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-white font-black text-xs p-2 rounded-lg outline-none"
                  >
                    <option value="today">Today</option>
                    <option value="yesterday">Yesterday</option>
                    <option value="current_week">Current Week</option>
                    <option value="current_month">Current Month</option>
                    <option value="previous_month">Previous Month</option>
                    <option value="all">All Time</option>
                    <option value="custom">Custom Range</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase text-slate-400 block mb-1">
                    From ({formatToDDMMYYYY(filterFromDate)})
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={filterFromDate}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setDatePreset("custom");
                      setFilterFromDate(e.target.value);
                    }}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-white font-bold text-xs p-2 rounded-lg outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase text-slate-400 block mb-1">
                    To ({formatToDDMMYYYY(filterToDate)})
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="date"
                    value={filterToDate}
                    max={getISTDateString(0)}
                    onChange={(e) => {
                      setDatePreset("custom");
                      setFilterToDate(e.target.value);
                    }}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 text-white font-bold text-xs p-2 rounded-lg outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto bg-slate-50">
              {rightPanel === "viewer" ? (
                <div className="p-5 flex flex-col items-center justify-start min-h-full">
                  {imagePreview ? (
                    <div className="w-full flex flex-col items-center space-y-3">
                      <div className="w-full flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-900 text-white px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg">
                        <span className="text-xs font-black truncate">
                          {slipImage?.name || "Uploaded Receipt"}
                        </span>
                        <a
                          href={imagePreview}
                          target="_blank"
                          rel="noreferrer"
