          >
            🆔 Aadhaar Kendra Hub
          </Link>
          <Link
            href="/partner/helpdesk"
            className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white shrink-0 transition"
          >
            🎧 Helpdesk
          </Link>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="p-4 md:p-8 max-w-[1400px] mx-auto space-y-6">
        {!hasUploadedDocs ? (
          <button
            onClick={() => setIsDocModalOpen(true)}
            className="w-full bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-700 text-white font-black py-4 px-6 rounded-xl shadow-lg border-2 border-red-800 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4 transition transform hover:-translate-y-1 animate-in fade-in"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-left">
              <span className="text-3xl md:text-4xl animate-pulse">🚨</span>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg md:text-xl uppercase tracking-widest leading-tight">
                  Action Required: Upload Compliance Docs
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-red-200 mt-1">
                  Your account requires mandatory documentation to maintain
                  active status.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <span className="bg-white text-red-700 font-black px-5 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm uppercase tracking-widest shrink-0 shadow-sm w-full md:w-auto text-center">
              Tap to Upload ↗
            </span>
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 p-4 rounded-xl shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <span className="text-2xl">✅</span>
              <p className="font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-sm">
                Compliance Documents Secured
              </p>
            </div>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold opacity-70 bg-emerald-200 px-2 py-1 rounded">
              Locked &amp; Validated
            </span>
          </div>
        )}

        {messages.filter((m) => !m.is_read).length > 0 && (
          <div className="bg-red-50 border-l-4 border-red-600 p-5 rounded-r-xl shadow-sm animate-in fade-in">
            <h3 className="font-black text-red-800 flex items-center gap-2 text-lg">
              <span className="text-2xl">⚠️</span> Unread Corporate Notices
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-red-700">
              You must acknowledge these notices in your Official Inbox.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {lifetimePendingBalance >= 1000 && (
          <div className="bg-red-600 text-white p-4 rounded-xl shadow-lg border-2 border-red-800 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between animate-pulse">
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-black text-lg uppercase tracking-widest flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-2xl">🚨</span> Priority Remittance Required
              </h3>
              <p className="font-bold text-sm mt-1">
                Your pending cash balance has exceeded the ₹1,000 limit. Settle
                your ledger immediately.
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-4 md:mt-0 text-left md:text-right bg-red-800/50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-red-700">
              <p className="text-[10px] uppercase font-black text-red-300 tracking-widest">
                Pending Amount
              </p>
              <p className="text-3xl font-black">
                ₹{lifetimePendingBalance.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <DashboardQuickActions hasSubmittedToday={hasSubmittedToday} />

        <div
          onClick={() => routeTo("/partner/helpdesk")}
          className="bg-slate-900 rounded-xl shadow-lg border border-slate-800 p-6 md:p-8 flex flex-col md:flex-row items-start md:items-center justify-between gap-6 cursor-pointer hover:border-blue-500 hover:shadow-xl transition-all group animate-in fade-in"
        >
          <div className="flex items-start md:items-center gap-4 md:gap-6">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 md:w-16 md:h-16 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-3xl shrink-0 group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform shadow-inner">
              🎧
            </div>
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-black text-white flex items-center gap-2 tracking-wide">
                Support &amp; Escalation Helpdesk
              </h2>
              <p className="text-slate-400 font-medium mt-1 text-sm md:text-base leading-relaxed">
                Report BSNL infrastructure issues, portal downtime, or company
                queries. Track your live SLA resolutions.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <button className="w-full md:w-auto bg-blue-600 group-hover:bg-blue-500 text-white font-black px-6 py-3.5 rounded-lg shadow-md uppercase tracking-widest text-xs transition-colors shrink-0 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
            Open Helpdesk <span>&rarr;</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <InfrastructureAccordions
          partner={partner}
          partnerCtops={partnerCtops}
          virtualAccounts={virtualAccounts}
          upiIds={upiIds}
        />

        <LedgerKPIs
          displayLedger={displayLedger}
          timeFilter={timeFilter}
          datePreset={datePreset}
          fromDate={fromDate}
          toDate={toDate}
          onPresetChange={handlePresetChange}
          onCustomDateChange={handleCustomDateChange}
          lifetimePendingBalance={lifetimePendingBalance}
          telecomPendingBalance={telecomPendingBalance}
          aadhaarPendingBalance={aadhaarPendingBalance}
          aadhaarPenaltyBalance={aadhaarPenaltyBalance}
        />

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mt-8">
          <SalesHistory
            timeFilter={`${formatToDDMMYYYY(fromDate)} - ${formatToDDMMYYYY(
              toDate
            )}`}
            visibleSales={visibleSales}
            expandedSaleId={expandedSaleId}
            setExpandedSaleId={setExpandedSaleId}
            requestingEditId={requestingEditId}
            setRequestingEditId={setRequestingEditId}
            editReason={editReason}

            downloadCSV={downloadCSV}
          />

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { supabase } from "../../lib/supabase";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

export default function ResubmitApplication() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [partnerDetails, setPartnerDetails] = useState<any>(null);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    verifyRejectedStatus();
  }, []);

  const verifyRejectedStatus = async () => {
    const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
    if (!session) return router.push("/login");

    const { data, error } = await supabase
      .from('active_partners')
      .select('*')
      .eq('auth_id', session.user.id)
      .single();

    // Security Gate: Only 'Rejected' profiles can access this page
    if (error || !data || data.status !== 'Rejected') {
      router.push("/login");
      return;
    }

    setPartnerDetails(data);
    setLoading(false);
  };

  const handleResubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSubmitting(true);

    try {
      // OVERWRITE ENGINE: Update the existing row instead of creating a new one
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('active_partners')
        .update({ 
          status: 'Pending',
          // Note: If you have file upload inputs here for corrected PAN/GST docs, 
          // you would append their new storage URLs to this update payload.
        })
        .eq('id', partnerDetails.id);

      if (error) throw error;

      alert("✅ Application successfully updated and resubmitted for corporate review.");
      
      // Log them out so they wait for the new approval
      await supabase.auth.signOut();
      router.push("/login");

    } catch (err: any) {
      alert("Error resubmitting application: " + err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center">
      <div className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-red-200 border-t-red-600 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-xl w-full bg-white p-8 rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-red-200">
        <div className="text-center mb-6">
          <span className="text-5xl">⚠️</span>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900 mt-4 uppercase tracking-widest">Application Rejected</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-500 font-bold mt-2">
            Your franchise application requires corrections before corporate approval.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 p-5 rounded-lg mb-6">
          <p className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-red-800 mb-2">Corporate Remarks</p>
          <p className="font-black text-red-900 text-sm">
            {partnerDetails.rejection_reason || "Invalid documents or missing mandatory operational information. Please verify your submitted details."}
          </p>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleResubmit} className="space-y-4 border-t border-slate-200 pt-6">
          <div className="bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded border border-slate-200 mb-4">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600">
              Your email <span className="text-slate-900 font-black">{partnerDetails.email}</span> is currently locked to this application. Clicking resubmit will place your existing profile back into the corporate queue.
            </p>
          </div>
          
          <button 
            type="submit" 
            disabled={isSubmitting}
            className="w-full bg-slate-900 text-white font-black py-4 rounded-lg shadow-md hover:bg-red-600 transition disabled:opacity-50 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm"
          >
            {isSubmitting ? "Processing Resubmission..." : "Resubmit Application"}
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { supabase } from "../../lib/supabase";

export default function PartnerStockRequest() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [partner, setPartner] = useState<any>(null);
  const [requests, setRequests] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // Auto-detect OCSC Rules
  const [isOCSC, setIsOCSC] = useState(false);

  const [form, setForm] = useState({
    stock_type: "CBP",
    ctop_no: "",
    qty: "",
    amount: "",
    commission_percent: "3.5",
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchPartnerAndRequests();
  }, []);

  const fetchPartnerAndRequests = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      if (!session) {
        router.push("/partner/login");
        return;
      }

      // Secure fetch using ilike and maybeSingle
      const { data: partnerData, error: partnerError } = await supabase
        .from("active_partners")
        .select("id, partner_name, role, center_id, locations(center_name)")
        .ilike("email", session.user.email || "")
        .maybeSingle();

      if (partnerError) throw partnerError;
      if (!partnerData) throw new Error("Database Desync: Your partner profile could not be loaded.");
      
      setPartner(partnerData);

      // OCSC Strict Override Check
      if (partnerData.role?.toUpperCase().includes('OCSC')) {
        setIsOCSC(true);
      }

      const { data: reqData, error: reqError } = await supabase
        .from("stock_requests")
        .select("*")
        .eq("partner_id", partnerData.id)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false });

      if (reqError) throw reqError;
      setRequests(reqData || []);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error("Error loading stock data:", err.message);
      if (err.message.includes("Desync")) {
        alert(err.message);
      }
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);

    const qtyNum = parseInt(form.qty, 10);
    
    // OCSC Strict Overrides force Amount to 0. 
    const amountNum = (!isOCSC && form.amount) ? parseFloat(form.amount) : 0;
    
    // [CRITICAL FIX]: Reverted Commission to `null` to safely bypass the CHECK constraint
    const commNum = (!isOCSC && form.stock_type === "CTOP" && form.commission_percent) ? parseFloat(form.commission_percent) : null;

    if (qtyNum <= 0 || isNaN(qtyNum)) {
      alert("Quantity must be greater than zero.");
      setSubmitting(false);
      return;
    }

    if (amountNum < 0 || isNaN(amountNum)) {
      alert("Amount cannot be negative.");
      setSubmitting(false);
      return;
    }

    if (form.stock_type === "CTOP") {
      if (form.ctop_no.length !== 10) {
        alert("CTOP Number must be exactly 10 digits.");
        setSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }
      // Commission validation is completely bypassed for OCSC
      if (!isOCSC && (commNum === null || commNum < 2.0 || commNum > 5.6)) {
        alert("CTOP Commission percentage must be strictly between 2.0% and 5.6%.");
        setSubmitting(false);
        return;
      }
    }

    try {
      const { error } = await supabase.from("stock_requests").insert([
        {
          partner_id: partner.id,
          center_id: partner.center_id,
          stock_type: form.stock_type,
          
          // [CRITICAL FIX]: Keep empty string "" to satisfy the NOT NULL constraint
          ctop_no: form.stock_type === "CTOP" ? form.ctop_no : "", 
          
          qty: qtyNum,
          amount: amountNum,
          
          // Will safely insert `null` for OCSC/SIM/CBP, bypassing the 2.0-5.6 Check Constraint
          commission_percent: commNum, 
          
          status: "Pending",
        },
      ]);

      if (error) throw error;

      alert("✅ Stock request submitted successfully.");
      setForm({ stock_type: "CBP", ctop_no: "", qty: "", amount: "", commission_percent: "3.5" });
      fetchPartnerAndRequests();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert("Error placing request: " + err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="w-10 h-10 border-4 border-blue-200 border-t-blue-600 rounded-full animate-spin"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const numInputClass = "w-full border border-slate-300 p-2.5 rounded-lg outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-6 md:p-8">
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto space-y-8">
        
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b pb-4">
          <div>
            <Link href="/partner/dashboard" className="text-blue-600 text-sm font-bold hover:underline">
              &larr; Back to Dashboard
            </Link>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900 mt-1">Stock Indent & Inventory Request</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm font-medium">
              Center: {partner?.locations?.center_name || "Assigned Center"} | Role: <span className="uppercase font-black text-blue-600">{partner?.role}</span>
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8">
          
          {/* Left Side: Request Form */}
          <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm h-fit sticky top-8">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-black text-slate-800 mb-4 pb-2 border-b">Raise New Stock Request</h2>
            
            {/* OCSC Warning Banner */}
            {isOCSC && (
              <div className="bg-blue-50 p-3 mb-4 rounded border border-blue-200 text-blue-800 text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-center shadow-sm">
                OCSC Override: Pure Quantity Requests Only
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-sm font-medium">
              
              <div>
                <label className="block text-slate-700 font-bold mb-1 uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest">Stock Type</label>
                <select
                  value={form.stock_type}
                  onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, stock_type: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full border border-slate-300 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 font-bold text-slate-800 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
                >
                  <option value="CBP">CBP</option>
                  <option value="CTOP">CTOP (Recharge Balance)</option>
                  <option value="SIM">SIM Inventory</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              {form.stock_type === "CTOP" && (
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-700 font-bold mb-1 uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest">CTOP Number</label>
                  <input
                    required
                    type="text"
                    maxLength={10}
                    placeholder="10-digit CTOP"
                    value={form.ctop_no}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, ctop_no: e.target.value.replace(/\D/g, "") })}
                    className="w-full border border-slate-300 p-2.5 rounded-lg outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 font-bold"
                  />
                </div>
              )}

              <div className={`grid ${isOCSC ? 'grid-cols-1' : 'grid-cols-2'} gap-4`}>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-slate-700 font-bold mb-1 uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest">Quantity</label>
                  <input
                    required
                    type="number"
                    step="1"
                    min="1"
                    placeholder="0"
                    value={form.qty}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, qty: e.target.value })}
                    className={numInputClass}
                  />
                </div>

                {/* Amount field dynamically hidden for OCSC */}
                {!isOCSC && (
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-slate-700 font-bold mb-1 uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest">Total Amount (₹)</label>
                    <input
                      type="number"
                      min="0"
                      step="0.01"
                      placeholder="0.00"
                      value={form.amount}
                      onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, amount: e.target.value })}
                      className={numInputClass}
                    />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Commission field dynamically hidden for OCSC */}
              {form.stock_type === "CTOP" && !isOCSC && (
                <div className="bg-amber-50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-amber-200">
                  <label className="block text-amber-900 font-bold mb-1 uppercase text-[10px] tracking-widest">Commission % (2.0 - 5.6%)</label>
                  <input
                    required
                    type="number"
                    step="0.1"
                    min="2.0"
                    max="5.6"
                    value={form.commission_percent}
                    onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, commission_percent: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full border border-amber-300 p-2.5 rounded text-amber-900 font-black outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none"
                  />
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={submitting}
                className="w-full py-4 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-black rounded-xl transition shadow-md disabled:bg-slate-400 mt-4"
              >
                {submitting ? "Submitting..." : "Send Stock Request"}
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          {/* Right Side: Requisition History Table */}
          <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden h-fit">
            <div className="p-4 border-b bg-slate-50 flex justify-between items-center">
              <h2 className="font-black text-slate-800">Stock Requisition History</h2>
              <button
                onClick={fetchPartnerAndRequests}
                className="text-xs bg-white border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md font-bold hover:bg-slate-100 transition shadow-sm"
              >
                ↻ Refresh
              </button>
            </div>
            
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-left text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest border-b">
                    <th className="p-4 font-bold">Date</th>
                    <th className="p-4 font-bold">Details</th>
                    <th className="p-4 font-bold">Qty</th>
                    <th className="p-4 font-bold">Amount</th>
                    <th className="p-4 font-bold text-right">Status</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {requests.length === 0 ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={5} className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400 font-medium">
                        No previous stock requests found.
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : (
                    requests.map((req) => (
                      <tr key={req.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition">
                        <td className="p-4 text-slate-500 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
                          {new Date(req.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-4">
                          <p className="font-black text-blue-700">{req.stock_type}</p>
                          {req.stock_type === "CTOP" && (
                            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-bold mt-0.5">
                              No: {req.ctop_no} {req.commission_percent ? <span className="text-amber-600 ml-1">({req.commission_percent}%)</span> : null}
                            </p>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-4 font-black text-slate-800 text-lg">{req.qty}</td>
                        <td className="p-4 font-bold text-slate-600">
                          {req.amount > 0 ? `₹${Number(req.amount).toLocaleString('en-IN')}` : <span className="text-slate-500 uppercase text-[9px] bg-slate-200 px-2 py-1 rounded border border-slate-300 font-black tracking-widest">Pure Qty</span>}
                        </td>
                        <td className="p-4 text-right">
                          <span
                            className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest ${
                              req.status === "Approved"
                                ? "bg-green-100 text-green-800"
                                : req.status === "Dispatched"
                                ? "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800"
                                : req.status === "Rejected"
                                ? "bg-red-100 text-red-800"
                                : "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800"
                            }`}
                          >
                            {req.status}
                          </span>
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>
          
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

const getMondayToSundayWindow = (
  dateStr: string
): { monday: string; sunday: string } => {
  const base = dateStr ? new Date(`${dateStr}T00:00:00Z`) : new Date();
  const day = base.getUTCDay();
  const diffToMonday = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day;

  const mon = new Date(base);
  mon.setUTCDate(base.getUTCDate() + diffToMonday);

  const sun = new Date(mon);
  sun.setUTCDate(mon.getUTCDate() + 6);

  return {
    monday: mon.toISOString().split("T")[0],
    sunday: sun.toISOString().split("T")[0],
  };
};

    useState<string>("");
  const [slipFile, setSlipFile] = useState<File | null>(null);

  const [isScanningSlip, setIsScanningSlip] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [scanProgress, setScanProgress] = useState<number>(0);
  const [ocrSummary, setOcrSummary] = useState<{
    platform: string | null;

    date: string | null;
  }>({
    platform: null,

    transactionId: null,

  const [confirmDepositCheck, setConfirmDepositCheck] =
    useState<boolean>(false);

  );

  const [confirmWeeklyCheck, setConfirmWeeklyCheck] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSubmittingWeekly, setIsSubmittingWeekly] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Global & Menu 5: 7-Option Date Preset + Download Confirmation Gate
  const [datePreset, setDatePreset] = useState<DatePresetMode>("current_month");
  const [filterFromDate, setFilterFromDate] = useState<string>(
    () => getDateRangeFromPreset("current_month").start
  );
  const [filterToDate, setFilterToDate] = useState<string>(
    () => getDateRangeFromPreset("current_month").end
  );
  const [fileModeFilter, setFileModeFilter] = useState<
    "ALL" | "WITH_FILES" | "WITHOUT_FILES"
  >("ALL");
  const [confirmDownloadCheck, setConfirmDownloadCheck] =
    useState<boolean>(false);

  // Menu 6: Credentials Form State
  const [upgradeForm, setUpgradeForm] = useState({
    operator_id: "",
    station_id: "",
    nseit_no: "",
  });

  const handleNumericWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
  };

  const handleNumericKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (["ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "e", "E", "+", "-"].includes(e.key)) {
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  };

  const showBanner = (type: "success" | "error" | "info", text: string) => {
    setStatusBanner({ type, text });
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "smooth" });
  };

  const handlePresetChange = (mode: DatePresetMode) => {
    setDatePreset(mode);
    setConfirmDownloadCheck(false);
    if (mode !== "custom") {
      const range = getDateRangeFromPreset(mode);
      setFilterFromDate(range.start);
      setFilterToDate(range.end);
    }
  };

  const handleWeekDateSelection = (pickedDate: string) => {
    if (!pickedDate) return;
    const { monday, sunday } = getMondayToSundayWindow(pickedDate);
    setWeekStart(monday);
    setWeekEnd(sunday);
    setWeeklyPreview(null);
    setWeeklyError("");
    setConfirmWeeklyCheck(false);
  };

  const handleSwitchRemittanceTrack = (track: "UPI_QR" | "BANK_TRANSFER") => {
    setRemittanceTrack(track);
    setSlipFile(null);
    if (slipPreviewUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(slipPreviewUrl);
    setSlipPreviewUrl(null);
    setIsSlipExempted(false);

    setOcrSummary({
      platform: null,
      amount: null,

  const initializeAadhaarPortal = async () => {
    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      if (!session) return router.push("/partner/login");

      const { data: pData } = await supabase
        .from("active_partners")
        .select("*, locations(*)")
        .ilike("email", session.user.email || "")
        .maybeSingle();

      if (!pData) return router.push("/partner/login");
      setPartner(pData);

      const { data: upgData } = await supabase
        .from("partner_upgrade_requests")
        .select("*")
        .eq("partner_id", pData.id)
        .order("created_at", { ascending: false })
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle();

      setLatestUpgradeReq(upgData || null);

      if (upgData) {
        setUpgradeForm({
          operator_id:
            upgData.requested_operator_id || pData.aadhaar_operator_id || "",
          station_id:
            upgData.requested_station_id || pData.aadhaar_station_id || "",
          nseit_no: upgData.nseit_cert_no || "",
        });
      } else if (pData.aadhaar_operator_id || pData.aadhaar_station_id) {
        setUpgradeForm((prev) => ({
          ...prev,
          operator_id: pData.aadhaar_operator_id || "",
          station_id: pData.aadhaar_station_id || "",
        }));
      }

      const authorized = Boolean(
        pData.role_aadhaar &&
          pData.aadhaar_operator_id &&
          pData.aadhaar_station_id &&
          pData.locations?.role_aadhaar
      );

      if (!authorized) {
        setActiveMenu("upgrade");
        setLoading(false);
        return;
      }

      await syncAadhaarLatePenalties(supabase, pData.id);

      const [tariffRes, dailyRes, weeklyRes, depositsRes, penaltyRes, upiRes] =
        await Promise.all([
          supabase
            .from("aadhaar_tariff_history")
            .select("*")
            .lte("effective_from", reportDate)
            .or(`effective_to.is.null,effective_to.gte.${reportDate}`)
            .order("effective_from", { ascending: false })
            .limit(1)
            .maybeSingle(),
          supabase
            .from("aadhaar_daily_reports")
            .select("*")
            .eq("partner_id", pData.id)
            .order("report_date", { ascending: false }),
          supabase
            .from("aadhaar_weekly_reports")
            .select("*")
            .eq("partner_id", pData.id)
            .order("end_date", { ascending: false }),
          supabase
            .from("partner_deposits")
            .select("*")
            .eq("partner_id", pData.id)
            .order("deposit_date", { ascending: false }),
          supabase
            .from("aadhaar_penalty_logs")
            .select("*")
            .eq("partner_id", pData.id)
            .eq("is_settled", false)
            .eq("is_waived", false),
          pData.center_id
            ? supabase
                .from("upi_ids")
                .select("upi_id")
                .eq("assigned_location_id", pData.center_id)
                .eq("is_active", true)
                .maybeSingle()
            : Promise.resolve({ data: null }),
        ]);

      setActiveTariff(
        tariffRes.data || {
          new_enrolment_fee: 0,
          mbu_free_fee: 0,
          mbu_chargeable_fee: 125,
          demographic_fee: 75,
          biometric_fee: 125,

          demo_max_threshold: 100,
          bio_min_threshold: 100,
          gst_percent: 18,
          daily_late_penalty: 100,
        }
      );

      const dList = dailyRes.data || [];
      const allDeps = depositsRes.data || [];
      const aDeps = allDeps.filter(
        (d: any) =>
          d.deposit_stream === "AADHAAR" ||
          String(d.reference_no || "")
            .toUpperCase()
            .startsWith("AADHAAR_")
      );
      const pList = (penaltyRes.data || []).filter((p: any) => !p.is_waived);

      setDailyReports(dList);
      setWeeklyReports(weeklyRes.data || []);
      setAadhaarDeposits(aDeps);
      setPenalties(pList);
      if (upiRes.data?.upi_id) setCenterUpi(upiRes.data.upi_id);

      // Total Collection minus Total Deposit = Balance Payable
      const totalCollected = dList.reduce(
        (sum: number, r: any) => sum + Number(r.total_cash_collected || 0),
        0
      );
      const totalDeposited = aDeps
        .filter((d: any) => d.status !== "Discrepancy")
        .reduce(
          (sum: number, d: any) => sum + Number(d.deposit_amount || 0),
          0
        );
      const penSum = pList.reduce(
        (sum: number, p: any) => sum + Number(p.penalty_amount || 0),
        0
      );

      const netPayable = Math.max(
        0,
        totalCollected + penSum - totalDeposited
      );
      if (netPayable > 0) {
        setQrPayAmount(netPayable.toFixed(2));
      } else {
        setQrPayAmount("");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      await reportAndMaskError(err, "PARTNER_AADHAAR_INIT");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const isAadhaarAuthorized = Boolean(
    partner?.role_aadhaar &&
      partner?.aadhaar_operator_id &&
      partner?.aadhaar_station_id &&
      partner?.locations?.role_aadhaar
  );

  const isCredentialsLocked =
    isAadhaarAuthorized || latestUpgradeReq?.status === "Approved";
  const existingDailyForSelectedDate = dailyReports.find(
    (r) => r.report_date === reportDate
  );
  const existingWeeklyForSelectedWindow = weeklyReports.find(
    (w) => w.start_date === weekStart && w.end_date === weekEnd
  );

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadTariffForDate = async () => {
      if (!reportDate || !isAadhaarAuthorized) return;
      const { data } = await supabase
        .from("aadhaar_tariff_history")
        .select("*")
        .lte("effective_from", reportDate)
        .or(`effective_to.is.null,effective_to.gte.${reportDate}`)
        .order("effective_from", { ascending: false })
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (data) setActiveTariff(data);
    };
    loadTariffForDate();
  }, [reportDate, isAadhaarAuthorized]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const runDualValidation = async () => {
      if (
        !csvFile ||
        !htmlFile ||
        isManualMode ||
        !isAadhaarAuthorized ||
        existingDailyForSelectedDate
      )
        return;
      setParseError("");
      setParsedPreview(null);
      setConfirmDailyCheck(false);

      try {
        const result = await parseAndValidateDualFiles(
          csvFile,
          htmlFile,
          "DAILY",
          { reportDate },
          partner?.aadhaar_operator_id || "",
          partner?.aadhaar_station_id || "",
          activeTariff
        );
        setParsedPreview(result);
      } catch (err: any) {
        const safeErr = await reportAndMaskError(err, "PARTNER_DAILY_PARSE", {
          id: partner?.id,
          email: partner?.email,
        });
        setParseError(safeErr);
      }
    };
    runDualValidation();
  }, [
    csvFile,
    htmlFile,
    reportDate,
    isManualMode,
    isAadhaarAuthorized,
    existingDailyForSelectedDate,
  ]);

  const isZeroExemption =
    isManualMode &&
    exemptionReason !== "" &&
    exemptionReason !== "ECMP_CRASH_MANUAL";
  const manualCashTotal = isZeroExemption
    ? 0
    : manualCounts.cat3 * Number(activeTariff?.mbu_chargeable_fee || 125) +
      manualCounts.cat4 * Number(activeTariff?.demographic_fee || 75) +
      manualCounts.cat5 * Number(activeTariff?.biometric_fee || 125);
  const manualBaseTotal = Number(
    (
      manualCashTotal /
      (1 + Number(activeTariff?.gst_percent || 18) / 100)
    ).toFixed(2)
  );
  const manualGstTotal = Number((manualCashTotal - manualBaseTotal).toFixed(2));

  const handleDailySubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isAadhaarAuthorized) {
      showBanner(
        "error",
        "[ERR-SEC-401] Your Aadhaar credentials and Center mapping must be approved by Corporate Admin before uploading reports."
      );
      setActiveMenu("upgrade");
      return;
    }
    if (reportDate > getISTDateString(0)) {
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Validation Error: You cannot submit a Daily Aadhaar Report for a future date."
      );
    }
    if (existingDailyForSelectedDate) {
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        `[ERR-DUP-205] A Daily Report for ${formatToDDMMYYYY(
          reportDate
        )} has already been submitted and is locked.`
      );
    }
    if (!confirmDailyCheck) {
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Please check the mandatory confirmation box before submitting."
      );
    }

    setIsSubmittingDaily(true);
    setStatusBanner(null);
    try {
      let csvPath = null;
      let htmlPath = null;

      if (!isManualMode) {
        if (!csvFile || !htmlFile || !parsedPreview) {
          throw new Error("Both matching CSV and HTML files are mandatory.");
        }
        const safeOp = (partner.aadhaar_operator_id || "OP").replace(
          /[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g,
          "_"
        );
        csvPath = `DAILY_${safeOp}_${reportDate}_${Date.now()}.csv`;
        htmlPath = `DAILY_${safeOp}_${reportDate}_${Date.now()}.html`;

        const [up1, up2] = await Promise.all([
          supabase.storage.from("aadhaar-reports").upload(csvPath, csvFile),
          supabase.storage.from("aadhaar-reports").upload(htmlPath, htmlFile),
        ]);
        if (up1.error) throw up1.error;
        if (up2.error) throw up2.error;
      } else {
        if (!exemptionReason)
          throw new Error("Please select a valid reason from the dropdown.");
      }

      const finalCash = isManualMode
        ? manualCashTotal
        : parsedPreview.total_cash_collected;
      const payload = {
        partner_id: partner.id,
        center_id: partner.center_id,
        report_date: reportDate,
        operator_id: isManualMode
          ? partner.aadhaar_operator_id
          : parsedPreview.operator_id,
        station_id: isManualMode
          ? partner.aadhaar_station_id
          : parsedPreview.station_id,
        cat1_new_qty: isManualMode
          ? isZeroExemption
            ? 0
            : manualCounts.cat1
          : parsedPreview.cat1_new_qty,
        cat2_mbu_free_qty: isManualMode
          ? isZeroExemption
            ? 0
            : manualCounts.cat2
          : parsedPreview.cat2_mbu_free_qty,
        cat3_mbu_chargeable_qty: isManualMode
          ? isZeroExemption
            ? 0
            : manualCounts.cat3
          : parsedPreview.cat3_mbu_chargeable_qty,
        cat4_demographic_qty: isManualMode
          ? isZeroExemption
            ? 0
            : manualCounts.cat4
          : parsedPreview.cat4_demographic_qty,
        cat5_biometric_qty: isManualMode
          ? isZeroExemption
            ? 0
            : manualCounts.cat5
          : parsedPreview.cat5_biometric_qty,
        total_packets_qty: isManualMode
          ? isZeroExemption
            ? 0
            : manualCounts.cat1 +
              manualCounts.cat2 +
              manualCounts.cat3 +
              manualCounts.cat4 +
              manualCounts.cat5
          : parsedPreview.total_packets_qty,
        completed_qty: isManualMode ? 0 : parsedPreview.completed_qty,
        inprocess_qty: isManualMode ? 0 : parsedPreview.inprocess_qty,
        rejected_qty: isManualMode ? 0 : parsedPreview.rejected_qty,
        base_amount: isManualMode ? manualBaseTotal : parsedPreview.base_amount,
        gst_amount: isManualMode ? manualGstTotal : parsedPreview.gst_amount,
        total_cash_collected: finalCash,
        has_files: !isManualMode,
        csv_file_url: csvPath,
        html_file_url: htmlPath,
        exemption_reason: isManualMode ? exemptionReason : null,
        deposit_status: finalCash > 0 ? "Pending Deposit" : "Settled",
      };

      const { data: insertedRow, error } = await supabase
        .from("aadhaar_daily_reports")
        .insert([payload])
        .select()
        .maybeSingle();
      if (error) throw error;

      await logSystemTelemetry({
        actorId: partner.id,
        actorEmail: partner.email,
        module: "PARTNER_AADHAAR_DAILY",
        actionCode: isManualMode ? "DAILY_MANUAL_SUBMIT" : "DAILY_FILE_SUBMIT",
        referenceId: insertedRow?.id || reportDate,
        metadata: {
          report_date: reportDate,
          station_id: payload.station_id,
          packets: payload.total_packets_qty,
          cash: finalCash,
          exemption: payload.exemption_reason,
        },
      });

      await initializeAadhaarPortal();
      setCsvFile(null);
      setHtmlFile(null);
      setParsedPreview(null);
      setConfirmDailyCheck(false);

      if (finalCash > 0) {
        showBanner(
          "success",
          `✅ Daily Report for ${formatToDDMMYYYY(
            reportDate
          )} saved! Instant Deposit QR unlocked for ₹${finalCash.toLocaleString(
            "en-IN"
          )}.`
        );
        setActiveMenu("deposit");
      } else {
        showBanner(
          "success",
          `✅ Zero-Collection Daily Report for ${formatToDDMMYYYY(
            reportDate
          )} logged. No deposit required.`
        );
        setActiveMenu("overview");
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      const safeMsg = await reportAndMaskError(err, "PARTNER_AADHAAR_DAILY", {
        id: partner?.id,
        email: partner?.email,
      });
      showBanner("error", safeMsg);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingDaily(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSendDailyCorrectionRequest = async (reportId: string) => {
    if (correctionReasonText.trim().length < 5) {
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Please enter a detailed reason (min 5 characters) for the Admin correction request."
      );
    }
    setIsSendingCorrectionReq(true);
    try {
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from("aadhaar_daily_reports")
        .update({
          edit_request_status: "Pending",
          edit_request_reason: correctionReasonText.trim(),
        })
        .eq("id", reportId);
      if (error) throw error;

      await logSystemTelemetry({
        actorId: partner.id,
        actorEmail: partner.email,
        module: "PARTNER_AADHAAR_DAILY",
        actionCode: "CORRECTION_REQUESTED",
        referenceId: reportId,
        metadata: { reason: correctionReasonText.trim() },
      });

      showBanner(
        "success",
        "✅ Correction request sent to Back-Office Audit Hub."
      );
      setRequestingCorrectionId(null);
      setCorrectionReasonText("");
      await initializeAadhaarPortal();
    } catch (err: any) {
      const safeMsg = await reportAndMaskError(
        err,
        "PARTNER_AADHAAR_CORRECTION",
        {
          id: partner?.id,
          email: partner?.email,
        }
      );
      showBanner("error", safeMsg);
    } finally {
      setIsSendingCorrectionReq(false);
    }
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // UPGRADED OCR SLIP UPLOAD (USES `scanPaymentReceiptOCR` WITH CANVAS PRE-PROCESSOR)
  // =========================================================================
  const handleSlipUploadOCR = async (
    e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>
  ) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setSlipFile(file);
    if (slipPreviewUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(slipPreviewUrl);
    setSlipPreviewUrl(URL.createObjectURL(file));
    setConfirmDepositCheck(false);

    if (
      file.type === "application/pdf" ||
      file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf")
    ) {
      setOcrSummary({
        platform: "PDF Receipt Attached",
        amount: null,
        utr: null,
        transactionId: null,
        date: null,
      });
      return;
    }

    setIsScanningSlip(true);
    setScanProgress(0);
    try {
      const ocrResult = await scanPaymentReceiptOCR(file, "auto", (pct) =>
        setScanProgress(pct)
      );

      setOcrSummary({
        platform: ocrResult.platform,
        amount: ocrResult.amount,
        utr: ocrResult.utr,
        transactionId: ocrResult.transactionId,
        date: ocrResult.date,
      });

      const effectiveDate = ocrResult.date || depositForm.date;
      setDepositForm((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        amount:
          ocrResult.amount !== null ? String(ocrResult.amount) : prev.amount,
        utr: ocrResult.utr ? ocrResult.utr : prev.utr,
        transaction_id: ocrResult.transactionId
          ? ocrResult.transactionId
          : ocrResult.utr || prev.transaction_id,
        date: effectiveDate,
        reference_code: generateSystemReferenceCode("FA-ADH", effectiveDate),
        method:
          remittanceTrack === "UPI_QR"
            ? "UPI"
            : ocrResult.method === "UPI"
            ? prev.method
            : ocrResult.method,
      }));
    } catch (err) {
      const safeMsg = await reportAndMaskError(err, "PARTNER_AADHAAR_OCR", {
        id: partner?.id,
        email: partner?.email,
      });
      showBanner("info", safeMsg);
    } finally {
      setIsScanningSlip(false);
    }
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // SUBMIT INSTANT DEPOSIT (WITH UNIQUE UTR, TXN ID, REF CODE & FIFO PENALTY SETTLEMENT)
  // =========================================================================
  const handleInstantDepositSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const amt = parseFloat(depositForm.amount) || 0;
    if (amt <= 0)
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Collected / Remitted Amount must be greater than zero. Upload your receipt to auto-read via OCR or enter the receipt amount."
      );
    if (!depositForm.date)
      return showBanner("error", "Please select the Deposit Date.");

    const cleanUtr = depositForm.utr
      .trim()
      .replace(/^AADHAAR_/i, "")
      .replace(/\s+/g, "")
      .toUpperCase();
    const cleanTxnId = (depositForm.transaction_id || cleanUtr)
      .trim()
      .toUpperCase();
    const finalRefCode =
      depositForm.reference_code ||
      generateSystemReferenceCode("FA-ADH", depositForm.date);

    if (cleanUtr.length < 4)
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Please enter a valid Unique UTR / Reference Number (min 4 characters)."
      );

    if (!isSlipExempted && !slipFile) {
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Please upload the payment screenshot / bank slip, or select the Missing Slip Exemption option."
      );
    }
    if (isSlipExempted && !slipExemptionCategory) {
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Please select a reason from the Missing Slip dropdown."
      );
    }
    if (
      isSlipExempted &&
      slipExemptionCategory === "Other" &&
      slipExemptionOtherText.trim().length < 4
    ) {
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Please type a detailed reason for 'Other' missing deposit slip."
      );
    }
    if (!confirmDepositCheck)
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "Please check the verification box before submitting."
      );

    setIsSubmittingDeposit(true);
    try {
      // Pre-flight duplicate UTR check across all deposits
      const { data: dupUtr } = await supabase
        .from("partner_deposits")
        .select("id, reference_code")
        .or(
          `utr_number.eq.${cleanUtr},reference_no.eq.${cleanUtr},reference_no.eq.AADHAAR_${cleanUtr}`
        )
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle();

      if (dupUtr) {
        setIsSubmittingDeposit(false);
        return showBanner(
          "error",
          `[ERR-DUP-205] Duplicate UTR Blocked: UTR '${cleanUtr}' has already been recorded under Reference Code ${
            dupUtr.reference_code || "EXISTING"
          }.`
        );
      }

      let slipFileName: string | null = null;
      if (!isSlipExempted && slipFile) {
        const ext = slipFile.name.split(".").pop();
        slipFileName = `aadhaar-slip-${partner.id}-${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
        const { error: upErr } = await supabase.storage
          .from("deposit-slips")
          .upload(slipFileName, slipFile);
        if (upErr) throw upErr;
      }

      const finalExemptionReason = isSlipExempted
        ? slipExemptionCategory === "Other"
          ? `OTHER: ${slipExemptionOtherText.trim()}`
          : slipExemptionCategory
        : null;

      const baseDepositPayload: any = {
        partner_id: partner.id,
        center_id: partner.center_id,
        deposit_amount: amt,
        deposit_method:
          remittanceTrack === "UPI_QR" ? "UPI" : depositForm.method,
        reference_no: `AADHAAR_${cleanUtr}`,
        deposit_date: depositForm.date,
        deposit_slip_url: slipFileName,
        is_exempted: isSlipExempted,
        exemption_reason: finalExemptionReason,
        status: "Pending",
      };

      // Insert with the 3-Identifier columns (fallback gracefully if SQL migration hasn't run yet)
      let depRow: any = null;
      const { data: richRow, error: richErr } = await supabase
        .from("partner_deposits")
        .insert([
          {
            ...baseDepositPayload,
            deposit_stream: "AADHAAR",
            utr_number: cleanUtr,
            transaction_id: cleanTxnId,
            reference_code: finalRefCode,
          },
        ])
        .select()
        .single();

      if (richErr && richErr.code === "42703") {
        const { data: fallbackRow, error: fbErr } = await supabase
          .from("partner_deposits")
          .insert([baseDepositPayload])
          .select()
          .single();
        if (fbErr) throw fbErr;
        depRow = fallbackRow;
      } else if (richErr) {
        throw richErr;
      } else {
        depRow = richRow;
      }

      // FIFO Settlement Allocation: Only mark daily reports & penalties as settled up to the cumulative deposited amount
      const totalValidDepositedSoFar =
        aadhaarDeposits
          .filter((d) => d.status !== "Discrepancy")
          .reduce((s, d) => s + Number(d.deposit_amount || 0), 0) + amt;

      const chronologicalReports = [...dailyReports].sort((a, b) =>
        a.report_date.localeCompare(b.report_date)
      );

      let runningAllocated = 0;
      const reportIdsToMarkSubmitted: string[] = [];

      for (const rep of chronologicalReports) {
        const repCash = Number(rep.total_cash_collected || 0);
        if (repCash <= 0) continue;
        if (runningAllocated + repCash <= totalValidDepositedSoFar) {
          runningAllocated += repCash;
          if (rep.deposit_status === "Pending Deposit") {
            reportIdsToMarkSubmitted.push(rep.id);
          }
        } else {
          break;
        }
      }

      if (reportIdsToMarkSubmitted.length > 0) {
        await supabase
          .from("aadhaar_daily_reports")
          .update({
            deposit_status: "Deposit Submitted",
            deposit_id: depRow.id,
          })
          .in("id", reportIdsToMarkSubmitted);
      }

      // FIFO Penalty Settlement: Settle active non-waived penalties chronologically as far as remaining deposit allows
      let remainingAfterReports = totalValidDepositedSoFar - runningAllocated;
      const chronologicalPenalties = [...penalties]
        .filter((p) => !p.is_settled && !p.is_waived)
        .sort((a, b) =>
          String(a.penalty_for_date || "").localeCompare(
            String(b.penalty_for_date || "")
          )
        );

      const penaltyIdsToSettle: string[] = [];
      for (const pen of chronologicalPenalties) {
        const penAmt = Number(pen.penalty_amount || 0);
        if (penAmt <= 0) continue;
        if (remainingAfterReports >= penAmt) {
          remainingAfterReports -= penAmt;
          penaltyIdsToSettle.push(pen.id);
        } else {
          break;
        }
      }

      if (penaltyIdsToSettle.length > 0) {
        await supabase
          .from("aadhaar_penalty_logs")
          .update({ is_settled: true, settled_by_deposit_id: depRow.id })
          .in("id", penaltyIdsToSettle);
      }

      await logSystemTelemetry({
        actorId: partner.id,
        actorEmail: partner.email,
        module: "PARTNER_AADHAAR_DEPOSIT",
        actionCode: "DEPOSIT_SUBMITTED",
        referenceId: finalRefCode,
        metadata: {
          amount: amt,
          utr: cleanUtr,
          transaction_id: cleanTxnId,
          reference_code: finalRefCode,
          method: baseDepositPayload.deposit_method,
        },
      });

      showBanner(
        "success",
        `✅ Remittance of ₹${amt.toLocaleString(
          "en-IN"
        )} recorded! Ref Code: ${finalRefCode} | UTR: ${cleanUtr}`
      );
      setSlipFile(null);
      if (slipPreviewUrl) URL.revokeObjectURL(slipPreviewUrl);
      setSlipPreviewUrl(null);
      setIsSlipExempted(false);
      setSlipExemptionCategory("");
      setSlipExemptionOtherText("");
      setOcrSummary({
        platform: null,
        amount: null,
        utr: null,
        transactionId: null,
        date: null,
      });
      setDepositForm((prev) => ({
        ...prev,
        amount: "",
        utr: "",
        transaction_id: "",
        reference_code: generateSystemReferenceCode(
          "FA-ADH",
          getISTDateString(0)
        ),
      }));
      setConfirmDepositCheck(false);
      await initializeAadhaarPortal();
      setActiveMenu("history");
    } catch (err: any) {
      const safeMsg = await reportAndMaskError(
        err,
        "PARTNER_AADHAAR_DEPOSIT",
        {
          id: partner?.id,
          email: partner?.email,
        }
      );
      showBanner("error", safeMsg);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingDeposit(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const runWeeklyParse = async () => {
      if (
        !weekCsv ||
        !weekHtml ||
        !isAadhaarAuthorized ||
        existingWeeklyForSelectedWindow
      )
        return;
      setWeeklyError("");
      setWeeklyPreview(null);
      try {
        const res = await parseAndValidateDualFiles(
          weekCsv,
          weekHtml,
          "WEEKLY",
          { startDate: weekStart, endDate: weekEnd },
          partner?.aadhaar_operator_id || "",
          partner?.aadhaar_station_id || "",
          activeTariff
        );
        setWeeklyPreview(res);
      } catch (err: any) {
        const safeMsg = await reportAndMaskError(err, "PARTNER_WEEKLY_PARSE", {
          id: partner?.id,
          email: partner?.email,
        });
        setWeeklyError(safeMsg);
      }
    };
    runWeeklyParse();
  }, [
    weekCsv,
    weekHtml,
    weekStart,
    weekEnd,
    isAadhaarAuthorized,
    existingWeeklyForSelectedWindow,
  ]);

  const handleWeeklySubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (existingWeeklyForSelectedWindow) {
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        `[ERR-DUP-205] Weekly Reconciliation for ${formatToDDMMYYYY(
          weekStart
        )} to ${formatToDDMMYYYY(weekEnd)} is already submitted.`
      );
    }
    if (
      !weeklyPreview ||
      !weekCsv ||
      !weekHtml ||
      !confirmWeeklyCheck ||
      !isAadhaarAuthorized
    )
      return;
    setIsSubmittingWeekly(true);
    try {
      const safeOp = (partner.aadhaar_operator_id || "OP").replace(
        /[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g,
        "_"
      );
      const csvPath = `WEEKLY_${safeOp}_${weekStart}_to_${weekEnd}_${Date.now()}.csv`;
      const htmlPath = `WEEKLY_${safeOp}_${weekStart}_to_${weekEnd}_${Date.now()}.html`;

      await Promise.all([
        supabase.storage.from("aadhaar-reports").upload(csvPath, weekCsv),
        supabase.storage.from("aadhaar-reports").upload(htmlPath, weekHtml),
      ]);

      let mismatchCount = 0;
      weeklyPreview.daily_breakdown.forEach((wb: any) => {
        const dMatch = dailyReports.find((dr) => dr.report_date === wb.date);
        if (!dMatch || dMatch.total_packets_qty !== wb.totalPkts)
          mismatchCount++;
      });

      const { error } = await supabase.from("aadhaar_weekly_reports").insert([
        {
          partner_id: partner.id,
          center_id: partner.center_id,
          start_date: weekStart,
          end_date: weekEnd,
          operator_id: weeklyPreview.operator_id,
          station_id: weeklyPreview.station_id,
          cat1_new_qty: weeklyPreview.cat1_new_qty,
          cat2_mbu_free_qty: weeklyPreview.cat2_mbu_free_qty,
          cat3_mbu_chargeable_qty: weeklyPreview.cat3_mbu_chargeable_qty,
          cat4_demographic_qty: weeklyPreview.cat4_demographic_qty,
          cat5_biometric_qty: weeklyPreview.cat5_biometric_qty,
          total_packets_qty: weeklyPreview.total_packets_qty,
          completed_qty: weeklyPreview.completed_qty,
          inprocess_qty: weeklyPreview.inprocess_qty,
          rejected_qty: weeklyPreview.rejected_qty,
          total_cash_collected: weeklyPreview.total_cash_collected,
          daily_breakdown_json: weeklyPreview.daily_breakdown,
          discrepancy_days_count: mismatchCount,
          reconciliation_status:
            mismatchCount === 0 ? "Matched" : "Discrepancy Flagged",
          csv_file_url: csvPath,
          html_file_url: htmlPath,
        },
      ]);
      if (error) throw error;

      await logSystemTelemetry({
        actorId: partner.id,
        actorEmail: partner.email,
        module: "PARTNER_AADHAAR_WEEKLY",
        actionCode: "WEEKLY_REPORT_SUBMITTED",
        referenceId: `${weekStart}_${weekEnd}`,
        metadata: {
          packets: weeklyPreview.total_packets_qty,
          cash: weeklyPreview.total_cash_collected,
          mismatches: mismatchCount,
        },
      });

      showBanner(
        "success",
        "✅ Weekly Report synced and cross-verified against Daily Reports!"
      );
      setWeekCsv(null);
      setWeekHtml(null);
      setWeeklyPreview(null);
      await initializeAadhaarPortal();
      setActiveMenu("history");
    } catch (err: any) {
      const safeMsg = await reportAndMaskError(err, "PARTNER_AADHAAR_WEEKLY", {
        id: partner?.id,
        email: partner?.email,
      });
      showBanner("error", safeMsg);
    } finally {
      setIsSubmittingWeekly(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadRawFile = async (path: string | null) => {
    if (!path)
      return showBanner(
        "info",
        "File not available (Manual / Exemption entry)."
      );
    const { data, error } = await supabase.storage
      .from("aadhaar-reports")
      .createSignedUrl(path, 120);
    if (error || !data?.signedUrl)
      return showBanner(
        "error",
        "[ERR-VLT-301] Unable to generate download link."
      );
    window.open(data.signedUrl, "_blank");
  };

  const handleViewDepositSlip = async (path: string | null) => {
    if (!path)
      return showBanner("info", "No deposit slip attached (Exempted).");
    if (path.startsWith("http")) {
      window.open(path, "_blank");
      return;
    }
    const { data, error } = await supabase.storage
      .from("deposit-slips")
      .createSignedUrl(path, 120);
    if (error || !data?.signedUrl)
      return showBanner("error", "[ERR-VLT-301] Unable to open deposit slip.");
    window.open(data.signedUrl, "_blank");
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 flex items-center justify-center text-white font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-xs animate-pulse">
        Verifying Aadhaar Seva Kendra Clearance...
      </div>
    );
  }

  const filteredHistory = dailyReports.filter((r) => {
    const dMatch =
      r.report_date >= filterFromDate && r.report_date <= filterToDate;
    const mMatch =
      fileModeFilter === "ALL"
        ? true
        : fileModeFilter === "WITH_FILES"
        ? r.has_files === true
        : r.has_files === false;
    return dMatch && mMatch;
  });

  const totals = filteredHistory.reduce(
    (acc, r) => {
      acc.cat1 += Number(r.cat1_new_qty || 0);
      acc.cat2 += Number(r.cat2_mbu_free_qty || 0);
      acc.cat3 += Number(r.cat3_mbu_chargeable_qty || 0);
      acc.cat4 += Number(r.cat4_demographic_qty || 0);
      acc.cat5 += Number(r.cat5_biometric_qty || 0);
      acc.pkts += Number(r.total_packets_qty || 0);
      acc.comp += Number(r.completed_qty || 0);
      acc.inproc += Number(r.inprocess_qty || 0);
      acc.rej += Number(r.rejected_qty || 0);
      acc.cash += Number(r.total_cash_collected || 0);
      return acc;
    },
    {
      cat1: 0,
      cat2: 0,
      cat3: 0,
      cat4: 0,
      cat5: 0,
      pkts: 0,
      comp: 0,
      inproc: 0,
      rej: 0,
      cash: 0,
    }
  );

  // Deduction Formula (Total Collection - Total Deposit = Remaining Balance Payable)
  const totalCollectionCash = dailyReports.reduce(
    (s, r) => s + Number(r.total_cash_collected || 0),
    0
  );
  const totalDepositedCash = aadhaarDeposits
    .filter((d) => d.status !== "Discrepancy")
    .reduce((s, d) => s + Number(d.deposit_amount || 0), 0);
  const unpaidPenaltyTotal = penalties
    .filter((p) => !p.is_settled && !p.is_waived)
    .reduce((s, p) => s + Number(p.penalty_amount || 0), 0);
  const pendingReportCash = Math.max(
    0,
    totalCollectionCash - totalDepositedCash
  );
  const totalPayableNow = Math.max(
    0,
    totalCollectionCash + unpaidPenaltyTotal - totalDepositedCash
  );

  const parsedQrAmount = parseFloat(qrPayAmount) || 0;
  const safeQrAmount = parsedQrAmount.toFixed(2);
  const upiDeepLink = `upi://pay?pa=${centerUpi}&pn=${encodeURIComponent(
    "Fast Ark Aadhaar"
  )}&am=${safeQrAmount}&cu=INR&tn=${encodeURIComponent(
    `Aadhaar_${partner?.aadhaar_station_id || partner?.center_id}`
  )}`;

  const parsedReceiptAmount = parseFloat(depositForm.amount) || 0;
  const isPdfSlip =
    slipFile?.type === "application/pdf" ||
    (slipFile?.name || "").toLowerCase().endsWith(".pdf");

  const effectiveMenu: AadhaarMenuTab = isAadhaarAuthorized
    ? activeMenu
    : "upgrade";
  const isDownloadReady = Boolean(
    filterFromDate &&
      filterToDate &&
      filteredHistory.length > 0 &&
      confirmDownloadCheck
  );

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-100 flex flex-col lg:flex-row font-sans">
      <AadhaarSidebar
        activeMenu={effectiveMenu}
        setActiveMenu={setActiveMenu}
        partner={partner}
        isAadhaarAuthorized={isAadhaarAuthorized}
        totalCollectionCash={totalCollectionCash}
        totalDepositedCash={totalDepositedCash}
        pendingReportCash={pendingReportCash}
        unpaidPenaltyTotal={unpaidPenaltyTotal}
        overdueDaysCount={
          penalties.filter((p) => !p.is_waived && !p.is_settled).length
        }
        onSignOut={async () => {
          await supabase.auth.signOut();
          router.push("/partner/login");
        }}
      />

      <main className="flex-1 p-4 md:p-8 pb-24 lg:pb-8 overflow-y-auto space-y-6 max-w-[1400px]">
        {statusBanner && (
          <div
            className={`p-4 rounded-xl border-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-4 font-bold text-xs shadow-sm ${
              statusBanner.type === "error"
                ? "bg-red-50 border-red-300 text-red-900"
                : statusBanner.type === "success"
                ? "bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-900"
                : "bg-blue-50 border-blue-300 text-blue-900"
            }`}
          >
            <span>{statusBanner.text}</span>
            <button

        {isAadhaarAuthorized && unpaidPenaltyTotal > 0 && (

                    </p>
