                        <div>
                          <label className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-600 block mb-1">
                            2. MBU Free (₹0)
                          </label>
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            step="1"
                            min="0"
                            placeholder="0"
                            value={manualCounts.cat2 || ""}
                            onWheel={handleNumericWheel}
                            onKeyDown={handleNumericKeyDown}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              setManualCounts({
                                ...manualCounts,
                                cat2: Math.max(
                                  0,
                                  parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0
                                ),
                              })
                            }
                            className={noScrollNumClass}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <label className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-amber-800 block mb-1">
                            3. MBU Paid (₹
                            {activeTariff?.mbu_chargeable_fee || 125})
                          </label>
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            step="1"
                            min="0"
                            placeholder="0"
                            value={manualCounts.cat3 || ""}
                            onWheel={handleNumericWheel}
                            onKeyDown={handleNumericKeyDown}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              setManualCounts({
                                ...manualCounts,
                                cat3: Math.max(
                                  0,
                                  parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0
                                ),
                              })
                            }
                            className={noScrollNumClass}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <label className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-blue-800 block mb-1">
                            4. Demo (₹{activeTariff?.demographic_fee || 75})
                          </label>
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            step="1"
                            min="0"
                            placeholder="0"
                            value={manualCounts.cat4 || ""}
                            onWheel={handleNumericWheel}
                            onKeyDown={handleNumericKeyDown}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              setManualCounts({
                                ...manualCounts,
                                cat4: Math.max(
                                  0,
                                  parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0
                                ),
                              })
                            }
                            className={noScrollNumClass}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <label className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-purple-800 block mb-1">
                            5. Bio (₹{activeTariff?.biometric_fee || 125})
                          </label>
                          <input
                            type="number"
                            step="1"
                            min="0"
                            placeholder="0"
                            value={manualCounts.cat5 || ""}
                            onWheel={handleNumericWheel}
                            onKeyDown={handleNumericKeyDown}
                            onChange={(e) =>
                              setManualCounts({
                                ...manualCounts,
                                cat5: Math.max(
                                  0,
                                  parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 0
                                ),
                              })
                            }
                            className={noScrollNumClass}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

                {parseError && (
                  <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border-2 border-red-300 rounded-xl text-red-800 text-xs font-black">
                    ❌ {parseError}
                  </div>
                )}

                {(parsedPreview || (isManualMode && exemptionReason)) && (
                  <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white p-5 rounded-xl space-y-4">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
                      <span className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400">
                        ✅ 5-Category Verification Summary (
                        {formatToDDMMYYYY(reportDate)})
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-300">
                        Operator:{" "}
                        {isManualMode
                          ? partner?.aadhaar_operator_id
                          : parsedPreview?.operator_id}{" "}
                        | Station:{" "}
                        {isManualMode
                          ? partner?.aadhaar_station_id
                          : parsedPreview?.station_id}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-6 gap-3 text-center">
                      <div className="bg-slate-800 p-3 rounded-lg">
                        <p className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold">
                          1. New (₹0)
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-xl font-black">
                          {isManualMode
                            ? isZeroExemption
                              ? 0
                              : manualCounts.cat1
                            : parsedPreview.cat1_new_qty}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="bg-slate-800 p-3 rounded-lg">
                        <p className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 uppercase font-bold">
                          2. MBU Free
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-xl font-black">
                          {isManualMode
                            ? isZeroExemption
                              ? 0
                              : manualCounts.cat2
                            : parsedPreview.cat2_mbu_free_qty}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="bg-slate-800 p-3 rounded-lg">
                        <p className="text-[9px] text-amber-400 uppercase font-bold">
                          3. MBU Paid
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-xl font-black text-amber-400">
                          {isManualMode
                            ? isZeroExemption
                              ? 0
                              : manualCounts.cat3
                            : parsedPreview.cat3_mbu_chargeable_qty}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="bg-slate-800 p-3 rounded-lg">
                        <p className="text-[9px] text-blue-400 uppercase font-bold">
                          4. Demographic
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-xl font-black text-blue-400">
                          {isManualMode
                            ? isZeroExemption
                              ? 0
                              : manualCounts.cat4
                            : parsedPreview.cat4_demographic_qty}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="bg-slate-800 p-3 rounded-lg">
                        <p className="text-[9px] text-purple-400 uppercase font-bold">
                          5. Biometric
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-xl font-black text-purple-400">
                          {isManualMode
                            ? isZeroExemption
                              ? 0
                              : manualCounts.cat5
                            : parsedPreview.cat5_biometric_qty}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                      <div className="bg-emerald-950 border border-emerald-700 p-3 rounded-lg">
                        <p className="text-[9px] text-emerald-300 uppercase font-black">
                          Cash Collected
                        </p>
                        <p className="text-xl font-black text-white">
                          ₹
                          {(isManualMode
                            ? manualCashTotal
                            : parsedPreview.total_cash_collected
                          ).toLocaleString("en-IN", {
                            minimumFractionDigits: 2,
                          })}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <label className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-slate-800 p-3.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 cursor-pointer">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        required
                        checked={confirmDailyCheck}
                        onChange={(e) => setConfirmDailyCheck(e.target.checked)}
                        className="w-5 h-5 accent-emerald-500"
                      />
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-200">
                        I verify that the 5-category counts and{" "}
                        <strong className="text-emerald-400">
                          ₹
                          {(isManualMode
                            ? manualCashTotal
                            : parsedPreview.total_cash_collected
                          ).toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                        </strong>{" "}
                        collected amount for{" "}
                        <strong>{formatToDDMMYYYY(reportDate)}</strong> are
                        accurate.
                      </span>
                    </label>

                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      disabled={isSubmittingDaily || !confirmDailyCheck}
                      className="w-full py-4 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-sm rounded-xl shadow-lg disabled:opacity-40 transition"
                    >
                      {isSubmittingDaily
                        ? "Committing Report..."
                        : "Submit Daily Report & Unlock Deposit QR \u2192"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </form>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* VIEW 3: SEPARATED REMITTANCE WORKSPACE (WITH UNIQUE UTR, TXN ID & REF CODE) */}
        {isAadhaarAuthorized && effectiveMenu === "deposit" && (
          <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in">
            <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm flex flex-col lg:flex-row justify-between items-start lg:items-center gap-4">
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-blue-600 block">
                  Choose Remittance Channel
                </span>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                  Aadhaar Cash Settlement &amp; OCR Receipt Verification
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Total Collection:{" "}
                  <strong>
                    ₹{totalCollectionCash.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                  </strong>{" "}
                  &bull; Less Deposited:{" "}
                  <strong className="text-emerald-600">
                    -₹{totalDepositedCash.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                  </strong>{" "}
                  &bull; Late Fine:{" "}
                  <strong className="text-red-600">
                    +₹{unpaidPenaltyTotal.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                  </strong>{" "}
                  &rarr; Balance Payable:{" "}
                  <strong className="text-red-600 text-sm">
                    ₹
                    {totalPayableNow.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
                      minimumFractionDigits: 2,
                    })}
                  </strong>
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 w-full lg:w-auto">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSwitchRemittanceTrack("UPI_QR")}
                  className={`px-5 py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider border-2 transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 ${
                    remittanceTrack === "UPI_QR"
                      ? "bg-slate-900 text-white border-slate-900 shadow-lg"
                      : "bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>📲</span> Mode 1: Pay via UPI QR &amp; Upload Slip
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleSwitchRemittanceTrack("BANK_TRANSFER")}
                  className={`px-5 py-3.5 rounded-xl font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-wider border-2 transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 ${
                    remittanceTrack === "BANK_TRANSFER"
                      ? "bg-amber-500 text-slate-950 border-amber-600 shadow-lg"
                      : "bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100"
                  }`}
                >
                  <span>🏦</span> Mode 2: Bank Cash / NEFT / IMPS
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 items-start">
              <div className="space-y-6">
                {remittanceTrack === "UPI_QR" ? (
                  <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-800 shadow-xl space-y-5">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-3">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400 block">
                          Step 1 of 2 — Isolated UPI QR Generator
                        </span>
                        <h3 className="text-lg font-black mt-0.5">
                          Generate QR &amp; Pay via UPI App
                        </h3>
                      </div>
                      <span className="bg-slate-800 text-slate-300 text-[10px] font-black px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-slate-700">
                        UPI ID: {centerUpi}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="bg-slate-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 text-left space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                        <label className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-amber-400 tracking-widest">
                          QR Generation Amount (₹) — Separate from Receipt OCR
                        </label>
                        {totalPayableNow > 0 && (
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() =>
                              setQrPayAmount(totalPayableNow.toFixed(2))
                            }
                            className="text-[9px] font-black uppercase bg-blue-600/30 hover:bg-blue-600 text-blue-300 hover:text-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-500/40 transition"
                          >
                            Reset to Balance Payable (₹{totalPayableNow})
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        step="0.01"
                        min="0"

                        onKeyDown={handleNumericKeyDown}
                        onChange={(e) => setQrPayAmount(e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full bg-slate-900 border-2 border-slate-700 focus:border-emerald-500 text-white font-black text-xl p-3 rounded-lg outline-none transition [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center pt-2">
                      <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-lg mb-4">
                        <QRCodeSVG value={upiDeepLink} size={185} level="M" />
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-3xl font-black text-emerald-400">
                        ₹
                        {parsedQrAmount.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
                          minimumFractionDigits: 2,
                        })}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest font-bold mt-1">
                        Scan with any UPI App or Tap Below on Mobile
                      </p>

                      {parsedQrAmount > 0 && (
                        <a

                          className="mt-4 w-full max-w-sm py-3.5 px-5 bg-emerald-500 hover:bg-emerald-400 text-slate-950 font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest rounded-xl shadow-lg transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                        >
                          <span>📲</span> Tap to Pay ₹
                          {parsedQrAmount.toLocaleString("en-IN")} via UPI App

                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-800 shadow-xl space-y-4">
                    <span className="bg-amber-500/20 text-amber-300 border border-amber-500/40 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest inline-block">
                      Bank Counter / Online Transfer Mode
                    </span>
                    <h3 className="text-xl font-black">
                      Bank Cash Deposit / NEFT / IMPS / Cheque Remittance
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-xs text-slate-300 font-medium leading-relaxed">
                      Upload your physical Bank Cash Deposit Challan or
                      NEFT/IMPS advice on the right — the enhanced OCR engine
                      will automatically read the collected amount, date, Unique
                      UTR, and Transaction ID from your slip.
                    </p>
                    <div className="bg-slate-950 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-800 flex justify-between items-center">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase">
                        Remaining Balance Payable:
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-2xl font-black text-amber-400">
                        ₹
                        {totalPayableNow.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
                          minimumFractionDigits: 2,
                        })}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {!isSlipExempted && slipPreviewUrl && (
                  <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
                    <div className="p-3.5 bg-slate-900 text-white flex justify-between items-center">
                      <span className="text-xs font-black uppercase tracking-widest">
                        📄 Uploaded Receipt Preview
                      </span>
                      <a
                        href={slipPreviewUrl}
                        target="_blank"

                        Open Full Screen ↗
                      </a>

                      {isPdfSlip ? (
                        <iframe
                          src={`${slipPreviewUrl}#toolbar=0`}
                          className="w-full h-96 rounded-xl border border-slate-300 bg-white"
                          title="Aadhaar Deposit PDF Preview"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <img
                          src={slipPreviewUrl}
                          alt="Uploaded Aadhaar Payment Slip"
                          className="max-h-96 w-auto object-contain rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow bg-white"
                        />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-5">
                <div className="border-b border-slate-100 pb-3 flex justify-between items-start">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-blue-600 block">
                      {remittanceTrack === "UPI_QR"
                        ? "Step 2 of 2 — Upload UPI Screenshot & Auto-Read OCR"
                        : "Upload Bank Slip / Challan & Auto-Read OCR"}
                    </span>
                    <h3 className="font-black text-lg text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                      Receipt Verification &amp; Unique UTR Record
                    </h3>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-right bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg">
                    <span className="text-[8px] font-black uppercase text-indigo-500 block">
                      Auto Reference Code
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-mono font-black text-xs text-indigo-900">
                      {depositForm.reference_code}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                <form
                  onSubmit={handleInstantDepositSubmit}
                  className="space-y-4"
                >
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={isSlipExempted}
                        onChange={(e) => {
                          setIsSlipExempted(e.target.checked);
                          setSlipFile(null);
                          if (slipPreviewUrl)
                            URL.revokeObjectURL(slipPreviewUrl);
                          setSlipPreviewUrl(null);
                          setOcrSummary({
                            platform: null,
                            amount: null,
                            utr: null,
                            transactionId: null,
                            date: null,
                          });
                          setSlipExemptionCategory("");
                          setSlipExemptionOtherText("");
                          setConfirmDepositCheck(false);
                        }}
                        className="w-5 h-5 accent-amber-600"
                      />
                      <span className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-800">
                        No deposit slip available (Select Missing Slip Reason)
                      </span>
                    </label>

                    {!isSlipExempted ? (
                      <div className="p-4 border-2 border-dashed border-blue-300 bg-blue-50/40 rounded-xl">
                        <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-blue-800 mb-1.5">
                          1. Upload{" "}
                          {remittanceTrack === "UPI_QR"
                            ? "UPI Screenshot"
                            : "Bank Deposit Slip / Advice"}{" "}
                          (Enhanced OCR Auto-Reads Amount, UTR &amp; Txn ID) *
                        </label>
                        <input
                          type="file"
                          accept="image/*,application/pdf,.pdf"
                          required={!isSlipExempted}
                          onChange={handleSlipUploadOCR}
                          className="w-full text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer"
                        />
                        {isScanningSlip && (
                          <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-blue-100/80 border border-blue-300 rounded-lg text-center">
                            <p className="text-[10px] font-black text-blue-800 uppercase animate-pulse">
                              🔍 Pre-processing Contrast &amp; Reading Amount,
                              Date, UTR &amp; Txn ID ({scanProgress}%)...
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="bg-amber-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-amber-200 space-y-3 animate-in fade-in">
                        <div>
                          <label className="text-[10px] text-amber-800 font-black uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1">
                            1. Reason for Missing Deposit Slip *
                          </label>
                          <select
                            required={isSlipExempted}
                            value={slipExemptionCategory}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              setSlipExemptionCategory(e.target.value);
                              setSlipExemptionOtherText("");
                            }}
                            className="w-full bg-white border-2 border-amber-300 text-slate-800 font-bold text-xs rounded-lg p-2.5 outline-none focus:border-amber-600"
                          >
                            <option value="" disabled>
                              -- Select Missing Slip Reason --
                            </option>
                            <option value="Missing">
                              Missing / Lost Physical Slip
                            </option>
                            <option value="Not downloaded">
                              Receipt Not Downloaded / UPI App Error
                            </option>
                            <option value="Other">Other (Specify Below)</option>
                          </select>
                        </div>

                        {slipExemptionCategory === "Other" && (
                          <div>
                            <label className="text-[10px] text-amber-800 font-black uppercase tracking-widest block mb-1">
                              Detailed Exemption Remarks *
                            </label>
                            <input
                              type="text"
                              required
                              placeholder="TYPE DETAILED REASON HERE..."
                              value={slipExemptionOtherText}
                              onChange={(e) =>
                                setSlipExemptionOtherText(
                                  e.target.value.toUpperCase()
                                )
                              }
                              className="w-full bg-white border-2 border-amber-300 text-slate-900 font-black uppercase text-xs rounded-lg p-2.5 outline-none"
                            />
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {!isScanningSlip &&
                    !isSlipExempted &&
                    slipFile &&
                    ocrSummary.platform && (
                      <div className="bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-xl p-4 space-y-2.5 border border-slate-800">
                        <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-slate-800 pb-2">
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-black text-emerald-400 uppercase tracking-widest">
                            ✅ Enhanced OCR Capture Summary
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-[10px] font-black bg-blue-900/60 text-blue-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-700">
                            {ocrSummary.platform}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-xs">
                          <div className="bg-slate-800 p-2 rounded">
                            <p className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 uppercase">
                              OCR Amount
                            </p>
                            <p className="font-black text-emerald-400">
                              {ocrSummary.amount !== null
                                ? `₹${ocrSummary.amount.toLocaleString(
                                    "en-IN"
                                  )}`
                                : "Enter Below"}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          <div className="bg-slate-800 p-2 rounded">
                            <p className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 uppercase">
                              OCR Date
                            </p>
                            <p className="font-bold text-slate-200">
                              {ocrSummary.date
                                ? formatToDDMMYYYY(ocrSummary.date)
                                : "Verify Below"}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          <div className="bg-slate-800 p-2 rounded">
                            <p className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 uppercase">
                              OCR UTR
                            </p>
                            <p className="font-bold text-slate-200 truncate">
                              {ocrSummary.utr || "Enter Below"}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-emerald-700 mb-1">
                        2. Deposit Amount (₹) *
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="number"
                        step="0.01"
                        min="0"
                        required
                        placeholder="Auto-filled from OCR slip..."
                        value={depositForm.amount}
                        onWheel={handleNumericWheel}
                        onKeyDown={handleNumericKeyDown}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setDepositForm({
                            ...depositForm,
                            amount: e.target.value,
                          })
                        }
                        className="w-full border-2 border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50/30 p-3 rounded-lg font-black text-lg text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-emerald-600 transition [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-blue-700 mb-1">
                        3. Deposit Date ({formatToDDMMYYYY(depositForm.date)}) *
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="date"
                        required
                        max={getISTDateString(0)}
                        value={depositForm.date}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setDepositForm({
                            ...depositForm,
                            date: e.target.value,
                            reference_code: generateSystemReferenceCode(
                              "FA-ADH",
                              e.target.value
                            ),
                          })
                        }
                        className="w-full border-2 border-slate-200 p-3 rounded-lg font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 bg-white outline-none focus:border-blue-600 transition"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* 3 DISTINCT IDENTIFIERS: UNIQUE UTR, TRANSACTION ID & SYSTEM REFERENCE CODE */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-600 mb-1">
                        4. Unique Bank / UPI UTR Number *
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        required
                        placeholder="Unique UTR / Reference Number..."
                        value={depositForm.utr}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setDepositForm({
                            ...depositForm,
                            utr: e.target.value.toUpperCase(),
                          })
                        }
                        className="w-full border-2 border-slate-300 p-2.5 rounded-lg font-black text-xs uppercase outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                      />
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-600 mb-1">
                        5. Bank Transaction / Scroll ID *
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        required
                        placeholder="Txn / Journal / Scroll No..."
                        value={depositForm.transaction_id}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setDepositForm({
                            ...depositForm,
                            transaction_id: e.target.value.toUpperCase(),
                          })
                        }
                        className="w-full border-2 border-slate-300 p-2.5 rounded-lg font-bold text-xs uppercase outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-500 mb-1">
                        6. Remittance Method
                      </label>
                      {remittanceTrack === "UPI_QR" ? (
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          readOnly
                          value="UPI (QR / App Payment)"
                          className="w-full border-2 border-slate-200 p-2.5 rounded-lg font-black text-xs bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 cursor-not-allowed"
                        />
                      ) : (
                        <select
                          value={
                            depositForm.method === "UPI"
                              ? "Cash Deposit"
                              : depositForm.method
                          }
                          onChange={(e) =>
                            setDepositForm({
                              ...depositForm,
                              method: e.target.value,
                            })
                          }
                          className="w-full border-2 border-amber-300 p-2.5 rounded-lg font-black text-xs bg-amber-50/40 text-slate-900 outline-none focus:border-amber-600"
                        >
                          <option value="Cash Deposit">
                            Bank Counter Cash Deposit
                          </option>
                          <option value="NEFT/RTGS">
                            NEFT / RTGS Transfer
                          </option>
                          <option value="IMPS">IMPS Transfer</option>
                          <option value="Cheque">Bank Cheque Deposit</option>
                        </select>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    <div>
                      <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-indigo-700 mb-1">
                        7. System Reference Code (Locked for Records)
                      </label>
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        readOnly
                        value={depositForm.reference_code}
                        className="w-full border-2 border-indigo-200 p-2.5 rounded-lg font-mono font-black text-xs bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-900 cursor-not-allowed"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <label className="flex items-start gap-2.5 bg-blue-50 p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-blue-200 cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      required
                      checked={confirmDepositCheck}
                      onChange={(e) => setConfirmDepositCheck(e.target.checked)}
                      className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-600 mt-0.5 shrink-0"
                    />
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-950 leading-snug">
                      I confirm that the Deposit Amount (
                      <strong>
                        ₹
                        {parsedReceiptAmount.toLocaleString("en-IN", {
                          minimumFractionDigits: 2,
                        })}
                      </strong>
                      ), Unique UTR (<strong>{depositForm.utr || "N/A"}</strong>
                      ), Transaction ID (
                      <strong>{depositForm.transaction_id || "N/A"}</strong>),
                      and Reference Code (
                      <strong>{depositForm.reference_code}</strong>) match my
                      payment receipt.
                    </span>
                  </label>

                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    disabled={
                      isSubmittingDeposit ||
                      isScanningSlip ||
                      !confirmDepositCheck
                    }
                    className="w-full py-4 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-blue-600 text-white font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-xs rounded-xl shadow-md disabled:opacity-40 transition"
                  >
                    {isSubmittingDeposit
                      ? "Submitting Remittance..."
                      : `Submit ₹${parsedReceiptAmount.toLocaleString(
                          "en-IN"
                        )} Remittance (${depositForm.reference_code})`}
                  </button>
                </form>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* VIEW 4: WEEKLY REPORT RECONCILIATION (MONDAY TO SUNDAY) */}
        {isAadhaarAuthorized && effectiveMenu === "weekly" && (
          <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-6 space-y-6 animate-in fade-in">
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-2 border-b border-slate-100 pb-4">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-slate-900">
                  Weekly UIDAI Report Reconciliation (Monday to Sunday)
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
                  Pick any date in the week — the system automatically snaps to
                  Monday (Start) and consecutive Sunday (End).
                </p>
              </div>
              <span className="bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-800 border border-indigo-200 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest">
                📅 {formatToDDMMYYYY(weekStart)} (Mon) &rarr;{" "}
                {formatToDDMMYYYY(weekEnd)} (Sun)
              </span>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 bg-slate-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-blue-700 mb-1">
                  1. Select Week Start (Auto-Snaps to Monday:{" "}
                  {formatToDDMMYYYY(weekStart)}) *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  required
                  value={weekStart}
                  onChange={(e) => handleWeekDateSelection(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full border-2 border-blue-300 p-2.5 rounded-lg font-black text-xs bg-white outline-none focus:border-blue-600"
                />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-slate-500 mb-1">
                  2. Consecutive Week End (Locked to Sunday:{" "}
                  {formatToDDMMYYYY(weekEnd)})
                </label>
                <input
                  type="date"
                  readOnly
                  value={weekEnd}
                  className="w-full border-2 border-slate-200 p-2.5 rounded-lg font-black text-xs bg-slate-200/70 text-slate-600 cursor-not-allowed outline-none"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {existingWeeklyForSelectedWindow ? (
              <div className="p-6 bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-2xl border-2 border-emerald-500/60 space-y-2">
                <h3 className="font-black text-sm uppercase tracking-widest text-emerald-400">
                  🔒 Weekly Reconciliation Already Submitted (
                  {formatToDDMMYYYY(weekStart)} to {formatToDDMMYYYY(weekEnd)})
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-300">
                  Logged Packets:{" "}
                  {existingWeeklyForSelectedWindow.total_packets_qty} | Cash: ₹
                  {Number(
                    existingWeeklyForSelectedWindow.total_cash_collected || 0
                  ).toLocaleString("en-IN")}{" "}
                  | Status:{" "}
                  {existingWeeklyForSelectedWindow.reconciliation_status}
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <form onSubmit={handleWeeklySubmit} className="space-y-6">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-blue-300 bg-blue-50/50 rounded-xl p-5 text-center relative">
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      accept=".csv,text/csv,application/vnd.ms-excel,text/plain"
                      onChange={(e) => setWeekCsv(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
                      className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                    <p className="font-black text-slate-800 text-sm">
                      {weekCsv
                        ? `✅ ${weekCsv.name}`
                        : "Upload Weekly .CSV File *"}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50/50 rounded-xl p-5 text-center relative">
                    <input
                      type="file"
                      accept=".html,.htm,text/html"
                      onChange={(e) => setWeekHtml(e.target.files?.[0] || null)}
                      className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                    <p className="font-black text-slate-800 text-sm">
                      {weekHtml
                        ? `✅ ${weekHtml.name}`
                        : "Upload Weekly .HTML File *"}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {weeklyError && (
                  <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border-2 border-red-300 rounded-xl text-red-800 text-xs font-black">
                    ❌ {weeklyError}
                  </div>
                )}

                {weeklyPreview && (
                  <div className="space-y-4">
                    <h3 className="font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-600">
                      Day-by-Day Weekly vs. Daily Matching Matrix (
                      {formatToDDMMYYYY(weekStart)} to{" "}
                      {formatToDDMMYYYY(weekEnd)})
                    </h3>
                    <div className="overflow-x-auto border rounded-xl">
                      <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
                        <thead className="bg-slate-900 text-white text-[10px] uppercase">
                          <tr>
                            <th className="p-3">Date (DD/MM/YYYY)</th>
                            <th className="p-3 text-center">
                              Weekly File Packets
                            </th>
                            <th className="p-3 text-center">
                              Daily Report Logged
                            </th>
                            <th className="p-3 text-center">
                              Rejected in Weekly
                            </th>
                            <th className="p-3 text-right">Weekly Cash</th>
                            <th className="p-3 text-right">Match Status</th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody className="divide-y">
                          {weeklyPreview.daily_breakdown.map((wb: any) => {
                            const dMatch = dailyReports.find(
                              (dr) => dr.report_date === wb.date
                            );
                            const isMatched =
                              dMatch &&
                              dMatch.total_packets_qty === wb.totalPkts;
                            return (
                              <tr key={wb.date} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
                                <td className="p-3 font-black">
                                  {formatToDDMMYYYY(wb.date)}
                                </td>
                                <td className="p-3 text-center font-bold">
                                  {wb.totalPkts}
                                </td>
                                <td className="p-3 text-center font-bold">
                                  {dMatch
                                    ? dMatch.total_packets_qty
                                    : "MISSING"}
                                </td>
                                <td className="p-3 text-center font-bold text-red-600">
                                  {wb.rejected}
                                </td>
                                <td className="p-3 text-right font-black">
                                  ₹{wb.totalCash.toLocaleString("en-IN")}
                                </td>
                                <td className="p-3 text-right">
                                  {isMatched ? (
                                    <span className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-black uppercase">
                                      ✅ Matched
                                    </span>
                                  ) : (
                                    <span className="bg-red-100 text-red-800 px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-black uppercase">
                                      🚨 Mismatch / Missing Daily
                                    </span>
                                  )}
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                            );
                          })}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>
                    </div>

                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2.5 bg-slate-100 p-3 rounded-lg cursor-pointer">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        required
                        checked={confirmWeeklyCheck}
                        onChange={(e) =>
                          setConfirmWeeklyCheck(e.target.checked)
                        }
                        className="w-4 h-4 accent-blue-600"
                      />
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
                        I confirm the Monday-to-Sunday weekly reconciliation
                        matrix ({weeklyPreview.total_packets_qty} packets, ₹
                        {weeklyPreview.total_cash_collected.toLocaleString(
                          "en-IN"
                        )}
                        ).
                      </span>
                    </label>

                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      disabled={isSubmittingWeekly || !confirmWeeklyCheck}
                      className="w-full py-4 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-blue-600 text-white font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-xs rounded-xl shadow-lg"
                    >
                      {isSubmittingWeekly
                        ? "Syncing Weekly Report..."
                        : "Submit Weekly Reconciliation"}
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </form>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* VIEW 5: MODULAR UPLOADED REPORTS & DEPOSIT REMITTANCE VAULT */}
        {isAadhaarAuthorized && effectiveMenu === "history" && (
          <PartnerAadhaarHistoryVault
            partner={partner}
            dailyReports={dailyReports}
            weeklyReports={weeklyReports}
            aadhaarDeposits={aadhaarDeposits}
            penalties={penalties}
            filterFromDate={filterFromDate}
            filterToDate={filterToDate}
            fileModeFilter={fileModeFilter}
            onDownloadRawFile={handleDownloadRawFile}
            onViewDepositSlip={handleViewDepositSlip}
          />
        )}

        {/* VIEW 6: MODULAR CREDENTIALS & 10-DOCUMENT COMPLIANCE DOSSIER */}
        {effectiveMenu === "upgrade" && (
          <PartnerAadhaarUpgradeModule
            partner={partner}
            latestUpgradeReq={latestUpgradeReq}
            isCredentialsLocked={isCredentialsLocked}
            upgradeForm={upgradeForm}
            setUpgradeForm={setUpgradeForm}
            showBanner={showBanner}
            onRefreshPortal={initializeAadhaarPortal}
          />
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

================================================================================
FILE PATH: ./app/partner/helpdesk/page.tsx

"use client";

import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { supabase } from "../../lib/supabase";

const BSNL_ISSUES = [
  "Technical issues", "Connectivity issues", "Portal down", 
  "Application not working", "System not available / PC/Internet/Power/Back up/", 
  "Other issues", "Sims not provided", "FTTH not available", 
  "Toilet not available", "No water facilities"
];

const COMPANY_ISSUES = [
  "Technical issues", "Id activation", "Queries", 
  "Salary not received", "Others"
];

export default function PartnerHelpdesk() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [partner, setPartner] = useState<any>(null);
  
  // Ticket History State
  const [myTickets, setMyTickets] = useState<any[]>([]);

  // Form State
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<'BSNL' | 'COMPANY'>('BSNL');
  const [issueType, setIssueType] = useState("");
  const [complaintText, setComplaintText] = useState("");
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [undertaking, setUndertaking] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    initializePortal();
  }, []);

  const initializePortal = async () => {
    try {
      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      if (!session) return router.push("/partner/login");

      // Get Partner Geo-Data required for back-office filters
      const { data: pData } = await supabase
        .from('active_partners')
        .select('id, locations(id, state, parent_master_id)')
        .eq('email', session.user.email)
        .single();
        
      if (!pData) throw new Error("Partner profile not found.");
      setPartner(pData);

      await fetchTicketHistory(pData.id);
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const fetchTicketHistory = async (partnerId: string) => {
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('complaints_log')
      .select('*')
      .eq('partner_id', partnerId)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
    
    setMyTickets(data || []);
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // GUARDRAIL ENGINE: Validates Dates, Duplicates, and Monthly Quotas
  // =========================================================================
  const todayDate = new Date().getDate();
  const currentMonthStr = new Date().toISOString().substring(0, 7);

  const getTicketStats = (issue: string) => {
    const thisMonthTickets = myTickets.filter(t => 
      t.issue_type === issue && 
      t.created_at.startsWith(currentMonthStr)
    );
    
    const hasUnresolved = thisMonthTickets.some(t => t.status !== 'Resolved');
    return { count: thisMonthTickets.length, hasUnresolved };
  };

  const getQuotaLimit = (issue: string) => {
    if (['Toilet not available', 'No water facilities', 'Salary not received'].includes(issue)) return 1;
    return 3;
  };

  // Dynamic Validation Variables based on selected issue
  const stats = issueType ? getTicketStats(issueType) : { count: 0, hasUnresolved: false };
  const limit = issueType ? getQuotaLimit(issueType) : 3;
  
  const isDuplicateLocked = stats.hasUnresolved;
  const isQuotaLocked = stats.count >= limit;

  // =========================================================================
  // SEQUENTIAL FILE ENGINE & TEXT HANDLING
  // =========================================================================
  const handleFileAppend = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.files && e.target.files.length > 0) {
      const newFile = e.target.files[0];
      
      // 5MB Size Limit
      if (newFile.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
        return alert("File size must be under 5MB.");
      }
      
      if (files.length < 4) {
        setFiles(prev => [...prev, newFile]);
      }
    }
    // Reset the input value so the same file could be selected again if removed
    e.target.value = '';
  };

  const removeFile = (index: number) => {
    setFiles(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));
  };

  const handleTextChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    // Strictly enforces uppercase transformation at the keystroke level
    setComplaintText(e.target.value.toUpperCase());
  };

  // =========================================================================
  // SUBMISSION LOGIC
  // =========================================================================
  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!partner || isDuplicateLocked || isQuotaLocked) return;

    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      let attachmentUrls: string[] = [];

      // Upload Evidence to Supabase Storage sequentially
      if (files.length > 0) {
        for (const file of files) {
          const fileExt = file.name.split('.').pop();
          const fileName = `${partner.id}/${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(7)}.${fileExt}`;
          
          const { error: uploadError } = await supabase.storage
            .from('partner_complaint_evidence')
            .upload(fileName, file);
            
          if (uploadError) throw new Error("File upload failed: " + uploadError.message);
          
          const { data: publicUrlData } = supabase.storage
            .from('partner_complaint_evidence')
            .getPublicUrl(fileName);
            
          attachmentUrls.push(publicUrlData.publicUrl);
        }
      }

      // Prepare payload with strict structural mapping for back-office filters
      const payload = {
        partner_id: partner.id,
        center_id: partner.locations?.id,
        hq_id: partner.locations?.parent_master_id,
        state: partner.locations?.state,
        category_type: category,
        issue_type: issueType,
        complaint_text: complaintText,
        attachments: attachmentUrls
      };

      const { error } = await supabase.from('complaints_log').insert([payload]);
      if (error) throw error;

      alert("✅ Ticket successfully raised. Your supervisor has been notified.");
      
      // Reset Form & Refresh History
      setIssueType("");
      setComplaintText("");
      setFiles([]);
      setUndertaking(false);
      fetchTicketHistory(partner.id);

    } catch (err: any) {
      alert("Submission Error: " + err.message);
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  if (loading) return <div className="p-20 text-center font-bold text-blue-600 animate-pulse">Loading Helpdesk...</div>;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-4 md:p-8">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto space-y-6">
        
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b pb-4">
          <div>
            <Link href="/partner/dashboard" className="text-blue-600 font-bold text-sm mb-1 hover:underline block">
              &larr; Back to Dashboard
            </Link>
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-black text-slate-900">Partner Helpdesk</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-500 font-medium">Log difficulties and track resolutions.</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8">
          
          {/* ======================= LEFT: TICKET FORM ======================= */}
          <div className="bg-white p-6 md:p-8 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm h-fit">
            <h2 className="font-black text-xl text-slate-800 mb-6 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-2xl">🎫</span> Raise a New Ticket
            </h2>

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
              
              {/* CATEGORY SELECTOR */}
              <div className="flex gap-4 p-1 bg-slate-100 rounded-lg">
                <button type="button" onClick={() => { setCategory('BSNL'); setIssueType(''); }} className={`flex-1 py-3 text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-widest rounded-md transition ${category === 'BSNL' ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'}`}>
                  1. BSNL Queries
                </button>
                <button type="button" onClick={() => { setCategory('COMPANY'); setIssueType(''); }} className={`flex-1 py-3 text-sm font-black uppercase tracking-widest rounded-md transition ${category === 'COMPANY' ? 'bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow' : 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-700'}`}>
                  2. Company Queries
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* ISSUE TYPE DROPDOWN */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">Select Issue Type *</label>
                <select 
                  required 
                  value={issueType} 
                  onChange={(e) => setIssueType(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full border-2 border-slate-300 p-3 rounded-lg font-bold text-slate-800 outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition"
                >
                  <option value="" disabled>-- Select specific difficulty --</option>
                  {(category === 'BSNL' ? BSNL_ISSUES : COMPANY_ISSUES).map(issue => {
                    // Salary Date Guardrail Engine
                    if (issue === 'Salary not received' && todayDate <= 10) return null;
                    return <option key={issue} value={issue}>{issue}</option>;
                  })}
                </select>
                
                {/* DYNAMIC GUARDRAIL ALERTS */}
                {issueType && isDuplicateLocked && (
                  <p className="text-red-600 font-bold text-xs mt-2 p-2 bg-red-50 rounded border border-red-200">
                    ⚠️ Locked: You already have an unresolved ticket for this issue. Please wait for resolution.
                  </p>
                )}
                {issueType && !isDuplicateLocked && isQuotaLocked && (
                  <p className="text-amber-600 font-bold text-xs mt-2 p-2 bg-amber-50 rounded border border-amber-200">
                    ⚠️ Locked: Monthly limit ({limit}) reached for this category. Contact management directly.
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* UPPERCASE ENFORCED TEXT AREA */}
              <div className={isDuplicateLocked || isQuotaLocked ? 'opacity-50 pointer-events-none' : ''}>
                <label className="block text-xs font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">
                  Detailed Remarks * <span className="text-slate-400 font-normal normal-case">(Max {category === 'BSNL' ? 2000 : 500} letters)</span>
                </label>
                <textarea 
                  required
                  maxLength={category === 'BSNL' ? 2000 : 500}
                  rows={5}
                  value={complaintText}
                  onChange={handleTextChange}
                  placeholder="DESCRIBE THE ISSUE IN DETAIL HERE..."
                  className="w-full border-2 border-slate-300 p-3 rounded-lg font-bold text-slate-800 outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition resize-none placeholder:text-slate-300 uppercase"
                />
              </div>

              {/* SEQUENTIAL ATTACHMENT HANDLER */}
              <div className={isDuplicateLocked || isQuotaLocked ? 'opacity-50 pointer-events-none' : ''}>
                <label className="block text-xs font-black text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest mb-2">Evidence / Attachments (Max 4)</label>
                
                {/* List of currently selected files */}
                {files.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="space-y-2 mb-3">
                    {files.map((file, idx) => (
                      <div key={idx} className="flex justify-between items-center bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 p-3 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold text-blue-800 shadow-sm animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95">
                        <span className="truncate pr-4">📎 {file.name}</span>
                        <button 
                          type="button" 
                          onClick={() => removeFile(idx)} 
                          className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700 hover:bg-red-50 w-6 h-6 flex items-center justify-center rounded-full font-black text-lg transition"
                          title="Remove attachment"
                        >
                          &times;
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* The Sequential "Add Attachment" Button */}
                {files.length < 4 && (
                  <div className="relative overflow-hidden inline-block w-full">
                    <button 
                      type="button" 
                      className="w-full bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 border-2 border-dashed border-slate-300 text-slate-600 font-black py-4 rounded-lg transition uppercase tracking-widest text-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm hover:shadow"
                    >
                      <span className="text-lg">➕</span> Add Attachment {files.length > 0 ? `(${files.length}/4)` : ''}
                    </button>
                    <input 
                      type="file" 
                      accept="image/*,application/pdf" 
                      onChange={handleFileAppend}
                      className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full opacity-0 cursor-pointer"
                    />
                  </div>
                )}
                <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 mt-2">Accepted formats: JPG, PNG, PDF (Max 5MB each)</p>
              </div>

              {/* LEGAL UNDERTAKING */}
              <div className={`bg-slate-100 p-4 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg flex items-start gap-3 ${(isDuplicateLocked || isQuotaLocked) ? 'opacity-50 pointer-events-none' : ''}`}>
                <input 
                  type="checkbox" 
                  id="undertaking"
                  required
                  checked={undertaking} 
                  onChange={(e) => setUndertaking(e.target.checked)}
                  className="w-5 h-5 accent-blue-600 cursor-pointer mt-0.5 shrink-0" 
                />
                <label htmlFor="undertaking" className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-600 cursor-pointer flex-1 leading-relaxed uppercase tracking-wider">
                  <span className="text-slate-900 font-black block mb-0.5">Mandatory Undertaking *</span>
                  I hereby confirm that the information provided is accurate and true. I understand that raising false, duplicate, or misleading complaints violates operational policies.
                </label>
              </div>

              {/* SUBMIT BUTTON */}
              <button 
                type="submit" 
                disabled={submitting || !issueType || isDuplicateLocked || isQuotaLocked || !undertaking} 
                className="w-full py-4 bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-black text-lg rounded-xl transition shadow-md disabled:bg-slate-300 disabled:text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-widest"
              >
                {submitting ? "Uploading Ticket..." : "Submit Ticket"}
              </button>

            </form>
          </div>


          {/* ======================= RIGHT: TICKET HISTORY ======================= */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden flex flex-col h-[800px]">
            <div className="p-6 bg-slate-900 text-white border-b border-slate-800">
              <h2 className="font-black text-lg flex items-center gap-2 tracking-wide">
                <span>📋</span> My Ticket History
              </h2>
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto bg-slate-50 p-4 space-y-4">
              {myTickets.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-10 text-center text-slate-400 font-bold">No tickets found.</div>
              ) : (
                myTickets.map(ticket => (
                  <div key={ticket.id} className="bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-5 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition relative">
                    
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-start mb-3">
                      <div>
                        <span className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-600 text-[10px] font-black uppercase px-2 py-0.5 rounded tracking-widest border border-slate-200">
                          {ticket.ticket_number}
                        </span>
                        <h3 className="font-black text-slate-800 mt-1">{ticket.issue_type}</h3>
                      </div>
                      
                      {/* DYNAMIC PIPELINE STATUS BADGE */}
                      <span className={`text-[10px] font-black px-2.5 py-1 rounded-sm uppercase tracking-widest shadow-sm ${
                        ticket.status === 'Resolved' ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200' :
                        ticket.status === 'Escalated L3' ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 border border-red-200' :
                        ticket.status === 'Escalated L2' ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200' :
                        'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200'
                      }`}>
                        {ticket.status}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded border border-slate-100 mb-3 italic">
                      "{ticket.complaint_text}"
                    </p>

                    <div className="flex justify-between items-end border-t border-slate-100 pt-3">
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest">
                        {new Date(ticket.created_at).toLocaleString('en-IN')}
                      </span>
                      {ticket.attachments?.length > 0 && (
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1">
                          📎 {ticket.attachments.length} files
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* RESOLUTION REMARKS RENDERER */}
                    {ticket.status === 'Resolved' && (
                      <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t-2 border-emerald-100 animate-in fade-in">
                        <p className="text-[10px] font-black text-emerald-600 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1 flex items-center gap-1"><span>✅</span> Official Resolution</p>
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
                          {ticket.l3_remarks || ticket.l2_remarks || ticket.l1_remarks || "Resolved by Management."}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    )}

                  </div>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
