"use client";
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { supabase } from "../../lib/supabase";

const sanitizeCSV = (val: unknown): string => {
  let str = String(val || "").replace(/"/g, '""');
  if (/^[=+\-@]/.test(str)) str = "'" + str;
  return `"${str}"`;
};

const numInputClass = "w-full border border-slate-300 p-2.5 rounded-lg font-bold outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 bg-white [appearance:textfield] [&::-webkit-outer-spin-button]:appearance-none [&::-webkit-inner-spin-button]:appearance-none";

export default function CommissionsModule({ hqLocations, mappedMasterCtopsForComms, rawCommissions, fetchArchitectureAndReports, reportingMonth, setReportingMonth, entryMasterLocId, setEntryMasterLocId }: any) {
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [commissionForm, setCommissionForm] = useState({ master_ctop_id: "", instant_commission: "", pending_commission: "" });

  const preventNegativeScroll = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === '-' || e.key === '+' || e.key === 'e' || e.key === 'E') e.preventDefault();
  };
  
  const handleWheel = (e: React.WheelEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
  };

  const handleCommissionSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!entryMasterLocId || !commissionForm.master_ctop_id) return alert("Select Master Location and CTOP.");
    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      const user = session?.user;
      if (!user) throw new Error("Auth drop.");

      const payload = {
        reporting_month: `${reportingMonth}-01`, 
        location_id: parseInt(entryMasterLocId), 
        master_ctop_id: commissionForm.master_ctop_id,
        instant_commission: parseFloat(commissionForm.instant_commission) || 0, 
        pending_commission: parseFloat(commissionForm.pending_commission) || 0, 
        logged_by: user.id
      };
      
      const { data: rec, error } = await supabase.from('mis_commissions').insert([payload]).select().single();
      if (error) throw error;

      await supabase.from('staff_activity_logs').insert([{ 
          staff_id: user.id, staff_email: user.email, action_type: 'MIS_ENTRY', module: 'MANAGER_MIS', target_id: rec.id, details: `Logged Commission: Instant ₹${payload.instant_commission}, Pending ₹${payload.pending_commission}.` 
      }]);
      
      alert("✅ Commission Ledger Updated.");
      setCommissionForm({ master_ctop_id: "", instant_commission: "", pending_commission: "" }); 
      fetchArchitectureAndReports();
    } catch (err: any) { 
      alert("Error: " + err.message); 
    } finally { 
      setIsSubmitting(false); 
    }
  };

  const downloadCSV = () => {
    if (rawCommissions.length === 0) return alert("No data available to export.");
    const csvContent = "Month,Location,CTOP,Instant_Comm,Pending_Comm\n" + 
      rawCommissions.map((r: any) => 
      `${r.reporting_month},${sanitizeCSV(r.locations?.center_name)},${r.master_ctop_accounts?.master_ctop_no},${r.instant_commission},${r.pending_commission}`
    ).join("\n");
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    link.download = `FastArk_MIS_Commissions_${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.csv`;
    link.click();
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 animate-in fade-in">
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 p-6 max-w-2xl mx-auto">
        <h2 className="font-black uppercase text-lg mb-6 border-b pb-4 text-slate-800">Log Commissions</h2>
        <div className="bg-slate-900 p-5 rounded-xl shadow-lg border border-slate-800 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-6">
           <div>
             <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-indigo-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1.5 block">1. HQ Hub</label>
             <select value={entryMasterLocId} onChange={(e) => setEntryMasterLocId(e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-slate-800 border-2 border-indigo-500 text-white text-xs font-bold p-2.5 rounded-lg outline-none focus:border-indigo-400 transition">
               <option value="">-- Select --</option>
               {hqLocations.map((hq: any) => <option key={hq.id} value={hq.id}>{hq.center_name}</option>)}
             </select>
           </div>
           <div>
             <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-widest mb-1.5 block">2. Month Context</label>
             <input type="month" value={reportingMonth} onChange={(e) => setReportingMonth(e.target.value)} className="w-full bg-slate-800 border-2 border-slate-700 text-white text-xs font-bold p-2.5 rounded-lg outline-none focus:border-indigo-400 transition"/>
           </div>
        </div>

        {!entryMasterLocId ? (
          <p className="text-center font-bold text-slate-400 py-8">Select a Master HQ above.</p>
        ) : (
          <form onSubmit={handleCommissionSubmit} className="space-y-6">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500 mb-1.5">Master CTOP *</label>
              <select required value={commissionForm.master_ctop_id} onChange={e => setCommissionForm({...commissionForm, master_ctop_id: e.target.value})} className={numInputClass}>
                <option value="" disabled>-- Select --</option>
                {mappedMasterCtopsForComms.map((m: any) => <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>{m.master_ctop_no}</option>)}
              </select>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500 mb-1.5">Instant Comm (₹) *</label>
                <input required type="number" step="0.01" min="0" value={commissionForm.instant_commission} onChange={e => setCommissionForm({...commissionForm, instant_commission: e.target.value})} onKeyDown={preventNegativeScroll} onWheel={handleWheel} className={numInputClass} />
              </div>
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500 mb-1.5">Pending Comm (₹) *</label>
                <input required type="number" step="0.01" min="0" value={commissionForm.pending_commission} onChange={e => setCommissionForm({...commissionForm, pending_commission: e.target.value})} onKeyDown={preventNegativeScroll} onWheel={handleWheel} className={numInputClass} />
              </div>
            </div>
            <button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting} className="w-full bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white font-black py-4 rounded-xl uppercase tracking-widest transition shadow-md mt-6">
              Log Commission
            </button>
          </form>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-4 bg-slate-900 flex justify-between items-center text-white">
          <h3 className="font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-xs">Commission Ledger</h3>
          <button onClick={downloadCSV} className="bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 px-3 py-1 rounded text-[10px] font-bold shadow transition">📥 CSV</button>
        </div>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
            <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-200">
              <tr><th className="p-4">Month</th><th className="p-4">Location & CTOP</th><th className="p-4 text-right">Instant (₹)</th><th className="p-4 text-right">Pending (₹)</th></tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
              {rawCommissions.slice(0, 50).map((c: any) => (
                <tr key={c.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50 transition">
                  <td className="p-4 font-black text-slate-800">{c.reporting_month}</td>
                  <td className="p-4 font-bold text-slate-800">{c.locations?.center_name} <span className="text-[10px] font-black tracking-widest text-slate-400 ml-2">{c.master_ctop_accounts?.master_ctop_no}</span></td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-right font-black text-amber-600">₹{Number(c.instant_commission).toLocaleString('en-IN', {minimumFractionDigits: 2})}</td>
                  <td className="p-4 text-right font-black text-amber-600">₹{Number(c.pending_commission).toLocaleString('en-IN', {minimumFractionDigits: 2})}</td>
                </tr>
              ))}
              {rawCommissions.length === 0 && <tr><td colSpan={4} className="p-8 text-center text-slate-500 font-bold">No commissions logged.</td></tr>}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// FILE PATH: ./app/update-password/page.tsx
"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { supabase } from "../lib/supabase";

export default function UpdatePasswordPage() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [password, setPassword] = useState("");
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState("");
  const [successMsg, setSuccessMsg] = useState("");

  const handlePasswordUpdate = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg("");
    setSuccessMsg("");

    if (password.length < 8) {
      return setErrorMsg("Password must be at least 8 characters long.");
    }

    if (password !== confirmPassword) {
      return setErrorMsg("Passwords do not match.");
    }

    setLoading(true);

    try {
      // 1. Verify active session
      const {
        data: { session },
      } = await supabase.auth.getSession();
      if (!session) {
        throw new Error(
          "No active recovery session found. Please request a new reset link."
        );
      }

      // 2. Update password and wipe the must_change_password flag
      const { error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({
        password: password,
        data: { must_change_password: false },
      });

      if (updateError) throw updateError;

      const userEmail = (session.user.email || "Unknown").trim().toLowerCase();

      // 3. Determine Staff vs Partner Role & Establish Active Session Token
      const { data: staff } = await supabase
        .from("back_office_staff")
        .select("id, role")
        .ilike("email", userEmail)
        .maybeSingle();

      const sessionPrefix = staff ? "STAFF" : "PARTNER";
      const sessionToken = `${sessionPrefix}_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()
        .toString(36)
        .substring(2)}`;

      let currentIp = "Unknown";
      try {
        const ipRes = await fetch("https://api.ipify.org?format=json");
        currentIp = (await ipRes.json()).ip;
      } catch (_) {}

      await supabase.from("active_sessions").upsert({
        user_id: session.user.id,
        session_token: sessionToken,
        ip_address: currentIp,
        last_active: new Date().toISOString(),
      });

      localStorage.setItem("fapl_session_token", sessionToken);

      // 4. ENTERPRISE SECURITY TELEMETRY (Immutable Audit Log)
      await supabase.from("staff_activity_logs").insert([
        {
          staff_id: session.user.id,
          staff_email: userEmail,
          action_type: "SECURITY_AUDIT",
          module: "AUTHENTICATION",
          target_id: session.user.id,
          details: `Credentials updated successfully. Password change locked. IP: ${currentIp}`,
        },
      ]);

      setSuccessMsg(
        "✅ Password updated securely! Routing to your designated command center..."
      );

      setTimeout(() => {
        if (staff) {
          const safeRole = String(staff.role || "")
            .trim()
            .toLowerCase();
          router.push(
            safeRole === "supervisor"
              ? "/dashboard/supervisor-hub"
              : "/dashboard"
          );
        } else {
          router.push("/partner/dashboard");
        }
      }, 1500);
    } catch (err: any) {
      setErrorMsg(err.message || "Failed to update password.");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-900 flex flex-col justify-center items-center p-4 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-slate-950 p-8 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-800">
        <div className="text-center mb-6">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-blue-600 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-white font-black text-2xl mx-auto mb-3 shadow-md">
            🔒
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-white uppercase tracking-wider">
            Set New Password
          </h1>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold mt-1">
            Please choose a strong password to secure your Fast Ark portal
            access.
          </p>
        </div>

        {errorMsg && (
          <div className="mb-4 p-3 bg-red-950/60 border border-red-800 text-red-300 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg leading-relaxed">
            ❌ {errorMsg}
          </div>
        )}

        {successMsg && (
          <div className="mb-4 p-3 bg-emerald-950/60 border border-emerald-800 text-emerald-300 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg leading-relaxed">
            {successMsg}
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handlePasswordUpdate} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 mb-1.5">
              New Password (Min 8 Characters) *
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              required
              minLength={8}
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="••••••••••••"
              className="w-full p-3 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition"
              disabled={loading}
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 mb-1.5">
              Confirm New Password *
            </label>
            <input
              type="password"
              required
              minLength={8}
              value={confirmPassword}
              onChange={(e) => setConfirmPassword(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="••••••••••••"
              className="w-full p-3 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500 transition"
              disabled={loading}
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full py-3.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest rounded-xl transition shadow-lg disabled:opacity-50 mt-2"
          >
            {loading ? "Updating Credentials & Routing..." : "Save & Continue"}
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";

export default function ForgotPasswordPage() {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [statusMsg, setStatusMsg] = useState("");
  const [isError, setIsError] = useState(false);

  const handleResetRequest = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    setStatusMsg("");
    setIsError(false);

    const targetEmail = email.trim().toLowerCase();

    try {
      // 1. Route the request through the secure backend API to bypass RLS blocks
      const response = await fetch('/api/forgot-password', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ email: targetEmail })
      });

      const data = await response.json();

      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(data.error || "Failed to dispatch reset link.");
      }

      // 2. Handle Success
      setIsError(false);
      setStatusMsg(data.message);
      setEmail("");
      
    } catch (err: any) {
      // 3. Handle Rejection
      setIsError(true);
      setStatusMsg("❌ " + err.message);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-900 flex items-center justify-center p-4 font-sans">
      <div className="max-w-md w-full bg-slate-950 p-8 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-800">
        
        <div className="text-center mb-6">
          <div className="w-12 h-12 bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-white font-black text-2xl mx-auto mb-3 shadow-md">
            🔑
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-white uppercase tracking-wider">Reset Password</h1>
          <p className="text-slate-400 text-xs font-bold mt-1">
            Enter your official registered email to receive an authorized recovery link.
          </p>
        </div>

        {statusMsg && (
          <div className={`mb-4 p-4 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg border leading-relaxed ${
            isError ? "bg-red-950/60 border-red-800 text-red-300" : "bg-emerald-950/60 border-emerald-800 text-emerald-300"
          }`}>
            {statusMsg}
          </div>
        )}

        <form onSubmit={handleResetRequest} className="space-y-4">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 mb-1.5">
              Registered Email Address *
            </label>
            <input
              type="email"
              required
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="name@fastark.in"
              className="w-full p-3 bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold text-white outline-none focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 transition placeholder:text-slate-600"
              disabled={loading}
            />
          </div>

          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="w-full py-3.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-black text-xs uppercase tracking-widest rounded-xl transition shadow-lg disabled:opacity-50 mt-2"
          >
            {loading ? "Verifying & Dispatching..." : "Send Password Reset Link"}
          </button>
        </form>

        <div className="mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-slate-800 text-center">
          <Link href="/login" className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-400 hover:text-white transition">
            &larr; Back to Login
          </Link>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// FILE PATH: ./app/lib/ocrEngine.ts
import Tesseract from "tesseract.js";

const preprocessReceiptImage = (file: File): Promise<Blob | File> => {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const img = new Image();
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);

    img.onload = () => {
      try {
        const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
        const scale = img.width < 1100 ? 2 : 1;
        canvas.width = img.width * scale;
        canvas.height = img.height * scale;
        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

        if (!ctx) {
          URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
          return resolve(file);
        }

        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        const imgData = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
        const d = imgData.data;

        let totalLum = 0;
        const pixelCount = d.length / 4;
        for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) {
          totalLum += 0.299 * d[i] + 0.587 * d[i + 1] + 0.114 * d[i + 2];
        }
        const isDarkTheme = totalLum / pixelCount < 115;

        for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) {
          let gray = 0.299 * d[i] + 0.587 * d[i + 1] + 0.114 * d[i + 2];
          if (isDarkTheme) gray = 255 - gray;
          const contrast = 1.45;
          gray = Math.min(255, Math.max(0, contrast * (gray - 128) + 128));
          d[i] = d[i + 1] = d[i + 2] = gray;
        }

        ctx.putImageData(imgData, 0, 0);
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        canvas.toBlob((blob) => resolve(blob || file), "image/png", 1.0);
      } catch (_) {
        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        resolve(file);
      }
    };

    img.onerror = () => {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      resolve(file);
    };

    img.src = url;
  });
};

export interface OCRReceiptData {
  platform: string;
  method: string;
  amount: number | null;
  utr: string | null;
  transactionId: string | null;
  date: string | null;
}

export async function scanPaymentReceiptOCR(
  file: File,
  preset = "auto",
  onProgress?: (pct: number) => void
): Promise<OCRReceiptData> {
  const enhancedImage = await preprocessReceiptImage(file);

  const worker = await Tesseract.createWorker("eng", 1, {
    logger: (m) => {
      if (m.status === "recognizing text" && m.progress && onProgress) {
        onProgress(Math.round(m.progress * 100));
      }
    },
  });

  const {
    data: { text },
  } = await worker.recognize(enhancedImage);
  await worker.terminate();

  const raw = text.toLowerCase();
  const lines = text
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .map((l) => l.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

  // 1. Identify Payment Platform & Method
  let platform = "Payment Receipt";
  let method = "UPI";

  if (
    preset === "gpay" ||
    raw.includes("google pay") ||
    raw.includes("gpay") ||
    raw.includes("okaxis") ||
    raw.includes("okhdfcbank") ||
    raw.includes("okicici")
  ) {
    platform = "Google Pay";
    method = "UPI";
  } else if (
    preset === "phonepe" ||
    raw.includes("phonepe") ||
    raw.includes("ybl") ||
    raw.includes("ibl") ||
    raw.includes("axl")
  ) {
    platform = "PhonePe";
    method = "UPI";
  } else if (preset === "paytm" || raw.includes("paytm")) {
    platform = "Paytm";
    method = "UPI";
  } else if (
    preset === "cash_slip" ||
    raw.includes("cash deposit") ||
    raw.includes("challan") ||
    raw.includes("teller") ||
    raw.includes("denomination")
  ) {
    platform = "Bank Cash Slip";
    method = "Cash Deposit";
  } else if (
    preset === "neft_imps" ||
    raw.includes("neft") ||
    raw.includes("rtgs") ||
    raw.includes("imps")
  ) {
    platform = raw.includes("imps") ? "IMPS" : "NEFT/RTGS";
    method = platform;
  }

  // 2. Multi-Pass Amount Extraction
  const amountCandidates: number[] = [];

  // Pass 1: Explicit labeled amounts (₹, Rs, INR, Paid, Amount, Total)
  const labeledRegexes = [
    /(?:₹|rs\.?|inr|amount\s*paid|total\s*amount|paid\s*to|amount|amt|total)\s*[:\-₹\s]*([1-9]\d{0,2}(?:,\d{2,3})+(?:\.\d{1,2})?|[1-9]\d{1,5}(?:\.\d{1,2})?)/gi,
    /([1-9]\d{0,2}(?:,\d{2,3})+(?:\.\d{1,2})?)\s*(?:only|\/\-)/gi,
  ];

  for (const rgx of labeledRegexes) {
    for (const match of text.matchAll(rgx)) {
      if (match[1]) {
        const cleanVal = parseFloat(match[1].replace(/,/g, ""));
        if (
          !isNaN(cleanVal) &&
          cleanVal >= 10 &&
          cleanVal <= 1000000 &&
          !(cleanVal >= 2020 && cleanVal <= 2035)
        ) {
          amountCandidates.push(cleanVal);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Pass 2: Comma-formatted numbers in the top lines of UPI screenshots (handles cases where '₹' was misread as '2' or '7' or dropped)
  if (amountCandidates.length === 0) {
    for (const line of lines.slice(0, 14)) {
      const commaMatch = line.match(/\b([1-9]\d{0,2}(?:,\d{2,3})+(?:\.\d{2})?)\b/);
      if (commaMatch) {
        let rawNumStr = commaMatch[1].replace(/,/g, "");
        // If Tesseract turned '₹ 1,250' into '21,250' or '71,250', strip the false leading '2' or '7' when preceded by no spaces
        if (
          rawNumStr.length >= 5 &&
          (rawNumStr.startsWith("2") || rawNumStr.startsWith("7")) &&
          !line.includes("₹")
        ) {
          const stripped = parseFloat(rawNumStr.slice(1));
          if (!isNaN(stripped) && stripped >= 50 && stripped % 25 === 0) {
            amountCandidates.push(stripped);
            continue;
          }
        }
        const val = parseFloat(rawNumStr);
        if (!isNaN(val) && val >= 10 && val <= 500000) {
          amountCandidates.push(val);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Pass 3: Standalone decimal currency values (e.g., 4800.00) or clean 2-to-5 digit amounts near "completed/successful"
  if (amountCandidates.length === 0) {
    const decMatches = text.match(/\b([1-9]\d{1,5}\.\d{2})\b/g);
    if (decMatches) {
      for (const dm of decMatches) {
        const val = parseFloat(dm);
        if (!isNaN(val) && val >= 10 && val <= 500000) amountCandidates.push(val);
      }
    }
  }

  if (amountCandidates.length === 0) {
    for (const line of lines.slice(0, 10)) {
      const standalone = line.match(/^[₹27]?\s*([1-9]\d{1,4})$/);
      if (standalone && standalone[1]) {
        const val = parseFloat(standalone[1]);
        if (val >= 25 && val <= 100000 && !(val >= 2020 && val <= 2035)) {
          amountCandidates.push(val);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  const extractedAmount = amountCandidates.length > 0 ? amountCandidates[0] : null;

  // 3. Extract Unique UTR & Secondary Transaction ID
  let extractedUtr: string | null = null;
  let extractedTxnId: string | null = null;

  const utrMatch = text.match(
    /(?:upi\s*ref(?:\s*no|\s*id)?|utr(?:\s*no|\s*number)?|rrn|ref\s*no)[:\s#.\-]*([0-9\s]{10,16})/i
  );
  if (utrMatch && utrMatch[1]) {
    const cleanDigits = utrMatch[1].replace(/\D/g, "");
    if (cleanDigits.length >= 10 && cleanDigits.length <= 16) {
      extractedUtr = cleanDigits;
    }
  }

  if (!extractedUtr) {
    const spacedUtr = text.match(/\b(\d{4}\s?\d{4}\s?\d{4})\b/);
    if (spacedUtr && spacedUtr[1]) {
      extractedUtr = spacedUtr[1].replace(/\s+/g, "");
    }
  }

  const txnMatch = text.match(
    /(?:google\s*transaction\s*id|phonepe\s*transaction\s*id|transaction\s*id|txn\s*id|journal(?:\s*no)?|scroll(?:\s*no)?|challan(?:\s*no)?)[:\s#.\-]*([A-Za-z0-9\-]{6,28})/i
  );
  if (txnMatch && txnMatch[1]) {
    extractedTxnId = txnMatch[1].trim();
  }

  if (!extractedUtr && extractedTxnId) {
    extractedUtr = extractedTxnId;
  }
  if (!extractedTxnId && extractedUtr) {
    extractedTxnId = extractedUtr;
  }

  // 4. Extract Receipt Date (YYYY-MM-DD)
  const monthMap: Record<string, string> = {
    jan: "01", feb: "02", mar: "03", apr: "04", may: "05", jun: "06",
    jul: "07", aug: "08", sep: "09", oct: "10", nov: "11", dec: "12",
  };
  let parsedDate: string | null = null;

  const dmyMatch = text.match(/\b([0-3]?\d)[\/\-\.]([0-1]?\d)[\/\-\.](202\d)\b/);
  const ddMonYyyy = text.match(/\b([0-3]?\d)\s+([A-Za-z]{3,9})[,\s]+(202\d)\b/);
  const monDdYyyy = text.match(/\b([A-Za-z]{3,9})\s+([0-3]?\d),?\s+(202\d)\b/);

  if (dmyMatch) {
    parsedDate = `${dmyMatch[3]}-${dmyMatch[2].padStart(2, "0")}-${dmyMatch[1].padStart(2, "0")}`;
  } else if (ddMonYyyy) {
    const m = monthMap[ddMonYyyy[2].toLowerCase().substring(0, 3)];
    if (m) parsedDate = `${ddMonYyyy[3]}-${m}-${ddMonYyyy[1].padStart(2, "0")}`;
  } else if (monDdYyyy) {
    const m = monthMap[monDdYyyy[1].toLowerCase().substring(0, 3)];
    if (m) parsedDate = `${monDdYyyy[3]}-${m}-${monDdYyyy[2].padStart(2, "0")}`;
  }

  return {
    platform,
    method,
    amount: extractedAmount,
    utr: extractedUtr,
    transactionId: extractedTxnId,
    date: parsedDate,
  };
}

export const getLocalDateString = (date: Date) => {
  return new Date(date.getTime() - date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000).toISOString().split('T')[0];
};

export const normalizeToYYYYMMDD = (dateStr: string) => {
  if (!dateStr) return "";
  if (dateStr.includes('/')) {
    const parts = dateStr.split('/');
    if (parts.length === 3) return `${parts[2]}-${parts[1].padStart(2, '0')}-${parts[0].padStart(2, '0')}`;
  } 
  if (dateStr.includes('-')) {
    const dateOnly = dateStr.split('T')[0];
    const parts = dateOnly.split('-');
    if (parts[0].length === 4) return dateOnly; 
    if (parts[2].length === 4) return `${parts[2]}-${parts[1].padStart(2, '0')}-${parts[0].padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
  return dateStr.split('T')[0];
};

export const formatToDDMMYYYY = (dateStr: string) => {
  const yyyymmdd = normalizeToYYYYMMDD(dateStr);
  if (!yyyymmdd.includes('-')) return dateStr;
  const [y, m, d] = yyyymmdd.split('-');
  return `${d}/${m}/${y}`;
};

export const sanitizeCSV = (str: any) => `"${String(str || '').replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;

export const executePartnerSalesCSVExport = (exportData: any[], timeFilter: string) => {
  if (exportData.length === 0) {
    alert("No data to export for this time period.");
    return;
  }

  const headers = [
    "Report Date", "CBP Landline", "CBP GSM", "CTOP Amount", "FRC Amount", "MNP Amount",
    "SIM New Qty", "SIM Upgrade Qty", "SIM Replace Qty", "SIM Replace Amt",
    "Fancy Qty", "Fancy Amt", "Postpaid Qty", "Postpaid Amt", "Paybull Cash", "Other Amount", "Cheque Amount", "Audited Status"
  ];

  const csvContent = [
    headers.join(","),
    ...exportData.map(s => {
      const pbCash = Number(s.pb_cbp_amt||0) + Number(s.pb_ctop_amt||0) + Number(s.pb_frc_amt||0) + Number(s.pb_mnp_amt||0) + Number(s.pb_other_amt||0);
      return [
        sanitizeCSV(formatToDDMMYYYY(s.report_date)),
        s.cbp_landline_amt || 0, s.cbp_gsm_amt || 0, s.ctop_recharge_amt || 0, s.frc_amt || 0, s.mnp_amt || 0,
        s.sim_new_qty || 0, s.sim_upgrade_qty || 0, s.sim_replacement_qty || 0, s.sim_replacement_amt || 0,
        s.sim_fancy_qty || 0, s.sim_fancy_amt || 0, s.sim_postpaid_qty || 0, s.sim_postpaid_amt || 0,
        pbCash, s.other_amt || 0, s.cheque_amt || 0, sanitizeCSV(s.is_edited_by_staff ? "Audited" : "Original")
      ].join(",");
    })
  ].join("\n");

  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  
  const todayStr = getLocalDateString(new Date());
  link.download = `FastArk_Sales_${timeFilter}_${formatToDDMMYYYY(todayStr).replace(/\//g, '-')}.csv`;
  link.click();
};

// FILE PATH: ./app/lib/aadhaarEngine.ts
import { PDFDocument, rgb, StandardFonts } from "pdf-lib";

// --- STRICT INDIAN STANDARD DATE FORMATTERS (DD/MM/YYYY) ---
export const getISTDateString = (offsetDays = 0): string => {
  const now = new Date();
  const istTime = new Date(now.getTime() + (330 + now.getTimezoneOffset()) * 60000);
  if (offsetDays !== 0) istTime.setDate(istTime.getDate() + offsetDays);
  const y = istTime.getFullYear();
  const m = String(istTime.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const d = String(istTime.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
};

export const formatToDDMMYYYY = (yyyy_mm_dd: string): string => {
  if (!yyyy_mm_dd) return "";
  const clean = yyyy_mm_dd.split("T")[0];
  const parts = clean.split("-");
  if (parts.length !== 3) return yyyy_mm_dd;
  return `${parts[2]}/${parts[1]}/${parts[0]}`;
};

export const convertDDMMYYYYtoYYYYMMDD = (dd_mm_yyyy: string): string => {
  const parts = dd_mm_yyyy.trim().split("/");
  if (parts.length !== 3) return dd_mm_yyyy;
  return `${parts[2]}-${parts[1].padStart(2, "0")}-${parts[0].padStart(2, "0")}`;
};

// --- SHARED 7-OPTION DATE PRESET ENGINE (IST SAFE) ---
export type DatePresetMode =
  | "today"
  | "yesterday"
  | "current_week"
  | "current_month"
  | "previous_month"
  | "all"
  | "custom";

export const getDateRangeFromPreset = (preset: DatePresetMode): { start: string; end: string } => {
  const now = new Date();
  const istNow = new Date(now.getTime() + (330 + now.getTimezoneOffset()) * 60000);

  const formatYMD = (d: Date) => {
    const year = d.getFullYear();
    const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
    const day = String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
    return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
  };

  const todayStr = formatYMD(istNow);

  if (preset === "today") {
    return { start: todayStr, end: todayStr };
  }
  if (preset === "yesterday") {
    const yest = new Date(istNow);
    yest.setDate(yest.getDate() - 1);
    const yStr = formatYMD(yest);
    return { start: yStr, end: yStr };
  }
  if (preset === "current_week") {
    const startOfWeek = new Date(istNow);
    const day = startOfWeek.getDay();
    const diffToMonday = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day;
    startOfWeek.setDate(startOfWeek.getDate() + diffToMonday);
    return { start: formatYMD(startOfWeek), end: todayStr };
  }
  if (preset === "current_month") {
    const firstDay = new Date(istNow.getFullYear(), istNow.getMonth(), 1);
    return { start: formatYMD(firstDay), end: todayStr };
  }
  if (preset === "previous_month") {
    const firstDayPrev = new Date(istNow.getFullYear(), istNow.getMonth() - 1, 1);
    const lastDayPrev = new Date(istNow.getFullYear(), istNow.getMonth(), 0);
    return { start: formatYMD(firstDayPrev), end: formatYMD(lastDayPrev) };
  }
  if (preset === "all") {
    return { start: "2020-01-01", end: todayStr };
  }
  return { start: todayStr, end: todayStr };
};

// Slices YYYYMMDD from 28-char Enrolment ID
export const extractDateFromEID = (eid: string): string => {
  const clean = eid.trim();
  if (clean.length < 22) return "";
  const yyyymmdd = clean.slice(14, 22);
  if (!/^\d{8}$/.test(yyyymmdd)) return "";
  return `${yyyymmdd.slice(0, 4)}-${yyyymmdd.slice(4, 6)}-${yyyymmdd.slice(6, 8)}`;
};

// Quote-safe CSV line splitter
const parseCSVLine = (line: string): string[] => {
  const result: string[] = [];
  let current = "";
  let inQuotes = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
    const char = line[i];
    if (char === '"') {
      inQuotes = !inQuotes;
    } else if (char === "," && !inQuotes) {
      result.push(current.trim());
      current = "";
    } else {
      current += char;
    }
  }
  result.push(current.trim());
  return result;
};

export interface TariffRule {
  new_enrolment_fee: number;
  mbu_free_fee: number;
  mbu_chargeable_fee: number;
  demographic_fee: number;
  biometric_fee: number;
  demo_min_threshold: number;
  demo_max_threshold: number;
  bio_min_threshold: number;
  gst_percent: number;
  daily_late_penalty: number;
}

// --- 5-CATEGORY CLASSIFICATION RULE ENGINE ---
export const classifyEnrollmentRow = (
  type: string,
  mbu: string,
  totalAmt: number,
  tariff: Partial<TariffRule> | any
): "CAT1_NEW" | "CAT2_MBU_FREE" | "CAT3_MBU_PAID" | "CAT4_DEMO" | "CAT5_BIO" | "INVALID" => {
  const t = type.trim().toUpperCase();
  const m = mbu.trim().toUpperCase();
  const amt = Number(totalAmt);

  const demoMin = Number(tariff?.demo_min_threshold ?? 50);
  const demoMax = Number(tariff?.demo_max_threshold ?? 100);
  const bioMin = Number(tariff?.bio_min_threshold ?? 100);

  if (t === "N" && m === "NO" && amt === 0) return "CAT1_NEW";
  if (t === "U" && m === "YES" && amt === 0) return "CAT2_MBU_FREE";
  if (t === "U" && m === "YES" && amt > 0) return "CAT3_MBU_PAID";
  if (t === "U" && m === "NO" && amt > demoMin && amt < demoMax) return "CAT4_DEMO";
  if (t === "U" && m === "NO" && amt >= bioMin) return "CAT5_BIO";
  return "INVALID";
};

// --- DUAL CSV + HTML PARSER & CROSS-VERIFIER ---
export const parseAndValidateDualFiles = async (
  csvFile: File,
  htmlFile: File,
  mode: "DAILY" | "WEEKLY",
  expectedDateOrRange: { reportDate?: string; startDate?: string; endDate?: string },
  expectedOperatorId: string,
  expectedStationId: string,
  activeTariff: Partial<TariffRule> | any
) => {
  if (!expectedOperatorId.trim() || !expectedStationId.trim()) {
    throw new Error(
      "Profile Not Mapped: Your UIDAI Operator ID and Station ID are not yet mapped to your profile. Please submit your details in '6. Credentials & Upgrade' or contact Admin."
    );
  }

  const [csvText, htmlText] = await Promise.all([csvFile.text(), htmlFile.text()]);

  const parser = new DOMParser();
  const doc = parser.parseFromString(htmlText, "text/html");

  const metaMap: Record<string, string> = {};
  doc.querySelectorAll(".first_view table tr").forEach((tr) => {
    const tds = tr.querySelectorAll("td");
    if (tds.length >= 2) {
      const key = (tds[0].textContent || "").trim().toLowerCase();
      const val = (tds[1].textContent || "").trim();
      metaMap[key] = val;
    }
  });

  const htmlOperator = (metaMap["operator"] || "").toUpperCase();
  const htmlStation = (metaMap["station id"] || "").trim();
  const pickDateHeader = (doc.querySelector(".pick_date h3")?.textContent || "").trim();

  if (htmlOperator !== expectedOperatorId.trim().toUpperCase()) {
    throw new Error(
      `Operator Mismatch: HTML file belongs to '${htmlOperator}', but your profile is '${expectedOperatorId}'.`
    );
  }
  if (htmlStation !== expectedStationId.trim()) {
    throw new Error(
      `Station ID Mismatch: HTML file belongs to Station '${htmlStation}', but your assigned Station is '${expectedStationId}'.`
    );
  }

  const dateMatches = pickDateHeader.match(/(\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4})\s+to\s+(\d{2}\/\d{2}\/\d{4})/i);
  if (!dateMatches) {
    throw new Error(
      "Invalid HTML Report: Could not locate 'Report Generated for Date: DD/MM/YYYY to DD/MM/YYYY' header."
    );
  }
  const htmlFromYYYYMMDD = convertDDMMYYYYtoYYYYMMDD(dateMatches[1]);
  const htmlToYYYYMMDD = convertDDMMYYYYtoYYYYMMDD(dateMatches[2]);

  if (mode === "DAILY") {
    if (
      htmlFromYYYYMMDD !== expectedDateOrRange.reportDate ||
      htmlToYYYYMMDD !== expectedDateOrRange.reportDate
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `Date Mismatch: Selected date is ${formatToDDMMYYYY(
          expectedDateOrRange.reportDate!
        )}, but HTML report was generated for ${dateMatches[1]} to ${dateMatches[2]}.`
      );
    }
  } else {
    if (
      htmlFromYYYYMMDD !== expectedDateOrRange.startDate ||
      htmlToYYYYMMDD !== expectedDateOrRange.endDate
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `Weekly Date Range Mismatch: Selected ${formatToDDMMYYYY(
          expectedDateOrRange.startDate!
        )} to ${formatToDDMMYYYY(
          expectedDateOrRange.endDate!
        )}, but HTML file is for ${dateMatches[1]} to ${dateMatches[2]}.`
      );
    }
  }

  const htmlRows: any[] = [];
  doc.querySelectorAll(".details_view table tbody tr").forEach((tr) => {
    const tds = Array.from(tr.querySelectorAll("td")).map((td) =>
      (td.textContent || "").trim()
    );
    if (tds.length >= 19) {
      htmlRows.push({
        sno: tds[0],
        eid: tds[1],
        type: tds[3],
        mbu: tds[4],
        operator: tds[7],
        status: tds[12],
        gstPct: parseFloat(tds[15]) || 0,
        newAmt: parseFloat(tds[16]) || 0,
        updateAmt: parseFloat(tds[17]) || 0,
        totalAmt: parseFloat(tds[18]) || 0,
      });
    }
  });

  const csvLines = csvText
    .split(/\r?\n/)
    .map((l) => l.trim())
    .filter((l) => l.length > 0);
  if (csvLines.length < 2) throw new Error("CSV file is empty or missing headers.");

  const csvRows = csvLines.slice(1).map((line) => {
    const cols = parseCSVLine(line);
    return {
      sno: (cols[0] || "").trim(),
      eid: (cols[1] || "").trim(),
      type: (cols[3] || "").trim(),
      mbu: (cols[4] || "").trim(),
      operator: (cols[7] || "").trim(),
      status: (cols[11] || "").trim(),
      gstPct: parseFloat(cols[12]) || 0,
      newAmt: parseFloat(cols[13]) || 0,
      updateAmt: parseFloat(cols[14]) || 0,
      totalAmt: parseFloat(cols[15]) || 0,
    };
  });

  if (csvRows.length !== htmlRows.length) {
    throw new Error(
      `File Parity Error: CSV contains ${csvRows.length} rows, but HTML contains ${htmlRows.length} rows. Both files must match.`
    );
  }

  let cat1_new_qty = 0,
    cat2_mbu_free_qty = 0,
    cat3_mbu_chargeable_qty = 0,
    cat4_demographic_qty = 0,
    cat5_biometric_qty = 0;
  let completed_qty = 0,
    inprocess_qty = 0,
    rejected_qty = 0;
  let base_amount = 0,
    total_cash_collected = 0;

  const dailyBuckets: Record<
    string,
    {
      date: string;
      cat1: number;
      cat2: number;
      cat3: number;
      cat4: number;
      cat5: number;
      totalPkts: number;
      completed: number;
      inprocess: number;
      rejected: number;
      totalCash: number;
    }
  > = {};

  for (let i = 0; i < csvRows.length; i++) {
    const c = csvRows[i];
    const h = htmlRows[i];

    if (
      c.eid !== h.eid ||
      c.type !== h.type ||
      c.mbu !== h.mbu ||
      Math.abs(c.totalAmt - h.totalAmt) > 0.01
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        `Row #${i + 1} Mismatch (${
          c.eid
        }): CSV and HTML values do not match. Ensure both files are from the exact same export.`
      );
    }

    const eidDate = extractDateFromEID(c.eid);
    if (mode === "DAILY" && eidDate !== expectedDateOrRange.reportDate) {
      throw new Error(
        `Packet Date Mismatch on Row #${i + 1} (${c.eid}): Packet date is ${formatToDDMMYYYY(
          eidDate
        )}, expected ${formatToDDMMYYYY(expectedDateOrRange.reportDate!)}.`
      );
    }

    const cat = classifyEnrollmentRow(c.type, c.mbu, c.totalAmt, activeTariff);
    if (cat === "INVALID") {
      throw new Error(
        `Unrecognized UIDAI Category on Row #${i + 1} (${c.eid}): Type=${c.type}, MBU=${
          c.mbu
        }, Amt=₹${c.totalAmt}.`
      );
    }

    const st = c.status.toUpperCase();
    if (st.includes("REJECT")) rejected_qty++;
    else if (st.includes("COMPLETE")) completed_qty++;
    else inprocess_qty++;

    if (cat === "CAT1_NEW") cat1_new_qty++;
    else if (cat === "CAT2_MBU_FREE") cat2_mbu_free_qty++;
    else if (cat === "CAT3_MBU_PAID") cat3_mbu_chargeable_qty++;
    else if (cat === "CAT4_DEMO") cat4_demographic_qty++;
    else if (cat === "CAT5_BIO") cat5_biometric_qty++;

    base_amount += c.newAmt + c.updateAmt;
    total_cash_collected += c.totalAmt;

    if (!dailyBuckets[eidDate]) {
      dailyBuckets[eidDate] = {
        date: eidDate,
        cat1: 0,
        cat2: 0,
        cat3: 0,
        cat4: 0,
        cat5: 0,
        totalPkts: 0,
        completed: 0,
        inprocess: 0,
        rejected: 0,
        totalCash: 0,
      };
    }
    const b = dailyBuckets[eidDate];
    b.totalPkts++;
    b.totalCash += c.totalAmt;
    if (cat === "CAT1_NEW") b.cat1++;
    if (cat === "CAT2_MBU_FREE") b.cat2++;
    if (cat === "CAT3_MBU_PAID") b.cat3++;
    if (cat === "CAT4_DEMO") b.cat4++;
    if (cat === "CAT5_BIO") b.cat5++;
    if (st.includes("REJECT")) b.rejected++;
    else if (st.includes("COMPLETE")) b.completed++;
    else b.inprocess++;
  }

  const gst_amount = Math.max(0, total_cash_collected - base_amount);

  return {
    operator_id: htmlOperator,
    station_id: htmlStation,
    cat1_new_qty,
    cat2_mbu_free_qty,
    cat3_mbu_chargeable_qty,
    cat4_demographic_qty,
    cat5_biometric_qty,
    total_packets_qty: csvRows.length,
    completed_qty,
    inprocess_qty,
    rejected_qty,
    base_amount: Number(base_amount.toFixed(2)),
    gst_amount: Number(gst_amount.toFixed(2)),
    total_cash_collected: Number(total_cash_collected.toFixed(2)),
    daily_breakdown: Object.values(dailyBuckets).sort((a, b) =>
      a.date.localeCompare(b.date)
    ),
  };
};

// --- AUTOMATED LATE PAYMENT PENALTY SYNC ENGINE (RESPECTS WAIVE-OFFS & CUMULATIVE DEPOSITS) ---
export const syncAadhaarLatePenalties = async (supabase: any, partnerId: string) => {
  const todayIST = getISTDateString(0);

  const [overdueRes, tariffRes, existingPenRes] = await Promise.all([
    supabase
      .from("aadhaar_daily_reports")
      .select("id, report_date, total_cash_collected, deposit_status")
      .eq("partner_id", partnerId)
      .eq("deposit_status", "Pending Deposit")
      .gt("total_cash_collected", 0)
      .lt("report_date", todayIST),
    supabase
      .from("aadhaar_tariff_history")
      .select("daily_late_penalty")
      .is("effective_to", null)
      .order("effective_from", { ascending: false })
      .limit(1)
      .maybeSingle(),
    supabase
      .from("aadhaar_penalty_logs")
      .select("daily_report_id, penalty_for_date, is_waived, is_settled")
      .eq("partner_id", partnerId),
  ]);

  const overdueReports = overdueRes.data;
  if (!overdueReports || overdueReports.length === 0) return;

  const existingKeys = new Set(
    (existingPenRes.data || []).map(
      (p: any) => `${p.daily_report_id}_${p.penalty_for_date}`
    )
  );

  const penaltyRate = Number(tariffRes.data?.daily_late_penalty || 100.0);

  for (const rep of overdueReports) {
    const repDate = new Date(`${rep.report_date}T00:00:00+05:30`);
    const curDate = new Date(`${todayIST}T00:00:00+05:30`);
    const diffDays = Math.floor(
      (curDate.getTime() - repDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)
    );

    if (diffDays <= 0) continue;

    for (let d = 1; d <= diffDays; d++) {
      const penaltyDateObj = new Date(repDate.getTime() + d * 86400000);
      const pDateStr = penaltyDateObj.toISOString().split("T")[0];
      const compositeKey = `${rep.id}_${pDateStr}`;

      // Skip if this day's penalty was already logged, settled, or waived off by Admin
      if (existingKeys.has(compositeKey)) continue;

      const { data: inserted, error } = await supabase
        .from("aadhaar_penalty_logs")
        .insert([
          {
            partner_id: partnerId,
            daily_report_id: rep.id,
            report_date: rep.report_date,
            penalty_for_date: pDateStr,
            penalty_amount: penaltyRate,
          },
        ])
        .select()
        .maybeSingle();

      if (inserted && !error) {
        existingKeys.add(compositeKey);
        await supabase.from("partner_messages").insert([
          {
            partner_id: partnerId,
            subject: `🚨 LATE DEPOSIT PENALTY (₹${penaltyRate}): Aadhaar Report ${formatToDDMMYYYY(
              rep.report_date
            )}`,
            body: `Your Aadhaar cash collection of ₹${Number(
              rep.total_cash_collected
            ).toLocaleString("en-IN")} for ${formatToDDMMYYYY(
              rep.report_date
            )} was not deposited before closing. A late payment penalty of ₹${penaltyRate.toFixed(
              2
            )} (Day ${d}) has been added to your pending balance ledger for ${formatToDDMMYYYY(
              pDateStr
            )}. Please scan and pay immediately.`,
          },
        ]);
      }
    }
  }
};

// --- MULTI-FORMAT EXPORT ENGINE (CSV & OFFICIAL A4 PDF) ---
export const downloadAadhaarCSVReport = (reports: any[], filterLabel: string) => {
  if (reports.length === 0)
    return alert("No records available to export for the current filter.");

  const headers = [
    "Report Date (DD/MM/YYYY)",
    "Operator ID",
    "Station ID",
    "Submission Mode",
    "1. New Enrolment",
    "2. MBU Free",
    "3. MBU Chargeable",
    "4. Demographic Update",
    "5. Biometric Update",
    "Total Packets",
    "Completed",
    "InProcess",
    "Rejected",
    "Base Fee (INR)",
    "GST 18% (INR)",
    "Total Cash Collected (INR)",
    "Deposit Status",
    "Exemption / Remarks",
  ];

  const sanitize = (val: any) => `"${String(val ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;

  const rows = reports.map((r) => [
    sanitize(formatToDDMMYYYY(r.report_date)),
    sanitize(r.operator_id),
    sanitize(r.station_id),
    sanitize(
      r.has_files ? "With CSV & HTML Files" : "Without Files (Manual/Exemption)"
    ),
    r.cat1_new_qty || 0,
    r.cat2_mbu_free_qty || 0,
    r.cat3_mbu_chargeable_qty || 0,
    r.cat4_demographic_qty || 0,
    r.cat5_biometric_qty || 0,
    r.total_packets_qty || 0,
    r.completed_qty || 0,
    r.inprocess_qty || 0,
    r.rejected_qty || 0,
    r.base_amount || 0,
    r.gst_amount || 0,
    r.total_cash_collected || 0,
    sanitize(r.deposit_status),
    sanitize(r.exemption_reason || "Verified File Upload"),
  ]);

  const csvContent = [headers.join(","), ...rows.map((row) => row.join(","))].join(
    "\n"
  );
  const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  link.download = `FastArk_Aadhaar_${filterLabel}_${formatToDDMMYYYY(
    getISTDateString()
  ).replace(/\//g, "-")}.csv`;
  link.click();
};

FILE PATH: ./app/lib/pdfEngine.ts

import { PDFDocument, rgb, StandardFonts } from "pdf-lib";

export const buildCompliancePDF = async (
  partnerEmail: string,
  centerName: string,
  userIp: string,
  requiredDocs: string[],
  docFiles: Record<string, File | File[] | null>,
  onProgress: (msg: string) => void
): Promise<Uint8Array> => {
  
  onProgress("Merging documents into a secure PDF...");

  const pdfDoc = await PDFDocument.create();
  const trackingFont = await pdfDoc.embedFont(StandardFonts.HelveticaBold);
  const timestamp = new Date().toLocaleString('en-IN');
  const stampText = `USER: ${partnerEmail} | LOC: ${centerName || 'N/A'} | IP: ${userIp} | TIME: ${timestamp}`;

  for (const docName of requiredDocs) {
    const fileOrFiles = docFiles[docName];
    if (!fileOrFiles) continue;

    const filesToProcess = Array.isArray(fileOrFiles) ? fileOrFiles : [fileOrFiles];

    for (let i = 0; i < filesToProcess.length; i++) {
      const file = filesToProcess[i];
      const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
      const mimeType = file.type.toLowerCase();
      
      const label = Array.isArray(fileOrFiles) ? `${docName} (Part ${i + 1}/5)` : docName;
      onProgress(`Processing ${label}...`);

      if (mimeType.includes('pdf') || file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.pdf')) {
        const loadedPdf = await PDFDocument.load(arrayBuffer, { ignoreEncryption: true });
        const copiedPages = await pdfDoc.copyPages(loadedPdf, loadedPdf.getPageIndices());
        
        copiedPages.forEach((page) => {
          pdfDoc.addPage(page);
          const { width } = page.getSize();
          page.drawRectangle({ x: 0, y: 0, width: width, height: 20, color: rgb(0, 0, 0) });
          page.drawText(`${label.toUpperCase()} | ${stampText}`, { x: 10, y: 6, size: 7, font: trackingFont, color: rgb(1, 1, 1) });
        });
      } else if (mimeType.includes('jpeg') || mimeType.includes('jpg') || mimeType.includes('png')) {
        let image = (mimeType.includes('png')) ? await pdfDoc.embedPng(arrayBuffer) : await pdfDoc.embedJpg(arrayBuffer);
        let { width, height } = image;
        const maxWidth = 595.28; 
        if (width > maxWidth) {
          const ratio = maxWidth / width;
          width = maxWidth;
          height = height * ratio;
        }

        const page = pdfDoc.addPage([width, height + 25]);
        page.drawImage(image, { x: 0, y: 25, width: width, height: height });
        page.drawRectangle({ x: 0, y: 0, width: width, height: 25, color: rgb(0, 0, 0) });
        page.drawText(`${label.toUpperCase()} | ${stampText}`, { x: 10, y: 8, size: 7, font: trackingFont, color: rgb(1, 1, 1) });
      }
    }
  }

  onProgress("Uploading secure Compliance PDF to Vault...");
  const mergedPdfBytes = await pdfDoc.save();
  return mergedPdfBytes;
};

import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

// Provide a build-time fallback so the static compiler never crashes
const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || 'https://build-placeholder.supabase.co';
const supabaseKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || 'build-placeholder-key';

// =========================================================================
// HYBRID COOKIE + LOCALSTORAGE ADAPTER (WEB EDGE + MOBILE APP READY)
// Mirrors auth tokens to both HTTP Cookies (for Next.js Edge proxy.ts) and
// LocalStorage (so Capacitor / React Native WebViews never drop sessions).
// =========================================================================
const writeCookie = (key: string, value: string) => {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
  const isSecure = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'secure;' : '';
  document.cookie = `${key}=${encodeURIComponent(value)}; path=/; max-age=31536000; SameSite=Lax; ${isSecure}`;
};

const customHybridStorage = {
  getItem: (key: string) => {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null;
    const match = document.cookie.match(new RegExp('(^| )' + key + '=([^;]+)'));
    if (match) {
      return decodeURIComponent(match[2]);
    }
    // Mobile App Fallback: If WebView cleared cookies, recover from localStorage & re-sync cookie
    try {
      const localVal = window.localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (localVal) {
        writeCookie(key, localVal);
        return localVal;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("LocalStorage read fallback warning:", e);
    }
    return null;
  },
  setItem: (key: string, value: string) => {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    writeCookie(key, value);
    try {
      window.localStorage.setItem(key, value);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("LocalStorage write warning:", e);
    }
  },
  removeItem: (key: string) => {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    document.cookie = `${key}=; path=/; expires=Thu, 01 Jan 1970 00:00:00 GMT`;
    try {
      window.localStorage.removeItem(key);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("LocalStorage remove warning:", e);
    }
  }
};

export const supabase = createClient(supabaseUrl, supabaseKey, {
  auth: {
    storage: typeof window !== 'undefined' ? customHybridStorage : undefined,
    autoRefreshToken: true,
    persistSession: true,
    detectSessionInUrl: true,
  }
});

// FILE PATH: ./app/lib/errorCodes.ts
import { supabase } from "./supabase";

const ERROR_CATALOG: Record<string, { code: string; userMessage: string }> = {
  "23505": {
    code: "ERR-DUP-205",
    userMessage:
      "Duplicate Record Blocked: This UTR, Transaction ID, or Report Date has already been registered in the ledger.",
  },
  "23503": {
    code: "ERR-REL-203",
    userMessage:
      "Reference Error: Linked profile or center mapping could not be verified.",
  },
  "42501": {
    code: "ERR-SEC-401",
    userMessage:
      "Security Gate: Your current session does not have permission for this action.",
  },
  "PGRST116": {
    code: "ERR-LCK-116",
    userMessage:
      "Record Locked: This entry was already processed or updated.",
  },
  "STORAGE_ERR": {
    code: "ERR-VLT-301",
    userMessage:
      "Vault Storage Error: Unable to upload or retrieve the document. Verify file format and size.",
  },
  "OCR_ERR": {
    code: "ERR-OCR-404",
    userMessage:
      "Receipt Scanner Notice: Could not auto-read all fields from the slip. Please verify and enter manually.",
  },
  "CSV_HTML_MISMATCH": {
    code: "ERR-UID-422",
    userMessage:
      "Report Validation Blocked: The uploaded CSV and HTML files do not match your Operator ID, Station ID, or selected date.",
  },
  "DEFAULT": {
    code: "ERR-SYS-500",
    userMessage:
      "System Operation Failed: Unable to process the request right now. Please try again or contact support with this error code.",
  },
};

export async function reportAndMaskError(
  err: any,
  moduleName: string,
  actor?: { id?: string; email?: string; role?: string }
): Promise<string> {
  const rawMessage = String(err?.message || err || "Unknown error");
  const rawCode = String(err?.code || "");

  let matched = ERROR_CATALOG["DEFAULT"];
  if (rawCode && ERROR_CATALOG[rawCode]) {
    matched = ERROR_CATALOG[rawCode];
  } else if (
    rawMessage.toLowerCase().includes("duplicate") ||
    rawMessage.toLowerCase().includes("unique")
  ) {
    matched = ERROR_CATALOG["23505"];
  } else if (
    rawMessage.toLowerCase().includes("mismatch") ||
    rawMessage.toLowerCase().includes("parity") ||
    rawMessage.toLowerCase().includes("unrecognized uidai")
  ) {
    matched = ERROR_CATALOG["CSV_HTML_MISMATCH"];
  } else if (
    rawMessage.toLowerCase().includes("storage") ||
    rawMessage.toLowerCase().includes("bucket") ||
    rawMessage.toLowerCase().includes("upload")
  ) {
    matched = ERROR_CATALOG["STORAGE_ERR"];
  }

  try {
    await supabase.from("system_audit_logs").insert([
      {
        actor_id: actor?.id || null,
        actor_email: actor?.email || "SYSTEM",
        actor_role: actor?.role || "USER",
        module: moduleName,
        action_code: matched.code,
        metadata: { raw_code: rawCode, raw_error: rawMessage },
      },
    ]);
  } catch (_) {}

  return `[${matched.code}] ${matched.userMessage}`;
}

export async function logSystemTelemetry(params: {
  actorId?: string;
  actorEmail?: string;
  actorRole?: string;
  module: string;
  actionCode: string;
  referenceId?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}) {
  try {
    await supabase.from("system_audit_logs").insert([
      {
        actor_id: params.actorId || null,
        actor_email: params.actorEmail || "UNKNOWN",
        actor_role: params.actorRole || "PARTNER",
        module: params.module,
        action_code: params.actionCode,
        reference_id: params.referenceId || null,
        metadata: params.metadata || {},
      },
    ]);
  } catch (_) {}
}

export function generateSystemReferenceCode(prefix: "FA-DEP" | "FA-ADH", dateStr?: string): string {
  const cleanDate = (dateStr || new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0]).replace(/-/g, "");
  const rand = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 6).toUpperCase();
  const timePart = Date.now().toString().slice(-4);
  return `${prefix}-${cleanDate}-${rand}${timePart}`;
}

// FILE PATH: ./app/api/verify-applicant/route.ts
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const supabaseAdmin = createClient(
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
      process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!
    );
    const payload = await request.json();

    const cleanEmail = String(payload.email || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    const cleanMobile = String(payload.mobile || '').trim();
    const cleanAltMobile = String(payload.alt_mobile || '').trim();
    const cleanGovId = String(payload.gov_id_number || '').trim();
    const cleanPan = String(payload.pan_number || '').trim().toUpperCase();

    if (!cleanEmail || !cleanMobile || !cleanGovId) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { success: false, error: '[ERR-VAL-400] Email, Mobile, and Gov ID are mandatory.' },
        { status: 400 }
      );
    }

    // 1. Check Active Partners & Back-Office Staff Directories First
    const [activePartnerMatch, staffMatch] = await Promise.all([
      supabaseAdmin
        .from('active_partners')
        .select('id, status')
        .or(`email.ilike.${cleanEmail},mobile.eq.${cleanMobile}`)
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle(),
      supabaseAdmin
        .from('back_office_staff')
        .select('id')
        .ilike('email', cleanEmail)
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle(),
    ]);

    if (staffMatch.data) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            '[ERR-DUP-205] Identity Conflict: This email is registered to an internal corporate account.',
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    if (activePartnerMatch.data && activePartnerMatch.data.status === 'Active') {
      return NextResponse.json(
        {
          success: false,
          error:
            '[ERR-DUP-205] Identity Conflict: An active partner profile with this Email or Mobile already exists.',
        },
        { status: 409 }
      );
    }

    // 2. Parallel Lookups in pending_applications
    const lookups = [
      supabaseAdmin.from('pending_applications').select('id, status').ilike('email', cleanEmail),
      supabaseAdmin.from('pending_applications').select('id, status').eq('mobile', cleanMobile),
      supabaseAdmin.from('pending_applications').select('id, status').eq('gov_id_number', cleanGovId),
    ];

    if (cleanAltMobile) {
      lookups.push(
        supabaseAdmin.from('pending_applications').select('id, status').eq('alt_mobile', cleanAltMobile)
      );
      lookups.push(
        supabaseAdmin.from('pending_applications').select('id, status').eq('mobile', cleanAltMobile)
      );
    }

    if (cleanPan) {
      lookups.push(
        supabaseAdmin.from('pending_applications').select('id, status').eq('pan_number', cleanPan)
      );
    }

    const results = await Promise.all(lookups);
    let allMatchedRecords: any[] = [];

    for (const res of results) {
      if (res.error && res.error.code !== '42703') {
        throw new Error('Database lookup failed.');
      }
      if (res.data && res.data.length > 0) {
        allMatchedRecords = [...allMatchedRecords, ...res.data];
      }
    }

    if (allMatchedRecords.length > 0) {
      const hasActiveCollision = allMatchedRecords.some((r: any) => r.status !== 'Rejected');
      if (hasActiveCollision) {
        return NextResponse.json(
          {
            success: false,
            error:
              '[ERR-DUP-205] Database Block: A record with this Identity (Email/Mobile/ID) is already registered and under process.',
          },
          { status: 409 }
        );
      }

      return NextResponse.json({ success: true, rejectedId: allMatchedRecords[0].id });
    }

    return NextResponse.json({ success: true, rejectedId: null });
  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json(
      { success: false, error: '[ERR-SYS-500] Identity verification service unavailable.' },
      { status: 500 }
    );
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { Resend } from 'resend';

// Define strict enterprise limits (Upgraded to include Supervisor limit of 20)
const ROLE_LIMITS: Record<string, number> = {
  'Manager': 5,
  'Accountant': 3,
  'Supervisor': 20,
  'Staff': 11,
  'Admin': 2 
};

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const supabaseAdmin = createClient(
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
      process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!
    );
    const resend = new Resend(process.env.RESEND_API_KEY);

    // =========================================================================
    // 1. CRITICAL SECURITY GATE
    // =========================================================================
    const authHeader = request.headers.get('Authorization');
    if (!authHeader) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Missing token' }, { status: 401 });
    }
    
    const token = authHeader.replace('Bearer ', '');
    const { data: { user: requestingUser }, error: verifyError } = await supabaseAdmin.auth.getUser(token);
    
    if (verifyError || !requestingUser) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Invalid session' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const { data: adminCheck, error: adminError } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('back_office_staff')
      .select('role')
      .eq('email', requestingUser.email)
      .single();

    if (adminError || adminCheck?.role !== 'Admin') {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Forbidden: Super Admin clearance required.' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 2. Data Extraction & Quota Verification
    // =========================================================================
    const { name, email, role, mobile } = await request.json();

    if (!name || !email || !role) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Missing mandatory fields: Name, Email, or Role.' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    const maxLimit = ROLE_LIMITS[role];
    if (maxLimit) {
      const { count, error: countError } = await supabaseAdmin
        .from('back_office_staff')
        .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })
        .eq('role', role);

      if (!countError && count !== null && count >= maxLimit) {
        return NextResponse.json({ 
          success: false, 
          error: `Limit Reached: You have reached the maximum quota of ${maxLimit} for the ${role} role.` 
        }, { status: 400 });
      }
    }

    const tempPassword = `FastArk@${Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000)}`;

    // =========================================================================
    // 3. ARCHITECTURAL FIX: 2-STEP BYPASS WITH AUTH_ID BINDING
    // =========================================================================
    
    // STEP A: Create the Auth User WITHOUT metadata to bypass the legacy trigger.
    const { data: authData, error: authError } = await supabaseAdmin.auth.admin.createUser({
      email: email.trim().toLowerCase(),
      password: tempPassword,
      email_confirm: true
    });

    if (authError) throw new Error(`Auth Creation Failed: ${authError.message}`);
    const newUserId = authData.user.id;

    // STEP B: Manually inject the user into the database WITH their auth_id.
    // This CRITICAL step ensures Row Level Security (RLS) allows them to log in.
    const { error: dbError } = await supabaseAdmin.from('back_office_staff').insert([{
      auth_id: newUserId, 
      email: email.trim().toLowerCase(),
      name: name,
      role: role,
      mobile: mobile || null,
      status: 'Active'
    }]);

    if (dbError) {
      // Rollback Auth if DB insertion fails to prevent orphaned ghost accounts
      await supabaseAdmin.auth.admin.deleteUser(newUserId);
      throw new Error(`Database record creation failed: ${dbError.message}`);
    }

    // STEP C: Safely update user_metadata now that the database is mapped.
    await supabaseAdmin.auth.admin.updateUserById(newUserId, {
      user_metadata: {
        name: name,
        role: role,
        mobile: mobile || null,
        must_change_password: true
      }
    });

    // =========================================================================
    // 4. Secure Credential Dispatch via Resend
    // =========================================================================
    const senderEmail = 'updates@fastark.in';

    await resend.emails.send({
      from: `Fast Ark IT Systems <${senderEmail}>`,
      to: email,
      subject: `Action Required: Your Fast Ark ${role} Credentials`,
      text: `Dear ${name},\n\nYour internal Fast Ark Command Center account has been provisioned.\n\nAssigned Role: ${role}\nLogin Email: ${email}\nTemporary Password: ${tempPassword}\n\nSecurity Notice: Please log in immediately and update your password in your profile settings.\n\nBest Regards,\nFast Ark IT Administration`,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({ 
      success: true, 
      message: `Staff provisioned successfully. Credentials emailed to ${email}.` 
    });

  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('API Error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  try {
    const supabaseAdmin = createClient(
      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
      process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!
    );

    // =========================================================================
    // 1. CRITICAL SECURITY GATE: Verify Bearer Token & Super Admin Role
    // =========================================================================
    const authHeader = request.headers.get('Authorization');
    if (!authHeader) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Missing token' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const token = authHeader.replace('Bearer ', '');
    const { data: { user: requestingUser }, error: verifyError } = await supabaseAdmin.auth.getUser(token);

    if (verifyError || !requestingUser) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Unauthorized: Invalid session' }, { status: 401 });
    }

    const { data: adminCheck, error: adminError } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('back_office_staff')
      .select('role')
      .ilike('email', requestingUser.email || '')
      .maybeSingle();

    if (adminError || !adminCheck || !['Admin', 'Manager'].includes(adminCheck.role)) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Forbidden: Admin or Manager clearance required.' }, { status: 403 });
    }

    // =========================================================================
    // 2. Target Extraction & Complete Profile Purge
    // =========================================================================
    const { auth_id, partner_id } = await request.json();

    if (!auth_id || !partner_id) {
      return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: 'Missing target IDs' }, { status: 400 });
    }

    // Delete the user from the Supabase Auth Vault so the email is freed
    const { error: authError } = await supabaseAdmin.auth.admin.deleteUser(auth_id);
    if (authError) throw new Error(`Auth Deletion Failed: ${authError.message}`);

    // Delete their footprint from active_partners
    const { error: dbError } = await supabaseAdmin
      .from('active_partners')
      .delete()
      .eq('id', partner_id);
    if (dbError) throw new Error(`Database Record Deletion Failed: ${dbError.message}`);

    // Log the purge in the immutable audit trail
    await supabaseAdmin.from('staff_activity_logs').insert([{
      staff_id: requestingUser.id,
      staff_email: requestingUser.email,
      action_type: 'PURGE_REJECTED',
      module: 'ONBOARDING',
      target_id: partner_id,
      details: `Purged rejected partner profile (${partner_id}) and Auth ID (${auth_id}).`
    }]);

    return NextResponse.json({ 
      success: true, 
      message: "Rejected profile purged completely. The email address is now available for a fresh registration." 
    });

  } catch (error: any) {
    return NextResponse.json({ success: false, error: error.message }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
